cards.t_text: And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.

cards.note: *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.* 1 Enoch 99:2 names the woe-pattern against those who pervert the words of uprightness and transgress the eternal law. Matt 5:19's *whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven* walks the same diagnostic at the kingdom-status level. The Hebrew library carries the woe-form; the gospel carries the kingdom-status-naming. Both name the same act — perverting the words, transgressing the eternal law — and both refuse to soften the diagnostic.
cards.s_text: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
cards.t_text: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.

cards.note: *Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.* (1 Enoch 104:9). Enoch's charge to his children is the charge Matthew 5:19 makes to every teacher: do not alter the words of uprightness. *Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven.* To alter the words and to teach men so are one act; both are named here before the gospel names them.
cards.s_text: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
cards.t_text: Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.

cards.note: *And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.* (1 Enoch 104:10). Enoch knew the mystery before the pulpit practised it: sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness, and write books about it. *Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so* (Matthew 5:19) — the teaching is the perverting; the books are the sermons. The kingdom-status of such teachers was fixed long before the sermon was preached.
cards.s_text: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
cards.t_text: And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.

cards.note: *And they said to Yahuah (Lord) of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim (God) of gods, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!* (1 Enoch 9:4). Enoch's angels pray what the disciples are taught to pray: the holy and blessed name, the throne of glory that stands to all generations, the King of kings. *Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come* (Matthew 6:9–10) is the same prayer in the mouth of the children.
cards.s_text: After this manner therefore pray you: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be your name.
cards.t_text: And they said to Yahuah (Lord) of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim (God) of gods, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!

cards.note: *‘Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (Lord), King, Great and mighty in Thy greatness, Yahuah (Lord) of the whole creation of the heaven, King of kings and Elohim (God) of the whole world. And Thy power and kingship and greatness abide for ever and ever, And throughout all generations Thy dominion; And all the heavens are Thy throne for ever, And the whole earth Thy footstool for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 84:2). *Hallowed be thy name* (Matthew 6:9). Enoch's own prayer blesses the King whose dominion is through all generations and whose throne is the heavens. The disciples are taught to pray what the patriarch prayed.
cards.s_text: After this manner therefore pray you: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be your name.
cards.t_text: ‘Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (Lord), King, Great and mighty in Thy greatness, Yahuah (Lord) of the whole creation of the heaven, King of kings and Elohim (God) of the whole world. And Thy power and kingship and greatness abide for ever and ever, And throughout all generations Thy dominion; And all the heavens are Thy throne for ever, And the whole earth Thy footstool for ever and ever.

cards.note: *Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.* (1 Enoch 9:5). The One whose kingdom the disciples pray to come is the One who made all things and holds power over all things, from whom nothing hides. *Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven* (Matthew 6:10) asks nothing new; it asks that what is already true in heaven be seen on earth.
cards.s_text: Your kingdom come. Your will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
cards.t_text: Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.

cards.note: *And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptation, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.* (1 Enoch 94:1). Two ways, and only two. Enoch sets them before his sons — the paths of righteousness worthy of acceptance, the paths of unrighteousness that vanish — long before Matthew 7:13's *wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction.* The choice at Deuteronomy 30:19 was already old when Enoch taught it.
cards.s_text: Enter you in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leads to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
cards.t_text: And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptation, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.

cards.note: *And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves afar from them, And shall not follow them.* (1 Enoch 94:2). Enoch sees it from the other side: the paths of violence and death are shown to certain men of a generation, and they keep far from them. *Strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it* (Matthew 7:14). The few who hold themselves afar are the few who find.
cards.s_text: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leads unto life, and few there be that find it.
cards.t_text: And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves afar from them, And shall not follow them.

cards.note: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *Many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Avraham (Abraham), and Yitschaq (Isaac), and Ya'aqov (Jacob), in the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 8:11). Enoch saw the sitting-down: all that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in the house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoicing because they had returned. The many from east and west are the dispersed of the house coming home — the scattered sheep, not a new flock.
cards.s_text: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
cards.t_text: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.

cards.note: *And there I saw One who had a head of days, and His head was white like wool, and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.* 1 Enoch 46:1 names the throne-room vision in the Hebrew library's apocalyptic register — the Head of Days and another being with the appearance of a man beside Him. This is the opening of the named-title Messianic-figure passage (1 Enoch 46:1-3) the framework reads as the load-bearing Hebrew-library parallel for Matt 8:20's *the Son of Adam.* The figure is named as the Christ in heavenly vision before the incarnation.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of Adam has not where to lay his head.
cards.t_text: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.

cards.note: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). Enoch asks who *that Son of Adam* is — a figure named by title, standing beside the Head of Days. When Yahusha (Jesus) says *the Son of Adam hath not where to lay his head* (Matthew 8:20) he takes that title for himself: the named one of the Parables, now with no bed on the earth he came to.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of Adam has not where to lay his head.
cards.t_text: And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?

cards.note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* 1 Enoch 46:3 locks the identification of the figure: *the Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* This is the Christ — chosen, pre-eminent, the revealer of hidden treasures. The Hebrew library's named-title parallel for Matt 8:20's self-designation is locked in this verse. The figure Enoch saw in heavenly vision is the figure Yahusha (Jesus) names himself as in the gospel.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of Adam has not where to lay his head.
cards.t_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The spirits that met him among the tombs are named here by origin and by work: the spirits of the giants, afflicting and destroying, hungering and thirsting without food. The two possessed men of Matthew 8:28, *exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way,* were under exactly this.
cards.s_text: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
cards.t_text: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.

cards.note: *And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.* Jubilees 10:1 names the post-flood demon-administration architecture — the unclean demons begin their work on Noah's seed. The Hebrew library's book of Jubilees carries the same spirits-from-the-giants identification 1 Enoch 15-16 names. Matt 8:28's two-possessed-with-devils in the Gergesene territory walks the same architecture: the demons operating in the eastern-tribal-inheritance are the same spirits the Hebrew library had named in their post-flood demon-administration register.
cards.s_text: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
cards.t_text: And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.

cards.note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* 1 Enoch 48:2 names the Son of Adam's pre-existence-and-naming-before-the-Head-of-Days architecture in the Similitudes — the Son of Adam was named BEFORE creation; his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Matt 9:6's *the Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins* is the in-flesh exercise of the authority that 1 Enoch 48 names as eternally-pre-existent. The figure who has the Father's-forgiveness-prerogative in flesh is the figure 1 Enoch had named as pre-existent. Red Line #12 governs the named-title rendering (not kaph-comparative).
cards.s_text: But that you may know that the Son of Adam has power on earth to forgive sins, (then says he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up your bed, and go unto your house.
cards.t_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* 1 Enoch 48:3 intensifies the architecture: the Son of Adam's name was named before creation itself. Matt 9:6's in-flesh exercise of the Father's forgiveness-prerogative is the present-tense demonstration of the eternal-pre-existence the Similitudes had named — the Son of Adam exercising on earth what was his before the foundation of the world.
cards.s_text: But that you may know that the Son of Adam has power on earth to forgive sins, (then says he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up your bed, and go unto your house.
cards.t_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *The Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins* (Matthew 9:6). The Parables had already named him the one born unto righteousness, over whom righteousness abides; the forgiveness he speaks on earth is that abiding righteousness exercised in flesh.
cards.s_text: But that you may know that the Son of Adam has power on earth to forgive sins, (then says he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up your bed, and go unto your house.
cards.t_text: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’

cards.note: *And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). The shepherds who were set over the sheep and destroyed more than they were bidden end here, judged and cast into the fiery abyss. When Yahusha (Jesus) saw the multitudes *as sheep having no shepherd* (Matthew 9:36), he was looking at the flock those shepherds had left; the vision had already recorded their sentence.
cards.s_text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
cards.t_text: And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.

cards.note: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.* (1 Enoch 90:29). The shepherdless sheep of Matthew 9:36 are not left shepherdless. Enoch saw the Lord of the sheep bring a new house, greater and loftier than the first, with all the sheep within it. The compassion that moved him at the sight of the scattered flock is the compassion that builds the house.
cards.s_text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
cards.t_text: And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.

cards.note: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *When he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad* (Matthew 9:36). Enoch saw where the scattering ends: all that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in the house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoicing because they had returned.
cards.s_text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
cards.t_text: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.

cards.note: *I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.* (1 Enoch 104:1). *Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 10:32). Enoch swears to the righteous that their names are already written before the glory of the Great One. The Son confesses before the Father the ones whose names were written before they ever confessed.
cards.s_text: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
cards.t_text: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.

cards.note: *And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.* (1 Enoch 103:4). *But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 10:33). Enoch's word to the righteous who die in righteousness is that their memorial does not perish before the Great One. The warning of Matthew 10:33 is the other side of that promise: a memorial can be kept, and a name can be blotted out (1 Enoch 108:3). The denier is not a tare who never had a name; he is wheat that did not endure.
cards.s_text: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
cards.t_text: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.

cards.note: *And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children.* 1 Enoch 99:5 names the wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-register naming of the day-of-destruction family-disintegration: parents abandoning children, children perishing through parents. Matt 10:35-36's *I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother* walks the same household-division-pattern at the kingdom-citizens-hearing-the-Shepherd-divides-the-household register. The wisdom-stream had named the disintegration-of-the-household as the day-of-destruction signature; the King names the kingdom-hearing-of-his-voice as producing the division-line that runs through the household.
cards.s_text: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
cards.t_text: And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them, And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.

cards.note: *And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten, And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.* 1 Enoch 100:1-2 names the wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-register naming of the family-betrayal-in-the-day-of-destruction architecture: fathers and sons smitten together, brothers falling on brothers. Matt 10:36's *a man's foes shall be they of his own household* (citing Micah 7:6) walks the same architecture. The framework reads the seed-war (Genesis 3:15) as operative at the household-level — the kingdom-citizens' hearing of the Shepherd's voice creates a division-line the family-relationship cannot insulate from. The wisdom-stream had named the diagnostic at the apocalyptic-register; the King names it at the commissioning-discourse register.
cards.s_text: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.
cards.t_text: And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.

cards.note: *But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.* (1 Enoch 1:8). The answer sent to Yochanan (John) — *the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them* (Matthew 11:5) — is the peace, protection, mercy, and light Enoch saw promised to the righteous, now arriving in flesh.
cards.s_text: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
cards.t_text: But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.

cards.note: *And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.* (1 Enoch 10:17). Enoch saw the days when the righteous escape and complete their years in peace, the earth tilled in righteousness and cleansed of oppression (1 Enoch 10:17–22). The works Yahusha (Jesus) lists for Yochanan (John) at Matthew 11:5 are the first fruits of those days — the age Enoch saw, beginning.
cards.s_text: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
cards.t_text: And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.

cards.note: *And there I saw One who had a head of days, and His head was white like wool, and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.* 1 Enoch 46:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Father-Son architecture at the apocalyptic-register: the One-who-had-a-head-of-days (the Father) and the Son-of-Adam-whose-countenance-had-the-appearance-of-a-man-and-whose-face-was-full-of-graciousness (the Son). Matt 11:25-27's Father-Son revelation-economy prayer walks the same architecture at the kingdom-discourse register: the Father (*Lord of heaven and earth*) and the Son (*all things are delivered unto me of my Father; and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son*). The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King at Matt 11:25-27 names it operative in his own voice.
cards.s_text: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knows the Son, but the Father; neither knows any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
cards.t_text: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.

cards.note: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.* 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-revealing-the-hidden-treasures architecture: the Son-of-Adam reveals the hidden-treasures because Yahuah (God) has chosen him. Matt 11:27's *no man knoweth the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him* walks the same revelation-economy architecture explicitly. The framework reads 1 Enoch 46:3 as the wisdom-stream's named anchor of the *son of Adam* lineage-weight (Red Line #12) restored — the title-naming case where the kaph-comparative is NOT operative; the figure is named the Son of Adam outright. The Matt 11:27 *only the Son reveals the Father* and the 1 Enoch 46:3 *the Son-of-Adam revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden* name the same operative-fact: revelation-of-the-Father is mediated through the Son.
cards.s_text: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knows the Son, but the Father; neither knows any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
cards.t_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.note: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* 1 Enoch 48:6 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-chosen-and-hidden-before-the-creation-of-the-world architecture. The framework reads the verse as the wisdom-stream anchor of the Red Line #11 *names-written-before-the-foundation-of-the-world* architecture extended to the Son himself — the Son named before the creation, hidden before the Father, revealed-to-the-elect at the appointed-time. Matt 11:27's *no man knoweth the Son, but the Father* names the unique-mutual-knowledge between the chosen-and-hidden-Son and the Father — the relational-substance the wisdom-stream had named at the apocalyptic-register restated by the King at the kingdom-discourse register.
cards.s_text: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knows the Son, but the Father; neither knows any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
cards.t_text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.

cards.note: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness.* 1 Enoch 48:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the revelation-economy: the wisdom-of-Yahuah (God) reveals the Son-of-Adam to the holy-and-righteous — the body that has hated-and-despised-this-world-of-unrighteousness. The framework reads the verse against Matt 11:25's *thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes* — the revelation-economy at the King's prayer names the same architecture: revelation is to the un-credentialed-receptive (the babes, the holy-and-righteous-who-have-despised-this-world); concealment is from the system-credentialed (the wise-and-prudent, the world-of-unrighteousness). The Father's sovereign-revelation-choice aligns with the substance Red Line #11's seed-war-hearing-pattern names.
cards.s_text: At that time Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said, I thank you, O Father, Yahuah (Lord) of heaven and earth, because you have hid these things from the wise and prudent, and have revealed them unto babes.
cards.t_text: And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.

cards.note: *Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.* (1 Enoch 95:7). *Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him* (Matthew 12:14). Enoch's woe already names them: sinners who persecute the righteous, and the heavy yoke that waits for them. The council against the Righteous One is the act the woe was written for.
cards.s_text: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
cards.t_text: Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.

cards.note: *For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore. For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow.* 1 Enoch 49:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wisdom-poured-out-on-the-Elect-One architecture. Matt 12:18's *I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the goyim* (citing Isaiah 42:1) walks the same architecture at the gospel-restatement register: the Father's-Spirit-anointing of the Son the King walks publicly through the Galilean-ministry. The framework reads the verse-pair as one architecture across two registers: the wisdom-stream knew the Elect-One's wisdom-anointing-from-the-Father; Matt 12:18 names the operative-fact at the inaugurated-ministry.
cards.s_text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.

cards.note: *And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.* 1 Enoch 49:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the four-spirits-on-the-Elect-One architecture — the same four-spirits-cluster Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 11:2 names of the Branch-from-Yishai (Jesse): the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (the LORD). The framework reads 1 Enoch 49:3 as the wisdom-stream restatement of Isaiah 11:2 applied to the Elect-One — the same Spirit-anointing substance Matt 12:18 names in Yahusha (Jesus) at the immersion (Matt 3:16-17). The Tanakh anchor, the wisdom-stream anchor, and the gospel-fulfillment name one Spirit-anointing-architecture across three registers.
cards.s_text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.

cards.note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). *Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles* (Matthew 12:18). Enoch saw the same: the spirit of righteousness poured out on the Elect One seated on the throne, and the word of his mouth bringing judgment. The servant of Isaiah and the Elect One of the Parables are one figure, and the Spirit upon him is the same Spirit.
cards.s_text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.

cards.note: *And again Yahuah (the Lord) said to Raphael: Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dudael, and cast him therein. And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever.* 1 Enoch 10:4-5 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the binding-of-the-watchers-leader-Azazel architecture: bound-hand-and-foot, cast-into-the-darkness, sealed-with-rocks, covered-with-darkness for the appointed-time. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:29's *how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.* The King's exorcisms-and-spoiling are the inaugurated-form of the binding-architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the watcher-leader register; the full-binding-of-Satan at Revelation 20:1-3 lands the architecture at the millennial-consummation. The wisdom-stream knew the binding-and-darkness-and-appointed-time pattern; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-binding-and-spoiling.
cards.s_text: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.

cards.note: *And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: For whom are these chains being prepared? And he said unto me: These are being prepared for the hosts of Azazel, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits commanded.* 1 Enoch 54:5 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the chains-prepared-for-Azazel-and-his-hosts and the casting-into-the-abyss-of-complete-condemnation architecture. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:29's binding-the-strong-man: the wisdom-stream knew the chains-prepared and the abyss-of-condemnation as the eschatological-architecture awaiting Azazel and his hosts; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-action that culminates in the architecture the wisdom-stream had named.
cards.s_text: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: And he said unto me: ‘These are being prepared for the hosts of Azâzêl, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits commanded.

cards.note: *And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.* (1 Enoch 65:11). *But the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Ghost) shall not be forgiven unto men* (Matthew 12:32). Enoch heard the sentence on those who showed what was hidden and became the damned: no place of repentance for ever. There is a sin that closes the door from the inside; the Pharisees who called the Spirit's work the work of Beelzebub stood at that door.
cards.s_text: And whosoever speaks a word against the Son of Adam, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaks against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
cards.t_text: And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.

cards.note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* 1 Enoch 51:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the earth-and-Sheol-and-hell-giving-back-what-they-have-received architecture: resurrection-from-the-place-of-the-dead at the appointed-time. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:40's sign-of-Yonah three-days-and-three-nights-in-the-heart-of-the-earth: the wisdom-stream knew the earth-and-Sheol-giving-back-the-dead architecture; the King at Matt 12:40 names the inaugurated-form of the architecture in his own future-resurrection that the Yonah-typology pre-announces. The Yonah-vomited-out-by-the-fish at Yonah (Jonah) 2:10 is the typological-anchor the King draws; the wisdom-stream architecture of Sheol-giving-back is the framework-context.
cards.s_text: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
cards.t_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.note: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). *Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given* (Matthew 13:11). Enoch says who the *you* are: the holy and righteous to whom the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits reveals him, who have hated this world of unrighteousness. The revealing follows the belonging; it does not create it.
cards.s_text: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
cards.t_text: And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.

cards.note: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). *Then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart* (Matthew 13:19). Enoch names the spirits of the Watchers assuming many forms, leading mankind astray — the actor behind the catching-away. He is not a figure of speech; the restored library records his origin and his end.
cards.s_text: When any one hears the word of the kingdom, and understands it not, then comes the wicked one, and catches away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
cards.t_text: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.

cards.note: *And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters. And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: "Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children."* 1 Enoch 6:1-2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the watchers' incursion: the children-of-the-heaven saw-and-lusted-after the daughters-of-men and took-wives-from-among-them. The framework reads the verse as THE foundational-anchor for the tares-sown-by-the-enemy at Matt 13:25. The watchers' incursion produced the corrupted-line-of-the-giants and the spirits-of-the-giants that operate within-the-field-of-the-world as the seed-of-the-wicked-one. The King at Matt 13:25 names the operative-parable-form of the architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the chronological-source register: the enemy-sowing-tares-while-men-slept is the wisdom-stream's watchers-coming-while-men-slept-in-Yared (Jared)'s-days.
cards.s_text: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters.

cards.note: *And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.* (1 Enoch 10:9). *The tares are the children of the wicked one* (Matthew 13:38). Enoch names them before the parable does: the children of the Watchers, a seed with a father of its own, distinguished from the line of Adam and marked for destruction. The tares are not bad wheat; they are another seed.
cards.s_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
cards.t_text: And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.

cards.note: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling. Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.* 1 Enoch 15:8-9 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the spirits-of-the-giants-as-evil-spirits-upon-the-earth architecture: the giants died-physically but the spirits-of-the-giants continue-on-the-earth as evil-spirits. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:38-39's *the tares are the children of the wicked one ... the enemy that sowed them is the devil.* The wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the spirits-of-the-corruption operating-on-the-earth after the original-watchers' incursion; the King's parable names the operative-form of the seed-distinction at the field-of-the-world register. The evil-spirits-of-the-giants are the operative-instruments of the wicked-one's-sowing across the age.
cards.s_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
cards.t_text: And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.

cards.note: *And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born unto them, that the angels of Yahuah (the Lord) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare unto them sons and they were giants.* Jubilees 5:1-2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the watchers' incursion: the angels-of-Yahuah (the Lord) took-wives of the daughters-of-men and begat-giants. The framework reads the verse as a wisdom-stream parallel to 1 Enoch 6:1-2 (same incursion, slightly different angle). The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:25's tares-sown-by-the-enemy-while-men-slept: the wisdom-stream witnesses across both Jubilees AND 1 Enoch the watchers' incursion as the foundational-architecture the wheat-and-tares parable operates within. Two wisdom-stream witnesses establish the substance the King's parable names.
cards.s_text: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.

cards.note: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth* (Matthew 13:42). Enoch saw the abyss of fire and the prison appointed for the Watchers — the furnace the parable names, already mapped.
cards.s_text: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
cards.t_text: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.

cards.note: *And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’* (1 Enoch 54:6). *The reapers are the angels* (Matthew 13:39), and here they are by name: Michael, Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, casting the hosts of Azazel into the burning furnace on the great day. The furnace of Matthew 13:42 has its angels, its day, and its reason — vengeance for leading astray those who dwell on the earth.
cards.s_text: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
cards.t_text: And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’

cards.note: *Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.* 1 Enoch 104:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for Matt 13:43's *then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father* substance: the righteous shall-shine-as-the-lights-of-heaven at the eschatological-vindication. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:43: the wisdom-stream knew the architecture of the righteous-shining-as-the-lights-of-heaven at the day-of-vindication; the King names the operative-form at the wheat-and-tares-interpretation register. The shall-be-seen-and-the-portals-of-heaven-shall-be-opened substance carries the kingdom-of-the-Father vindication-architecture the King names at Matt 13:43. Two wisdom-stream witnesses (1 Enoch 104:2 here and Daniel 12:3 at the Tanakh-register) establish the substance the King's parable interpretation names at the gospel-register.
cards.s_text: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who has ears to hear, let him hear.
cards.t_text: Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.

cards.note: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before him, before the creation of the world and for evermore.* 1 Enoch 48:6 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for Matt 13:35's *I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world* substance: the Elect-One was-chosen-and-hidden-before-the-creation-of-the-world-and-for-evermore. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:34-35: the wisdom-stream knew the architecture of the Elect-One hidden-from-the-foundation-of-the-world and revealed-at-the-appointed-time; the King at Matt 13:35 fulfills the Psalm 78:2 substance by uttering things-which-have-been-kept-secret-from-the-foundation-of-the-world. The wisdom-stream and the King's-own-self-disclosure name one architecture: the substance hidden from the foundation is the substance the parables-method now reveals to the disciples.
cards.s_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
cards.t_text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.

cards.note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *All these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables* (Matthew 13:34). Enoch had named the Son of Adam as the one who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden. The parables are that revealing — hidden things opened, by the one chosen to open them.
cards.s_text: All these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
cards.t_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.note: *And over all the righteous and holy he will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels to guard them as the apple of an eye, until he makes an end of all wickedness and all sin, and though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.* 1 Enoch 100:5 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the holy-angels-guarding-the-righteous architecture at the eschatological-judgment register: the angels are-appointed-to-guard-the-righteous as-the-apple-of-an-eye until-the-end-of-all-wickedness-and-all-sin. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:49: the angels-as-guards-and-as-severers operate in the same architecture across the wisdom-stream and the gospel. The Son-of-Adam-sends-the-angels for both the gathering-of-the-righteous AND the severing-of-the-wicked; the wisdom-stream knew the angelic-architecture; the King names the operative-form.
cards.s_text: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
cards.t_text: And over all the righteous and holy He will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels To guard them as the apple of an eye, Until He makes an end of all wickedness and all sin, And though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.

cards.note: *Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.* Wisdom of Solomon 2:24 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the through-envy-of-the-devil-came-death-into-the-world architecture: the devil's envy is the source-of-death entering-the-world; they-that-hold-of-his-side find-death. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:39's *the enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world.* The wisdom-stream had named the architecture-of-the-devil-as-source-of-death-in-the-world; the King names the operative-form at the wheat-and-tares-interpretation register. The framework reads the architecture in continuity: the devil's envy at Bereshit (Genesis) 3 (the serpent) + the devil's seduction at the watchers (1 Enoch 6-11) + the devil's sowing-of-tares at Matt 13:39 = one architecture of the source-of-death-and-corruption across the canon and the wisdom-stream. The they-that-hold-of-his-side find-death substance is the same architecture the children-of-the-wicked-one carry: paternal-source-determines-destination.
cards.s_text: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
cards.t_text: Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.

cards.note: *And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’* (1 Enoch 22:7). *The good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one* (Matthew 13:38). The seed war is older than the parable. Enoch is shown the spirit of Hevel (Abel), the first righteous blood, making its suit against the seed of Qayin (Cain) until that seed is gone from among the seed of men. Two seeds, from Genesis 4 to the harvest.
cards.s_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
cards.t_text: And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’

cards.note: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). *Whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?* (Matthew 16:13). The question uses the title Enoch asked about — *that Son of Adam,* the one who went with the Head of Days. The King asks whether men have recognized the figure the Parables named.
cards.s_text: When Yahusha (Jesus) came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?
cards.t_text: And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?

cards.note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *Thou art the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God)* (Matthew 16:16). Kefa (Peter) confesses what Enoch was told: the Son of Adam who has righteousness, whom Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has chosen, whose lot has the pre-eminence for ever. The confession at Caesarea Philippi is the angel's answer at 1 Enoch 46:3, spoken on earth.
cards.s_text: And Simon Peter answered and said, You are the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days.* 1 Enoch 48:2 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Son-of-Adam-being-named-in-the-presence-of-Yahuah-of-Spirits substance — the heavenly-naming-of-the-Christ at the throne. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:16's *thou art the Messiah, the Son of the living Elohim (God).* Kefa's (Peter's)-confession articulates at the earthly-gospel-pivot what 1 Enoch 48:2 names at the heavenly-throne-pivot: the Son-of-Adam's name is the name-named-before-the-Head-of-Days. The wisdom-stream had named the heavenly-substance; the gospel-confession lands the earthly-confession of the same architecture; the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates at the Father's-revealing the same substance the wisdom-stream carried.
cards.s_text: And Simon Peter answered and said, You are the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* 1 Enoch 48:3 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the before-the-foundation-of-the-world naming substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:17's *flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.* The Father's-revelation to Kefa (Peter) reveals what was always true — the Son-of-Adam's name was named-before-the-sun-and-the-signs-were-created, before-the-stars-of-the-heaven-were-made; the gospel-confession at Caesarea Philippi reveals at the earthly-historical-pivot the substance the wisdom-stream had named at the before-creation register. The framework reads this in continuity with Revelation 13:8 / 17:8's *the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world* and *names written in the book of life from the foundation of the world* — the Father's-foreknowledge architecture the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates within.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Blessed are you, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood has not revealed it unto you, but my Father which is in heaven.
cards.t_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.note: *For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.* (1 Enoch 49:2). *I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 16:19). The secrets of righteousness belong to the Elect One who stands before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits; the keys Kefa (Peter) receives are stewardship of what is his. The one who holds the secrets delegates their opening.
cards.s_text: And I will give unto you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
cards.t_text: For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.

cards.note: *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3). *I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 16:19). Enoch saw the Elect One seated on the Father's throne, his mouth pouring out the secrets of wisdom and counsel. The keys are given by the one who sits on that throne; the house of David's key (Isaiah 22:22) is on his shoulder before it is in Kefa's (Peter's) hand.
cards.s_text: And I will give unto you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
cards.t_text: And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.

cards.note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *Flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 16:17). The Father's naming of the Son of Adam at 1 Enoch 71:14 is the same revealing — the Head of Days declaring who he is. Kefa (Peter) receives on earth what Enoch heard in heaven, and the keys follow the revealing.
cards.s_text: And I will give unto you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
cards.t_text: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’

cards.note: *And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.* (1 Enoch 69:27). *Whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven* (Matthew 16:19). The sum of judgement was given to the Son of Adam on the throne of his glory; what the apostles bind and loose is bound and loosed under that judgement, not beside it.
cards.s_text: And I will give unto you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
cards.t_text: And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.

cards.note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, and Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, and hell shall give back that which it owes.* 1 Enoch 51:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Sheol-giving-back-the-dead substance — the resurrection-architecture Wisdom of Solomon 16:13's *bringest up again* substance names at the apocryphal-stream-level and 1 Enoch 51:1 articulates at the pseudepigraphal-stream-level. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:18's *the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.* The gates-of-Sheol do not hold-finally because Sheol shall give-back-that-which-it-has-received at the day-of-Yahuah; the assembly built-on-the-King partakes-of-the-resurrection-substance the wisdom-stream had named the architecture for. The framework reads this in continuity with the broader-resurrection-architecture per the first-resurrection of Revelation 20:4-6 and the gathering-of-the-elect from-the-four-winds at Matt 24:31.
cards.s_text: And I say also unto you, That you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
cards.t_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.note: *Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?* 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:35 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the souls-of-the-righteous-in-their-chambers substance — the waiting-room of the righteous-dead between the first-coming and the resurrection. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:18's gates-of-hell-shall-not-prevail substance. The chambers-of-the-righteous-souls are not the eternal-conscious-torment-hell of the inherited-Christian-doctrine; the chambers are the waiting-place-for-the-resurrection. The gates-of-Sheol the King names do not hold-the-righteous-souls-finally; the resurrection-architecture per Red Line #11's sequence the framework reads operates: the righteous-souls in-the-chambers await-the-first-resurrection at the King's-coming, when Sheol gives back-that-which-it-has-received (1 Enoch 51:1) and the chambers-deliver-those-souls-that-were-committed-unto-them (2 Esdras 7:32's parallel naming).
cards.s_text: And I say also unto you, That you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
cards.t_text: Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?

cards.note: *And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed unto them.* 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:32 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the resurrection-of-the-dead substance preceding the day-of-judgment. The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:27's Son-of-Adam-coming-and-rewarding substance. The resurrection-substance the wisdom-stream names at 2 Esdras 7:32 + 1 Enoch 51:1 + Wisdom of Solomon 16:13 precedes the rewarding-according-to-works at the day-of-judgment. The framework reads the sequence in continuity with the first-resurrection of Revelation 20:4-6 — the righteous-souls in-the-chambers (2 Esdras 4:35) are restored-and-delivered (2 Esdras 7:32) and the works-of-the-living-and-the-restored are sifted-and-rewarded (2 Esdras 7:35 + Sirach 16:12 + Matt 16:27).
cards.s_text: For the Son of Adam shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
cards.t_text: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.

cards.note: *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* (1 Enoch 8:1). *Whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck* (Matthew 18:6). The stumbling-blocks laid across the way of the little ones have a history: Azazel taught men the arts that became the snares. The millstone is the King's answer to the teacher of the snare.
cards.s_text: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
cards.t_text: And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.

cards.note: *And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.* 1 Enoch 10:8 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the inevitability-of-offences-in-the-present-age substance — the whole earth has-been-corrupted by the watcher-taught substance, and the offences-coming-of-necessity (Matt 18:7's *it must needs be that offences come*) is the architectural-consequence of the corruption-already-running. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:7's *woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh.* The inevitability does-not-excuse the man-by-whom-the-offence-comes; the architecture-of-the-fallen-age makes the offences-inevitable, and the kingdom-citizen-who-becomes-the-substance-that-causes-the-stumble has joined-himself to the watcher-substance the kingdom-came-to-undo. The framework reads this in continuity with Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 24:5-6's *the earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant. Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth.* The earth's-defiling and the curse's-devouring are the architecture 1 Enoch names the source-of and the King-names the consequence-of at the millstone-warning.
cards.s_text: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence comes!
cards.t_text: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’

cards.note: *Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods.* 1 Enoch 19:1 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the leading-astray (*planao* — the same root the King will use for the *go astray* of the sheep at vv.12-13) substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:7's woe-against-the-man-by-whom-the-offence-comes. The fallen-watchers and their spirits operating-in-many-forms across the present-age are the architectural-substance behind every system-of-stumbling-block the King's-millstone-warning lands-on — the institutional-Christianity's antinomian-doctrine, the Hebrew-Roots false-inclusion gospel, the Pharisaic-traditions-of-the-elders, the Galatian-circumcision-party, the Islamic-transfer (the four-costumes per voice skill framework). The lying-spirits-leading-astray are the architecture under the doctrinal-corruptions; the kingdom-citizen-who-joins-the-corruption joins-the-substance the watchers-loosed. The framework reads this with the patience-not-condescension posture per voice skill — the little-ones-led-astray are victims-not-enemies; the systems-and-the-leadership-who-perpetuate-them are where the woe lands.
cards.s_text: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence comes!
cards.t_text: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.

cards.note: *Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.* (1 Enoch 22:11). *It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea* (Matthew 18:6). Better than what? Than the place Enoch was shown — spirits set apart in great pain until the great day of judgement, and bound there. The sea is the lesser end.
cards.s_text: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
cards.t_text: Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.

cards.note: *This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (the Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.* 1 Enoch 27:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the accursed-valley-of-judgment substance — the Watcher-Book passage (1 Enoch 26-27) describing the valley at the centre of the holy mountain (an explicit topographical-pointer to the *gei-Hinnom* (Valley of the sons of Hinnom) on the southern-edge of Yerushalayim (Jerusalem)). The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:9's *gehenna of fire.* The King's gehenna-substance is the Tanakh-and-wisdom-stream's accursed-valley-of-judgment carried-forward; 1 Enoch 27:2 names the wisdom-stream's identification of the place — *those who are accursed for ever* gathered for the judgment-substance at the place-of-judgment. The framework reads the substance as destruction-substance, not eternal-conscious-maintenance — *here shall be their place of judgement* is the place-where-the-judgment-is-executed, in continuity with 1 Enoch 22:11's consummation-of-the-judgment substance and Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 66:24's carcases-and-worm substance. The disciple cuts-off the hand-foot-eye that causes the stumble because the judgment is real.
cards.s_text: And if your eye offend you, pluck it out, and cast it from you: it is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
cards.t_text: Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: Here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.

cards.note: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.* (1 Enoch 90:18). *For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost* (Matthew 18:11). The Lord of the sheep comes to the flock in person, staff in hand, and the beasts and birds that devoured them are swallowed by the earth. The saving of the lost is the Lord of the sheep arriving.
cards.s_text: For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost.
