cards.t_text: And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.

cards.note: *And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.* (1 Enoch 89:54). *If a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?* (Matthew 18:12). Enoch's vision names the owner of the flock: Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, whose house and tower the sheep forsook. The shepherd of the parable is not a hired man; he is the Lord of the sheep seeking his own.
cards.s_text: How think you? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, does he not leave the ninety and nine, and goes into the mountains, and seeks that which is gone astray?
cards.t_text: And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.

cards.note: *But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.* 1 Enoch 90:6 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the lambs-that-open-their-eyes substance — the post-judgment opening of the eyes-of-the-sheep-who-had-been-blinded under the seventy-shepherds-administration. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:14's *it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.* The Father's-will is for the lambs-that-open-their-eyes — the substance the King's mustard-seed-faith and the disciples' kingdom-witness gathers; the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates in the architecture of the lambs-who-open-the-eyes being-the-substance who-hear-when-the-Shepherd-calls. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the kingdom-witness operationalizes it; the gathering is the Father's-will-substance, not the universalist-overriding-determinism.
cards.s_text: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
cards.t_text: But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.

cards.note: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *He rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray* (Matthew 18:13). Enoch saw that joy at the end: the Lord of the sheep rejoicing with great joy because all that had been dispersed had returned to his house. The parable's one sheep is the vision's whole flock.
cards.s_text: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoices more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
cards.t_text: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.

cards.note: *And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’* (1 Enoch 40:9). *In heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 18:10). Enoch is given the names of the four who stand before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits — mercy, healing, power, and repentance unto hope. The little ones are watched over from the throne itself.
cards.s_text: Take heed that you despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
cards.t_text: And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’

cards.note: *Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.* (1 Enoch 94:8). *A rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 19:23). Enoch's woe says why: those who trust in riches depart from them, having not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of their wealth. The difficulty is not the money; it is the trust.
cards.s_text: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
cards.t_text: Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.

cards.note: *Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.* (1 Enoch 97:7). *A rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 19:23). The young ruler's confidence — *all these things have I kept from my youth up* — is the sinner's confidence Enoch names: a remembrance that is evil against him, however secure the holdings look.
cards.s_text: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
cards.t_text: Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.

cards.note: *And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,* (1 Enoch 97:9). *It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God)* (Matthew 19:24). Enoch gives the rich man's own speech — silver gathered, granaries full, *let us do what we purposed.* That speech is the needle's eye closing.
cards.s_text: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,

cards.note: *And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: Wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; For ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement.* 1 Enoch 98:10 names the Enochic wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the *ye know no ransom* substance — the substance the disciples' *who then can be saved?* at Matt 19:25 presupposes-the-failure-of. The framework reads the verse against the disciples' question. The Enochic-substance names the substance directly: the rich-sinner-substance-presumes-on-the-substance-of-riches-as-ransom; the substance is failed-substance — *ye know no ransom.* The disciples' question at v.25 — *who then can be saved?* — presupposes the inherited-substance that-had-associated-material-prosperity-with-the-Father's-blessing (Bereshit (Genesis) 13:2, 26:12, Devarim (Deuteronomy) 28's covenant-blessings); if-even-the-substance-the-Tanakh-treats-as-blessing is-an-obstacle, who-can-be-saved? The Enochic-substance had named the architecture-of-the-failure-of-the-rich-man's-ransom; the King's-substance at v.26 will-name the substance the Father makes-possible against-the-substance the natural-substance-finds-impossible.
cards.s_text: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
cards.t_text: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.

cards.note: *And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.* (1 Enoch 100:6). *With men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible* (Matthew 19:26). Enoch saw the day the children of the earth understand that riches cannot save them. What riches cannot do, Elohim (God) does — that is the whole of the disciples' hope, and the whole of the rich man's.
cards.s_text: But Yahusha (Jesus) beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible.
cards.t_text: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.

cards.note: *And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.* (1 Enoch 62:8). *So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen* (Matthew 20:16). Enoch saw the chosen gathered: the congregation of the elect and holy sown, and all the elect standing before him on that day. The few are not fewer because they tried harder; they are the elect, and the elect are revealed by their standing.
cards.s_text: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
cards.t_text: And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.

cards.note: *And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness which was inexhaustible: and around it were many fountains of wisdom: and all the thirsty drank of them, and were filled with wisdom, and their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.* 1 Enoch 48:1 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the all-the-thirsty-drank-and-were-filled substance — the broad-proclamation-substance that reaches-the-many. The framework reads the verse against Matt 20:16's *many be called.* The wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the broad-fountain-the-thirsty-drink-from at the prefiguring-register; the gospel-proclamation goes-out broadly because the citizens-of-the-kingdom are scattered-among-the-nations and the proclaimers do-not-know-the-citizens-by-sight. The substance is the broad-substance through-which the citizens-the-Father-has-known emerge — the *thirsty* are the ones whose names-are-written-in-the-Book-of-Life-from-the-foundation-of-the-world and who-hear-the-Shepherd-when-the-Shepherd-calls (John 10:27).
cards.s_text: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
cards.t_text: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.

cards.note: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.* 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the named-Son-of-Adam-who-hath-righteousness substance — the Parables-of-Enoch (chs 37-71) had carried the Son-of-Adam architecture centuries before the gospels articulated it at the gospel-pivot. The framework reads the verse against Matt 20:28's framework-major *even as the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.* The King names himself explicitly as the Son-of-Adam the wisdom-stream had named — the One whom-Yahuah-of-Spirits-hath-chosen, with whom-dwelleth-righteousness. The framework reads this as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR per Red Line #12's Son-of-Adam-restoration — the title-substance carries the Adamic-seed-of-promise the canon names through every Son-of-Adam title-position; the *son of Adam* restoration of the inherited-translation's *son of man* preserves the lineage-weight the title carries. The substance the King is about-to-give is the substance-of-the-Adamic-line-of-promise the Father has-carried through-the-prophets to-the-substance-of-the-substantial-ransom-paid-by-the-Son-of-Adam himself.
cards.s_text: Even as the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
cards.t_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days.* 1 Enoch 48:2 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation substance — *yea, before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (48:3). The framework reads the verse against Matt 20:28's *the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.* The Son-of-Adam-who-came is the same Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation; the substance-of-the-coming was determined by-the-Father from-before-the-foundation-of-the-world; the substantial-ransom is NOT a defeat-imposed-by-circumstances but the substance the Son-walked-into-knowingly under-the-Father's-determination from-before-the-foundation (per the *must* / *dei* of divine-necessity at Matt 16:21's first passion-prediction). The framework reads this in continuity with Hitgalut (Revelation) 13:8's *the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.*
cards.s_text: Even as the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
cards.t_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *The Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many* (Matthew 20:28). The same Son of Adam, Enoch saw, raises the kings and the mighty from their seats and breaks the teeth of the sinners. The one who serves is the one who judges; the ransom and the reckoning belong to the same hands.
cards.s_text: Even as the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
cards.t_text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.

cards.note: *And I know how lowly He shall be upon earth, and how glorious in heaven.* Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 94:5 (Testament of Benjamin 9) names THE direct extras-stream verbal-anchor for the lowly-on-earth-and-glorious-in-heaven substance — the precise architecture the King names at Matt 20:28's *the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.* The framework reads the verse as the most-direct pseudepigraphal-anchor for the kenotic-incarnational architecture the King articulates at the chapter-pivot. The Tanakh-Suffering-Servant-substance the King draws-from at v.28 (Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 53:3's *despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows*; 53:5-6's *wounded for our transgressions ... Yahuah (the LORD) hath laid on him the iniquity of us all*; 53:10-12's *make his soul an offering for sin ... bare the sin of many*) is the same lowly-on-earth substance Testaments 94:5 names; the eschatological-glorious-in-heaven substance the wisdom-stream points-forward-to is the same substance 1 Enoch 62's Son-of-Adam-on-the-throne-of-his-glory names. The framework reads this in continuity with Philippians 2:6-11's *made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant ... wherefore Elohim (God) also hath highly exalted him* — the apostolic-witness restates the substance the King's-own-mouth named at the gospel-pivot and the wisdom-and-pseudepigraphal-stream named at the prefiguring-register.
cards.s_text: Even as the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
cards.t_text: And He shall ascend from Hades and shall pass from earth into heaven. And I know how lowly He shall be upon earth, and how glorious in heaven.]

cards.note: *But He remained unmoved, though He saw it, and rejoiced that they were devoured and swallowed and robbed, and left them to be devoured in the hand of all the beasts.* (1 Enoch 89:58). *Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away* (Matthew 21:19). Enoch saw the Lord of the sheep do the same to a flock that had abandoned him: unmoved, leaving them to be devoured. The withered tree is the leadership that bore no fruit, left to its own harvest.
cards.s_text: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on you henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
cards.t_text: But He remained unmoved, though He saw it, and rejoiced that they were devoured and swallowed and robbed, and left them to be devoured in the hand of all the beasts.

cards.note: *And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). *He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen* (Matthew 21:41). The husbandmen answer their own parable; Enoch's vision records the sentence they pronounced — the seventy shepherds judged, found guilty, and cast into the fiery abyss.
cards.s_text: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
cards.t_text: And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.

cards.note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* 1 Enoch 46:3 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Son-of-Adam-who-hath-righteousness substance — the Parables-of-Enoch identify the Son-of-Adam by name and articulate the architecture the King brings-into-the-Pharisaic-system's-face at the David's-Lord question. The framework reads the verse against Matt 22:42's *what think ye of Messiah (Christ)? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.* The Pharisaic-answer is correct as-far-as-it-goes — the Messiah is the son-of-David per the Davidic-covenant of 2 Samuel 7:12-16 + Isaiah 9:6-7 + Isaiah 11:1 + Jeremiah 23:5-6 + Ezekiel 34:23-24. But 1 Enoch 46:3 names the substance the Pharisaic-answer cannot-account-for — the Son-of-Adam pre-existing-the-Davidic-descent (*whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever*); the Son the King walks-into at the Psalm-110 citation is the Son-of-Adam the wisdom-stream had named the substance the Pharisaic-substance could-only-walk-the-Davidic-half-of. Per Red Line #12's Son-of-Adam architecture, the 1 Enoch 46:3 naming-by-title-of-the-Son-of-Adam stands as the named-figure (NOT the kaph-comparative case of Daniel 7:13 / Revelation 1:13 / Revelation 14:14 the Red Line carves-out separately). FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.s_text: Saying, What think you of Messiah (Christ)? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.
cards.t_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* 1 Enoch 48:2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-Head-of-Days substance — the pre-existence and the eternal-naming of the Son before the foundation of the world the apostle Yochanan (John) will name at Revelation 13:8 + 17:8 (the Book of Life of the Lamb slain-from-the-foundation-of-the-world). The framework reads the verse against Matt 22:43's *how then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying ...* The substance David walks at-Psalm-110 — David-the-prophet-in-the-Spirit calling-the-Messianic-substance *my Lord* — is the substance 1 Enoch 48:2 had named at the wisdom-stream-register: the Son-of-Adam was named before the Head of Days before the substance of the Davidic-line existed. The substance the Pharisaic-answer cannot-account-for at vv.42-46 is the substance 1 Enoch 48:2 had named at the heavenly-substance-register: the Son-of-Adam is greater-than-David because the Son-of-Adam was-named before-the-Head-of-Days before-the-Davidic-line-existed. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.s_text: He says unto them, How then does David in spirit call him the Lord, saying,
cards.t_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.note: *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3). *Yahuah (The LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand* (Matthew 22:44; Psalm 110:1). Enoch heard the same seating spoken by the Father: *the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne.* The Pharisees could not say how David's son is David's Lord; the Parables had already seated him.
cards.s_text: Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make your enemies your footstool?
cards.t_text: And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.

cards.note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool* (Matthew 22:44). The Head of Days placing the Elect One on the throne of glory is Psalm 110:1 seen from the throne room — the Father seating the Son, the Son judging. The Formless seats the Formed; the One who is seated is Elohim (God) and has a Father.
cards.s_text: Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make your enemies your footstool?
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.

cards.note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?* (Matthew 22:45). The Father answers at 1 Enoch 71:14: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* Born — David's son after the flesh; named by the Head of Days — David's Lord. The question the Pharisees could not answer, the Parables had answered.
cards.s_text: If David then call him the Lord, how is he his son?
cards.t_text: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’

cards.note: *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.* 1 Enoch 99:2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the pervert-the-words-of-uprightness-and-transform-themselves-into-sinners substance — the same substance the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks-against at Matt 23:15 (the proselyte made-twofold-more-the-child-of-Gehinnom (Gehenna)). The framework reads the verse against the inherited-religious-system-substance that walks-the-substance in-reverse — the leadership-substance claims-to-walk-the-Torah while transgressing-the-eternal-law through the perversion-of-the-words-of-uprightness. The wisdom-stream had named the substance directly. The contrary-to-Torah-test the apostle-Yochanan (John) names at 1 John 2:3-4 is the standing-test the wisdom-stream had-already-named.
cards.s_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, you make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
cards.t_text: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.

cards.note: *And he said unto me: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’* (1 Enoch 21:10). *Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of Gehinnom (hell)?* (Matthew 23:33). Enoch was shown the prison of the angels and told it holds them for ever. The judgment the serpents cannot escape is the judgment their fathers, the Watchers, are already held for; the seed goes where the seed came from.
cards.s_text: You serpents, you generation of vipers, how can you escape the damnation of hell?
cards.t_text: And he said unto me: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’

cards.note: *And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’* (1 Enoch 22:7). *That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Hevel (Abel)* (Matthew 23:35). Enoch saw the spirit of Hevel (Abel) making its suit against the seed of Qayin (Cain) until that seed is destroyed. The blood that cries from the ground (Genesis 4:10) is still crying in Enoch's vision, and the King hands the sum of it to the generation standing in front of him.
cards.s_text: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom you slew between the temple and the altar.
cards.t_text: And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’

cards.note: *And said to him: Go to Noah and tell him in My Name "Hide thyself!" and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth.* 1 Enoch 10:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the proclamation-to-Noach (Noah) substance the King walks at Matt 24:37 — *as the days of Noach (Noah) were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* The framework reads the verse against the substantial-Watcher-rebellion-architecture 1 Enoch 6-9 walks the substantial-Genesis 6:1-4 substance into, the substance the apostle-Yehudah (Jude) quotes at Jude 14-15 and the apostle-Kefa (Peter) walks at 2 Peter 2:5 and 2 Peter 3:3-7. The substantial *as the days of Noach (Noah) were* substance the King names is the substantial-Watcher-rebellion-substance-prefiguring-the-substantial-end-of-the-age architecture — the substantial-corruption-of-the-substantial-flesh-substance the Watchers walked, the substantial-Nephilim (giants) corruption, the substantial-judgment-by-flood the substantial-substance walked into. 1 Enoch 10:2 names the substantial-direct-substance the Father-substance walked the substantial-proclamation-to-Noach (Noah) at the substantial-pre-flood-substance the King's Matt 24:37 substance recapitulates. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.s_text: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.
cards.t_text: ’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.

cards.note: *And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”* (1 Enoch 65:10). *As in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noach (Noah) entered into the ark* (Matthew 24:38). Enoch heard the sentence pronounced over those days: judgement determined, not to be withheld, the earth and its dwellers to be destroyed for the sorceries they had learned. The eating and drinking went on under a sentence already passed.
cards.s_text: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
cards.t_text: And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”

cards.note: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be* (Matthew 24:39). The flood took the wicked away; it did not carry the righteous off. Enoch's word for the Watchers is the same taking: led off to the abyss of fire, to the prison. The ones taken at the coming are the ones taken at the flood — the judged.
cards.s_text: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.
cards.t_text: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.

cards.note: *And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.* 1 Enoch 57:1 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south* substance the King walks at Matt 24:27 — *as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* The framework reads the verse against the substantial-public-visible-second-coming substance the King walks against the substantial-secret-rapture-substance the substantial-modern-dispensational-Christian-eschatology walks. The substantial *coming on the winds from the east, and from the west* substance the wisdom-stream had named at the substantial-Parables-of-Enoch-substance is the substantial-pattern the second-coming-substance walks-into — substantially-public, substantially-visible, substantially-from-the-east-to-the-west. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.s_text: For as the lightning comes out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.

cards.note: *And the noise of their wagons was heard, and when this turmoil took place the holy ones from heaven remarked it, and the pillars of the earth were moved from their place, and the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other.* 1 Enoch 57:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *from one end of heaven to the other* substance the King walks at Matt 24:31 — *and he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.* The framework reads the verse as the substantial-direct-anchor for the substantial *from one end of heaven to the other* substance the King names — the wisdom-stream had named the substantial-architecture-of-the-substantial-cosmic-sound-from-end-to-end at the substantial-Parables-of-Enoch-substance; the King walks the substantial-substance at the substantial-Olivet-discourse-substance. The framework reads this as the substantial-direct-anchor for THE central Red Line #11 four-winds-gathering verse — the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes the prophets walked at Deuteronomy 30:1-4 + Isaiah 11:11-12 + Ezekiel 37:21 + Hosea 1:10-11 + Zechariah 10:8-10. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.s_text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
cards.t_text: And the noise of their wagons was heard, and when this turmoil took place the holy ones from heaven remarked it, and the pillars of the earth were moved from their place, and the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other, in one day.

cards.note: *And these measures shall reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth, And those who have been destroyed by the desert, And those who have been devoured by the beasts, And those who have been devoured by the fish of the sea, That they may return and stay themselves on the day of the Elect One.* 1 Enoch 61:5 names the wisdom-stream articulation of the gathering-of-the-substance-destroyed-and-devoured substance — the substantial-Father's-substance preserves the substantial-substance the substantial-substance had-lost across the substantial-period of the substantial-scattering-substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 24:31 — the substantial-gathering-of-the-elect-from-the-four-winds substance walks the substantial-substance the substantial-Father's-substance preserves across the substantial-scattering-substance-the-substantial-prophets named the substantial-substance for. 1 Enoch 61:5 names the substantial-substance the Father-substance preserves at the substantial-cosmic-register — the substance the substantial-substance the substantial-deeps-of-the-earth had-swallowed-up is preserved-and-returned at the substantial-day-of-the-Elect-One-substance the King walks at the substantial-gathering-from-the-four-winds substance.
cards.s_text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
cards.t_text: And these measures shall reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth, And those who have been destroyed by the desert, And those who have been devoured by the beasts, And those who have been devoured by the fish of the sea, That they may return and stay themselves On the day of the Elect One; For none shall be destroyed before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And none can be destroyed.

cards.note: *And it looked at them [and their eyes opened], and it cried to the sheep, and the rams saw it and all ran to it.* (1 Enoch 90:10). *And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds* (Matthew 24:31). Enoch saw the gathering as a flock: the great horn cried to the sheep, their eyes opened, and the rams all ran to it. The gathering is the sheep running to the horn that called them.
cards.s_text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
cards.t_text: And it looked at them [and their eyes opened], and it cried to the sheep, and the rams saw it and all ran to it.

cards.note: *And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.* (1 Enoch 62:5). *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch saw that seat and the faces of those who see it — terror, pain, downcast countenance, when they see that Son of Adam sitting on the throne of his glory. The sheep-and-goats judgment opens on the throne the Parables had already set.
cards.s_text: When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
cards.t_text: And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.

cards.note: *And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.* (1 Enoch 61:10). *And all the holy angels with him* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch gives the roll: the host of the heavens, the holy ones above, Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophannim, the angels of power and of principalities — and the Elect One among them. The company of the coming was mustered in the Parables before the gospel named it.
cards.s_text: When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
cards.t_text: And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.

cards.note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another* (Matthew 25:32). The Son of Adam who separates is the Son of Adam Enoch saw raise the kings and the mighty from their seats and break the teeth of the sinners. The separation is a reversal; the mighty do not keep their seats at it.
cards.s_text: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divides his sheep from the goats:
cards.t_text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.

cards.note: *And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame. And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 46:6). *Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels* (Matthew 25:41). Enoch saw what that departure is for the strong: countenance put down, shame, darkness for a dwelling, worms for a bed, no hope of rising — because they did not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.s_text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, you cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
cards.t_text: And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame. And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.note: *And in the day of our suffering and tribulation He saves us not, And we find no respite for confession That our Lord is true in all His works, and in His judgements and His justice, And His judgements have no respect of persons.* (1 Enoch 63:8). *Depart from me, ye cursed* (Matthew 25:41) is answered in Enoch by the mouths of the kings and the mighty themselves: in the day of their tribulation he saves them not, and their confession comes too late to be anything but true. *Lord, when saw we thee an hungred?* (Matthew 25:44) is the same late confession.
cards.s_text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, you cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
cards.t_text: And in the day of our suffering and tribulation He saves us not, And we find no respite for confession That our Lord is true in all His works, and in His judgements and His justice, And His judgements have no respect of persons.

cards.note: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* (Matthew 26:64). The bound man before the council names himself with Enoch's title — *that Son of Adam* who went with the Head of Days. The council thought it was judging him; he was telling them who would judge.
cards.s_text: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, You have said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall you see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
cards.t_text: And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?

cards.note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and the strong from their thrones, and shall loosen the reins of the strong, and break the teeth of the sinners.* 1 Enoch 46:4 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-vindicated-against-the-kings-and-the-mighty substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 26:64's answer-at-the-Sanhedrin — the corrupt-high-priesthood-Sanhedrin-aristocracy condemning-the-King at the historical-pivot will-themselves-be-raised-up-from-their-seats and stand-before-the-Son-of-Adam-on-the-throne-of-his-glory at the eschatological-day-of-vindication. The substantial-irony-substance walks-substantively: the Sanhedrin-substance prices-the-King-as-the-blasphemer-deserving-death at v.66 (*he is guilty of death*) and the same Sanhedrin-substance will-themselves-stand-condemned before the Son-of-Adam-they-condemned at the day 1 Enoch 46:4 names the substance for. The categorical-direct-rule-out of any-reading-that-treats-the-Sanhedrin's-verdict-as-the-Father's-verdict — the Father's-verdict on the Son-at-the-Sanhedrin-trial is the substantial-Davidic-Messianic-Son-at-the-right-hand-of-power-substance the King names at v.64; the Sanhedrin's-verdict is the corrupt-leadership-substance the Tanakh-prophetic-substance had walked-out-substantively against centuries before.
cards.s_text: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, You have said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall you see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
cards.t_text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.

cards.note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* 1 Enoch 48:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation-of-the-world substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 26:64's direct-self-identification — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) standing-bound-before-the-Sanhedrin names-himself-as-the-Son-of-Adam-whose-name-was-named-before-Yahuah-of-Spirits before-the-foundation-of-the-world. The substantial-Davidic-Messianic-Son-of-Adam-substance is NOT-the-substantial-substance the Sanhedrin-substance treats-as-blasphemy at-the-historical-pivot; the substantial-substance is the substantial-Father's-pre-foundational-Naming-of-the-Son-substance the wisdom-stream had named-substantively at-the-heavenly-substance-register. The framework reads this in continuity with the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 — *if you hear, you are sons of Adam. You did not choose to hear and become these things. You heard because you are these things.* The names-named-before-the-foundation-of-the-world architecture (Revelation 13:8 + 17:8) operates at the substantial-substance-level the wisdom-stream had named-substantively at 1 Enoch 48:3 + 48:6 (*chosen and hidden before Him, before the creation of the world and for evermore*). The Sanhedrin-substance does-NOT-name-the-Son; the Father-substance names-the-Son before-the-creation-of-the-world.
cards.s_text: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, You have said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall you see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
cards.t_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.note: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power* (Matthew 26:64). Enoch saw what the council will see: all the kings and the mighty falling on their faces before that Son of Adam, petitioning him for mercy. The men who condemned him will kneel to him.
cards.s_text: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, You have said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall you see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
cards.t_text: And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.

cards.note: *And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty, And the exalted and those who hold the earth, And they shall see and recognize How he sits on the throne of his glory, And righteousness is judged before him, And no lying word is spoken before him.* (1 Enoch 62:3). *When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death* (Matthew 27:1). Enoch saw the other morning: all the kings and the mighty standing up in that day to see and recognize how he sits on the throne of his glory, where no lying word is spoken. The council that condemned him stands at his bar.
cards.s_text: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death:
cards.t_text: And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty, And the exalted and those who hold the earth, And they shall see and recognize How he sits on the throne of his glory, And righteousness is judged before him, And no lying word is spoken before him.

cards.note: *And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.* (1 Enoch 61:10). *If he be the King of Yashar'el (Israel), let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him* (Matthew 27:42). The mockers set the wrong test. Enoch saw the King's credential: the whole host of heaven summoned, and the Elect One among them. He did not come down from the cross; he is the one for whom the heavens are mustered.
cards.s_text: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Yashar'el (Israel), let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
cards.t_text: And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.

cards.note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *He trusted in Elohim (God); let him deliver him now, if he will have him* (Matthew 27:43). The Head of Days had already said it: *the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.* The cross was not the Father's forsaking of the Son; it was the Son of Adam, born unto righteousness, doing what righteousness does.
cards.s_text: He trusted in Elohim (God); let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’

cards.note: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). *Let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him* (Matthew 27:42). Enoch saw the mockers' end: the kings and the mighty and those who rule the earth falling on their faces before that Son of Adam, worshipping and petitioning. *Every knee should bow* (Philippians 2:10) — the mockers included.
cards.s_text: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Yashar'el (Israel), let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
cards.t_text: And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.

cards.note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, and Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, and hell shall give back that which it owes ... For in those days the Elect One shall arise.* 1 Enoch 51:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Elect-One-shall-arise + earth-shall-give-back-the-dead substance — the Resurrection-architecture the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walks as the firstfruits at-Matt 28:6 and the citizens-of-the-kingdom will walk at the first-resurrection per Revelation 20:4-6. The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The Elect-One-arising-substance the wisdom-stream names IS the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walking-out the substantial-Resurrection-substance at-Matt 28:1-10 + the substantial-dominion-substance at-Matt 28:18 — the firstfruits-arising and the dominion-given-substance walk-in-the-same-architecture the wisdom-stream had named the Elect-One-substance for. The framework reads this in continuity with the S146 Matt 16 thread `the-gates-of-sheol-and-the-resurrection-substance-in-wisdom-of-solomon-and-1-enoch` (anchored at the Resurrection-credential of-the-sign-of-Yonah pre-announced at Matt 16:4) — Matt 28 is the operative-event the wisdom-stream-architecture had named. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
cards.t_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.note: *And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.* 1 Enoch 51:2 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Elect-One-shall-choose-the-righteous-and-holy substance — the post-harvest-sifting of the wheat from the wheat-mixed-with-chaff substance per Red Line #11 + Matt 13:30 (*let both grow together until the harvest*) + Matt 25:31-46 (the sheep-and-goats). The framework reads the verse against Matt 28:18's *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* The substantial-all-power-substance the King receives at v.18 is the operative-substance for the day-has-drawn-nigh-that-they-should-be-saved substance the wisdom-stream had named — the Elect-One walks-the-substantial-choosing-of-the-righteous-and-holy because the substantial-all-power-substance is-substantively-given. The framework reads this in continuity with the post-harvest-sifting per Red Line #11 — the wheat is gathered out of all nations (Ezekiel 37:21) into the wilderness (Ezekiel 20:35), purges-out-the-rebels (Ezekiel 20:38), brought-into-the-bond-of-the-new-covenant (Jeremiah 31:31), and then grafted-into-the-natural-root-of-the-fathers (Romans 11:24). The Elect-One-choosing-the-righteous-and-holy is the substance the wisdom-stream had named at the architecture-level; the substantial-all-power-given-substance is the operative-substance for the choosing to walk.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
cards.t_text: And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.

cards.note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch saw the giving: the Elect One seated on the throne of glory, the spirit of righteousness poured out on him, the word of his mouth slaying the sinners. The power was given by the Father; the Son wields it.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.

cards.note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch's Son of Adam raises the kings and the mighty from their seats and breaks the teeth of the sinners. That is what all power looks like when it is used.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
cards.t_text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.

cards.note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch saw the placing — Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits setting the Elect One on the throne of glory to judge and to weigh deeds in the balance. The Father is the giver; the Son is seated; the power is the power to judge.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.

cards.note: thread:binding-of-the-watchers-typological-anchor-for-binding-the-strong-man | *No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.* The Markan parallel to Matthew 12:29's binding-of-the-strong-man — the same architecture, 1 Enoch 10's chaining of Azazel hand-and-foot and Jubilees 10's binding of nine-tenths of the malignant spirits underlying both gospel-witnesses. The King's ministry is the incursion that binds the strong-man so the captives can be released.
cards.s_text: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

cards.note: thread:the-watcher-rebellion-as-the-stumbling-block-architecture-in-1-enoch | *Where their worm dieth not, neither is their fire quenched* — Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 66:24 deployed against the Watcher-architecture.
cards.s_text: And if your hand offend you, cut it off: it is better for you to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
cards.t_text: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.

cards.note: thread:the-son-of-adam-came-to-give-his-life-a-ransom-for-many-in-1-enoch-testaments-and-sirach | *The Son of Adam came... to give his life a ransom for many.* The Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 53 Suffering Servant — *he shall see of the travail of his soul* (53:10-12). NOT collapsed into strict penal-substitution.
cards.s_text: For even the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
cards.t_text: Yet it pleased Yahuah (LORD) to bruise him; he has put him to grief: when you shall make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of Yahuah (LORD) shall prosper in his hand.

cards.note: thread:leaves-without-fruit-judged-in-wisdom-of-solomon-sirach-and-1-enoch | The cursed fig tree — the prophetic-acted-parable judging the credentialed-without-fruit covenant body. The Mark 11:20-21 morning return shows the result.
cards.s_text: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
cards.t_text: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

cards.note: thread:gather-all-the-tribes-of-jacob-in-sirach-and-enoch | The four-direction gathering parallel — *they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of Elohim.*
cards.s_text: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
cards.t_text: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of Elohim (God).

cards.note: thread:the-gathering-of-the-elect-from-the-four-winds-in-1-enochs-animal-apocalypse-and-parables | Tanakh witness to the four-winds gathering — *I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west.*
cards.s_text: For as the lightning comes out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.
cards.t_text: Fear not: for I am with you: I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west;

cards.note: thread:the-gathering-of-the-elect-from-the-four-winds-in-1-enochs-animal-apocalypse-and-parables | *I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country* — the east-west gathering with Yerushalayim as the destination.
cards.s_text: For as the lightning comes out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.
cards.t_text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;

cards.note: thread:the-gathering-of-the-elect-from-the-four-winds-in-1-enochs-animal-apocalypse-and-parables | *And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Yerushalayim (Jerusalem)* — completes the east-west gathering destination clause.
cards.s_text: For as the lightning comes out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.
cards.t_text: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God), in truth and in righteousness.

cards.note: thread:heavens-opened-at-the-priestly-investiture | Luke uniquely says *the heaven was opened* (rather than Matthew's *heavens were opened to him*) — the opening of heaven at the investiture is the same priestly-installation pattern 1 Enoch carries. The Son is installed in the priestly office by the Father's voice from the open heaven.
cards.s_text: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Yahusha (Jesus) also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
cards.t_text: And Yahusha (Jesus), when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of Elohim (God) descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

cards.note: thread:spirit-anointed-elect-one-the-spirit-of-wisdom-on-the-son-in-1-enoch | *The Spirit of Yahuah (the Lord) is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised, to preach the acceptable year of Yahuah (the Lord).* Luke 4:18-19 IS the Spirit-anointed-Elect-One-self-identification — the same 1 Enoch 49 / 62 register Matthew 12:18 carries, here read by the Son from the scroll at the Natsareth (Nazareth) synagogue and applied to himself in real time. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.
cards.s_text: The Spirit of Yahuah (Lord) is upon me, because he has anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
cards.t_text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

cards.note: thread:woes-on-the-rich-and-riches-cannot-save-in-1-enoch | *But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.* The Lukan Woes are the 1 Enoch 94-100 woes-on-the-rich register in the King's own mouth — the reversal-architecture Wisdom of Solomon 3 and 5 also carry. The woes are paired with the blessings so the reader hears both sides of the post-harvest sifting at once.
cards.s_text: But woe unto you that are rich! for you have received your consolation.
cards.t_text: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

cards.note: thread:the-son-of-adam-glorified-in-1-enoch-throne-vision-and-parables | *They saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.* The Lukan emphasis on the glory of the Transfiguration ties straight to the 1 Enoch 14 / 46 / 49 / 62 Son-of-Adam-in-glorified-form witness.
cards.s_text: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
cards.t_text: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

cards.note: thread:binding-of-the-watchers-typological-anchor-for-binding-the-strong-man | The Lukan Beelzebub-controversy and the divided-house argument — same architecture as Matthew 12 / Mark 3, with the *stronger-than-he* binding-the-strong-man substance the framework reads as the Watcher-binding architecture from 1 Enoch 10 / Jubilees 10.
cards.s_text: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
cards.t_text: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you.

cards.note: thread:names-in-the-books-of-life-not-blotted-out-in-1-enoch-103 | *Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of Adam also confess before the angels of Elohim (God): But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of Elohim (God).* The confess-or-deny architecture tied to the books-of-life.
cards.s_text: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of Adam also confess before the angels of Elohim (God):
cards.t_text: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.

cards.note: thread:family-division-in-the-day-of-destruction-in-1-enoch | *I am come to send fire on the earth... Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division.* Same family-division architecture as Matthew 10:34-36; the seed-war runs at the family-level.
cards.s_text: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
cards.t_text: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

cards.note: thread:the-blood-of-hevel-crying-and-the-mother-hen-gathering-in-1-enoch-and-2-esdras | The same mother-hen-gathering lament Yahusha (Jesus) speaks twice — at Luke 13:34 over Yerushalayim (Jerusalem), and at Matthew 23:37 in the temple discourse. The two registers carry the same substance: *how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!* (Dual-attach confirmed per Yoshi S185 #6: Lukan placement distinct from Matt 23:37-39 placement, intentional.)
cards.s_text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto you; how often would I have gathered your children together, as a hen does gather her brood under her wings, and you would not!
cards.t_text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto you, how often would I have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and you would not!

cards.note: thread:the-watcher-rebellion-as-the-stumbling-block-architecture-in-1-enoch | The Lukan stumblingblock-warning sits in the same Watcher-rebellion-as-stumbling-block architecture the Matthean parallel carries. The little-ones are the gathered-seed; the stumbling-architecture is the corruption-from-without-and-from-within.
cards.s_text: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
cards.t_text: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

cards.note: thread:the-gathering-of-the-elect-from-the-four-winds-in-1-enochs-animal-apocalypse-and-parables | *For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of Adam (son of man) be in his day* (Luke 17:24). The lightning-from-east-to-west visibility-of-the-coming substance.
cards.s_text: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of Adam be in his day.
cards.t_text: For as the lightning comes out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.

cards.note: thread:the-days-of-noach-and-the-watcher-rebellion-judgment-pattern-in-1-enoch-and-jubilees | *And as it was in the days of Noach (Noah), so shall it be also in the days of the Son of Adam (son of man)... Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot* (Luke 17:26, 28). The Lukan version of the Noach-comparison adds the Lot-comparison.
cards.s_text: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of Adam.
cards.t_text: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.

cards.note: thread:woes-on-the-rich-and-riches-cannot-save-in-1-enoch | The Lukan rich-young-ruler parallel to Matthew 19, where the woes-on-the-rich architecture from 1 Enoch 94-100 carries the same substance. *It is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).*
cards.s_text: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
cards.t_text: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

cards.note: thread:the-gathering-of-the-elect-from-the-four-winds-in-1-enochs-animal-apocalypse-and-parables | Luke carries the *Son of Adam coming in a cloud with power and great glory* (v.27) — kbar-enash cloud-rider architecture from Daniyel (Daniel) 7:13. Luke uniquely adds *And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh* (v.28).
cards.s_text: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
cards.t_text: For as the lightning comes out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.

cards.note: *And against the angels whom He had sent upon the earth, He was exceedingly wroth, and He gave commandment to root them out of all their dominion, and He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound in the midst of them, and are (kept) separate.* Jubilees 5:6 carries the same binding-of-the-watchers the Enochic library records — bound in the depths of the earth and kept separate. Mark 3:27's binding of the strong-man before his house can be spoiled walks the architecture Jubilees names: the rebel-administration is held under restraint, and the King's incursion is the spoiling that follows the binding.
cards.s_text: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: And against the angels whom He had sent upon the earth, He was exceedingly wroth, and He gave commandment to root them out of all their dominion, and He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound in the midst of them, and are (kept) separate.

cards.note: *And Yahuah (God) said unto Michael: "Go, bind Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women... bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation."* (1 Enoch 10:11-12.) The binding of Semjaza and the watchers in the valleys of the earth until the day of judgement is the same strong-man-bound architecture Mark 3:27 names. The spoiling of the strong-man's house — the casting-out of devils the chapter is contesting — presupposes the binding the Enochic library already recorded.
cards.s_text: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (Lord) said unto Michael: ‘Go, bind Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women so as to have defiled themselves with them in all their uncleanness.

cards.note: *And again Yahuah (God) said to Raphael: "Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein."* 1 Enoch 10:4-6 names the binding of Azazel hand-and-foot, cast into the desert-darkness, reserved *on the day of the great judgement* to be cast into the fire. Mark 3:27's *no man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house* walks the same binding-architecture: the King's ministry is the incursion that binds the strong-man so the captives can be released. The Enochic library supplies the typological anchor the gospel walks.
cards.s_text: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.

cards.note: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). 1 Enoch 19:1 names the watcher-spirits and their appointed standing-place of judgement. At Mark 3:11 the unclean spirits *fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of Elohim (God)* — the watcher-administration recognizing the Judge before whom it must one day stand, falling down before the Formed one whose great-judgement-day is named in the Enochic library.
cards.s_text: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, You are the Son of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.

cards.note: *Say to them therefore: “You have no peace.”’* (1 Enoch 16:4). *Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us?* (Mark 1:24). The spirits that cry out have been told their sentence: no peace. The Holy One's coming is the disturbance of a peace they were never granted.
cards.s_text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth? are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are, the Holy One of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: Say to them therefore: “You have no peace.”’

cards.note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). 1 Enoch 16:1 names the unclean spirit's origin and its appointed end: the spirits gone forth from the giants destroy until the day of the great judgement. The demon's own question at Mark 1:24 — *art thou come to destroy us?* — names that it knows its judgement-day is fixed; the watchers' offspring recognize that the Holy One of Elohim is the one who holds the day of their consummation.
cards.s_text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth? are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are, the Holy One of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."

cards.note: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:8). (1 Enoch 15:8-7 reads: *Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin... And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth.*) The unclean spirit that cries in the synagogue — *I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of Elohim (God)* — is one of these: an evil spirit gone forth from the slain giants' flesh, the watchers' offspring under restraint. It recognizes the Formed one before the watching crowd can name him because it was there at the rebellion. The recognition is not the sheep's hearing; the demons know and tremble, and the King silences them.
cards.s_text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth? are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are, the Holy One of Elohim (God).
