cards.note: Jeremiah 4:30 — *And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.* The ornaments of gold and the painting of the face that the Watcher taught in 1 Enoch 8:1 cannot save the spoiled city.
cards.s_text: And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.
cards.t_text: And when you are spoiled, what will you do? Though you clothest thyself with crimson, though you deckest you with ornaments of gold, though you rentest your face with painting, in vain shall you make thyself fair; your lovers will despise you, they will seek your life.

cards.note: 2 Kings 9:30 — *And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.* The painting of the face and the beautifying of the eyelids that Azâzêl taught in 1 Enoch 8:1 becomes the mark of the harlot-queen at the window.
cards.s_text: And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.
cards.t_text: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 16:7 — *He was not pacified toward the old giants, who fell away in the strength of their foolishness.* The judgment Enoch 9:11 longs for is the one Ben Sira recalls: the Most High unappeased toward the old giants.
cards.s_text: And Thou knowest all things before they come to pass, and Thou seest these things and Thou dost suffer them, and Thou dost not say to us what we are to do to them in regard to these.’
cards.t_text: He was not pacified toward the old giants, who fell away in the strength of their foolishness.

cards.note: Revelation 6:10 — *And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah (Lord), holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?* The unceasing lamentation of Enoch 9:10 is the same How long? cry of the slain pleading for the judgment of those who dwell on the earth.
cards.s_text: And now, behold, the souls of those who have died are crying and making their suit to the gates of heaven, and their lamentations have ascended: and cannot cease because of the lawless deeds which are wrought on the earth.
cards.t_text: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah (Lord), holy and true, do you not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

cards.note: Revelation 6:9 — *I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of Elohim (God), and for the testimony which they held.* The souls of the dead crying at the gates of heaven in Enoch 9:10 are John's souls under the altar awaiting the judgment.
cards.s_text: And now, behold, the souls of those who have died are crying and making their suit to the gates of heaven, and their lamentations have ascended: and cannot cease because of the lawless deeds which are wrought on the earth.
cards.t_text: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of Elohim (God), and for the testimony which they held:

cards.note: The Wisdom of Solomon 14:6 — *For in the old time also, when the proud giants perished, the hope of the world governed by your hand escaped in a weak vessel, and left to all ages a seed of generation.* Wisdom remembers the perishing of the very giants the women bore in Enoch 9:9, with Noah's vessel preserved.
cards.s_text: And the women have borne giants, and the whole earth has thereby been filled with blood and unrighteousness.
cards.t_text: For in the old time also, when the proud giants perished, the hope of the world governed by your hand escaped in a weak vessel, and left to all ages a seed of generation.

cards.note: Jasher 4:18 — *and Elohim saw the whole earth and it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its ways upon earth, all men and all animals.* Jasher records the same defiling of the earth Enoch 9:8 lays at the Watchers' charge.
cards.s_text: And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.
cards.t_text: And their judges and rulers went to the daughters of men and took their wives by force from their husbands according to their choice, and the sons of men in those days took from the cattle of the earth, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the air, and taught the mixture of animals of one species with the other, in order therewith to provoke Yahuah (the Lord); and Elohim saw the whole earth and it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its ways upon earth, all men and all animals.

cards.note: Jubilees 7:21 — *owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men, and took themselves wives of all which they chose: and they made the beginning of uncleanness.* Jubilees names the watchers' fornication of Enoch 9:8 as a chief cause of the Flood.
cards.s_text: And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.
cards.t_text: For owing to these three things came the flood upon the earth, namely, owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men, and took themselves wives of all which they chose: and they made the beginning of uncleanness.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:1 — *the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* Jubilees joins Enoch 9:8-9: the angels took wives and the women bore giants.
cards.s_text: And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* The Watchers going to the daughters of men in Enoch 9:8 is Genesis' sons of Elohim taking the daughters of men to wife.
cards.s_text: And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment.* Peter, like Enoch 9:6, holds the sinning Watchers in chains of darkness reserved unto judgment.
cards.s_text: Thou seest what Azâzêl hath done, who hath taught all unrighteousness on earth and revealed the eternal secrets which were (preserved) in heaven, which men were striving to learn:
cards.t_text: For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* Jude names the very fate of Shemyaza and his associates from Enoch 9:7: angels who left their estate, chained unto the great judgment.
cards.s_text: And Semjâzâ, to whom Thou hast given authority to bear rule over his associates.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: Genesis 6:4 — *There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.* Azazel and Shemyaza in Enoch 9:6-7 are the sons of Elohim whose descent Genesis records in a single dense verse.
cards.s_text: Thou seest what Azâzêl hath done, who hath taught all unrighteousness on earth and revealed the eternal secrets which were (preserved) in heaven, which men were striving to learn:
cards.t_text: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

cards.note: Psalm 11:4 — *Yahuah (LORD) is in his holy temple, the LORD’S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.* The throne of glory standing unto all generations in Enoch 9:4 is the heavenly throne whose eyes try the children of men.
cards.s_text: And they said to Yahuah (Lord) of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim (God) of gods, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) is in his holy temple, the LORD’S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

cards.note: Proverbs 15:11 — *Hell and destruction are before Yahuah (LORD): how much more then the hearts of the children of men?* The Most High who seest all things in Enoch 9:5 is the Yahuah before whom even hell and the hidden heart lie open.
cards.s_text: Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.
cards.t_text: Hell and destruction are before Yahuah (LORD): how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

cards.note: Hebrews 4:13 — *Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.* Enoch 9:5's all things naked and open in His sight, nothing hidden, is carried verbatim into the apostolic word.
cards.s_text: Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.
cards.t_text: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

cards.note: Jubilees 7:23 — *And every one sold himself to work iniquity and to shed much blood, and the earth was filled with iniquity.* Jubilees names the same flood-cause Enoch 9:2 mourns: much blood shed, the earth filled with iniquity.
cards.s_text: And they said one to another: ‘The earth made without inhabitant cries the voice of their cryings up to the gates of heaven.
cards.t_text: And every one sold himself to work iniquity and to shed much blood, and the earth was filled with iniquity.

cards.note: Genesis 4:10 — *And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.* The voice of crying that reaches the gates of heaven in Enoch 9:2 is the same shed blood that cries from the ground from Abel onward.
cards.s_text: And they said one to another: ‘The earth made without inhabitant cries the voice of their cryings up to the gates of heaven.
cards.t_text: And he said, What have you done? the voice of your brother’s blood cries unto me from the ground.

cards.note: Genesis 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* The blood and lawlessness wrought upon the earth in Enoch 9:1 is Genesis' earth filled with violence.
cards.s_text: And then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked down from heaven and saw much blood being shed upon the earth, and all lawlessness being wrought upon the earth.
cards.t_text: The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.

cards.note: Genesis 6:5 — *And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.* The lawlessness the watchers see filling the earth in Enoch 9:1 is the very wickedness Genesis names as the cause of the Flood.
cards.s_text: And then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked down from heaven and saw much blood being shed upon the earth, and all lawlessness being wrought upon the earth.
cards.t_text: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

cards.note: Genesis 6:7 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.* The deluge Uriel announces to Noah in 1 Enoch 10:2 is this same resolve of Yahuah to blot out all flesh.
cards.s_text: ’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

cards.note: Genesis 6:8 — *But Noah found grace in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD).* Enoch 10:3 names the reason Noah is told to escape — his seed is preserved through every generation, the elect remnant kept by grace.
cards.s_text: And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’
cards.t_text: But Noah found grace in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Genesis 7:3 — *Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.* The preserving of Noah's seed for all generations (1 Enoch 10:3) is the keeping-seed-alive of the ark.
cards.s_text: And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’
cards.t_text: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:5 — *But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).* Jubilees carries the same Flood-intercession as Enoch 10, sparing Noah alone out of the corrupted earth.
cards.s_text: And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’
cards.t_text: But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).

cards.note: Leviticus 16:10 — *But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.* The Day of Atonement scapegoat is sent into the same desert where Azazel is bound in 1 Enoch 10:4, the sin-bearer driven out alive.
cards.s_text: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.
cards.t_text: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

cards.note: Leviticus 16:22 — *And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.* As all sin is ascribed to Azazel and he is sealed in the wilderness (1 Enoch 10:8), so the scapegoat bears all iniquities into a land uninhabited.
cards.s_text: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’
cards.t_text: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* Jude states the very binding of the Watchers Enoch 10:4-6 describes — chained in darkness until the great-day judgement.
cards.s_text: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;* Peter, like Enoch 10:6, holds the sinning angels in chains reserved for the fire of the great judgement.
cards.s_text: And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.
cards.t_text: For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

cards.note: Isaiah 24:22 — *And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.* Isaiah's host of the high ones shut in the pit until visited matches Azazel covered with rocks and darkness till the day of judgement (1 Enoch 10:5).
cards.s_text: And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever, and cover his face that he may not see light.
cards.t_text: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

cards.note: Genesis 6:4 — *There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.* The children of the Watchers Gabriel is sent against (1 Enoch 10:9) are these giants born of the sons of Elohim and the daughters of men.
cards.s_text: And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.
cards.t_text: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

cards.note: Genesis 6:3 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.* The refusal that the giants should have length of days (1 Enoch 10:10) is the LORD shortening flesh's days against their hope to live five hundred years.
cards.s_text: And no request that they (i.e. their fathers) make of thee shall be granted unto their fathers on their behalf; for they hope to live an eternal life, and that each one of them will live five hundred years.’
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:9 — *And He sent His sword into their midst that each should slay his neighbour, and they began to slay each other till they all fell by the sword and were destroyed from the earth.* Jubilees tells the same command Gabriel carries in 1 Enoch 10:9 — the giants turned one against another and destroyed.
cards.s_text: And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.
cards.t_text: And He sent His sword into their midst that each should slay his neighbour, and they began to slay each other till they all fell by the sword and were destroyed from the earth.

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* Michael's binding of Semjaza for seventy generations till the day of judgement (1 Enoch 10:12) is the everlasting chains Jude says hold the fallen angels.
cards.s_text: And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;* The abyss of fire and prison that confines the Watchers in 1 Enoch 10:13 is Peter's hell of chained darkness reserved unto judgment.
cards.s_text: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.
cards.t_text: For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

cards.note: Revelation 20:3 — *And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.* The same shut-up-in-the-pit-and-sealed motif of 1 Enoch 10:13 governs the binding of the dragon in the abyss.
cards.s_text: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.
cards.t_text: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:10 — *And their fathers were witnesses (of their destruction), and after this they were bound in the depths of the earth for ever, until the day of the great condemnation when judgment is executed on all those who have corrupted their ways and their works before Yahuah (God).* Jubilees, like Enoch 10:12, binds the Watchers in the earth's depths until the great judgement, their sons slain before their eyes.
cards.s_text: And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated.
cards.t_text: And their fathers were witnesses (of their destruction), and after this they were bound in the depths of the earth for ever, until the day of the great condemnation when judgment is executed on all those who have corrupted their ways and their works before Yahuah (God).

cards.note: Matthew 12:43 — *When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.* The spirits of the reprobate Michael is sent to destroy (1 Enoch 10:15) are these unclean spirits Yahusha confronts, roaming the dry places without rest.
cards.s_text: And destroy all the spirits of the reprobate and the children of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind.
cards.t_text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seeking rest, and finds none.

cards.note: Matthew 12:45 — *Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.* The wronging of mankind by the Watchers' spirits (1 Enoch 10:15) continues in these wicked spirits that re-enter and ruin a man.
cards.s_text: And destroy all the spirits of the reprobate and the children of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind.
cards.t_text: Then goes he, and takes with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

cards.note: Jubilees 10:1 — *And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.* Jubilees names the spirits of 1 Enoch 10:15 as the unclean demons that lead astray and destroy mankind after the Flood.
cards.s_text: And destroy all the spirits of the reprobate and the children of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind.
cards.t_text: And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.

cards.note: Jubilees 10:3 — *Elohim (God) of the spirits of all flesh, who have shown mercy to me, And have saved me and my sons from the waters of the flood, And have not caused me to perish as You did the sons of perdition... Let Your grace be lift up upon my sons, And let not wicked spirits rule over them Lest they should destroy them from the earth.* Noah's prayer answers the wronging of mankind by the reprobate spirits (1 Enoch 10:15), begging that the wicked spirits not rule over the righteous.
cards.s_text: And destroy all the spirits of the reprobate and the children of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind.
cards.t_text: And he prayed before Yahuah (God) his Elohim (God), and said: Elohim (God) of the spirits of all flesh, who have shown mercy to me, And have saved me and my sons from the waters of the flood, And have not caused me to perish as You did the sons of perdition; For Your grace has been great towards me, And great has been Your mercy to my soul; Let Your grace be lift up upon my sons, And let not wicked spirits rule over them Lest they should destroy them from the earth.

cards.note: Isaiah 24:21 — *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.* The same day that lets the plant of righteousness appear (1 Enoch 10:16) is the day Yahuah punishes the high host above and the kings below.
cards.s_text: Destroy all wrong from the face of the earth and let every evil work come to an end: and let the plant of righteousness and truth appear: and it shall prove a blessing; the works of righteousness and truth shall be planted in truth and joy for evermore.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

cards.note: Isaiah 65:21 — *And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.* The vines yielding wine in abundance on the cleansed earth (1 Enoch 10:19) match the new-creation vineyards the elect plant and enjoy.
cards.s_text: And all desirable trees shall be planted on it, and they shall plant vines on it: and the vine which they plant thereon shall yield wine in abundance, and as for all the seed which is sown thereon each measure (of it) shall bear a thousand, and each measure of olives shall yield ten presses of oil.
cards.t_text: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

cards.note: Isaiah 65:22 — *They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.* The righteous completing their days in peace (1 Enoch 10:17) are Isaiah's elect, long-lived as a tree, enjoying their own labour.
cards.s_text: And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.
cards.t_text: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and my elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

cards.note: Amos 9:14 — *And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Yashar'el (Israel), and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.* The earth tilled in righteousness and planted with trees (1 Enoch 10:18) is the regathered house of Yashar'el restored to plant and reap in the land.
cards.s_text: And then shall the whole earth be tilled in righteousness, and shall all be planted with trees and be full of blessing.
cards.t_text: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Yashar'el (Israel), and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

cards.note: Revelation 20:2 — *And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,* The order of 1 Enoch 10 — the adversary bound, then evil ended and the plant of righteousness appearing (10:16) — is Revelation's binding of the dragon before the reign of the righteous.
cards.s_text: Destroy all wrong from the face of the earth and let every evil work come to an end: and let the plant of righteousness and truth appear: and it shall prove a blessing; the works of righteousness and truth shall be planted in truth and joy for evermore.
cards.t_text: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

cards.note: Isaiah 2:3 — *And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), to the house of the Elohim (God) of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Yahuah (LORD) from Jerusalem.* The nations' worship in 1 Enoch 10:21 is Isaiah's peoples coming to walk in His paths under the Torah that goes forth from Zion.
cards.s_text: And all the children of men shall become righteous, and all nations shall offer adoration and shall praise Me, and all shall worship Me.
cards.t_text: And many people shall go and say, Come you, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), to the house of the Elohim (God) of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Yahuah (LORD) from Jerusalem.

cards.note: Psalm 22:27 — *All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto Yahuah (LORD): and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.* The universal worship of 1 Enoch 10:21 is the Psalm's ends of the world turning and all the kindreds of the nations worshipping before Him.
cards.s_text: And all the children of men shall become righteous, and all nations shall offer adoration and shall praise Me, and all shall worship Me.
cards.t_text: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto Yahuah (LORD): and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before you.

cards.note: Zechariah 14:9 — *And Yahuah (LORD) shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Yahuah (LORD), and his name one.* When all nations worship Me in 1 Enoch 10:21, it is Zechariah's day when Yahuah is king over all the earth and His name is one.
cards.s_text: And all the children of men shall become righteous, and all nations shall offer adoration and shall praise Me, and all shall worship Me.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Yahuah (LORD), and his name one.

cards.note: Zephaniah 3:9 — *For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD), to serve him with one consent.* The all-nations adoration of 1 Enoch 10:21 is Zephaniah's purified peoples calling on the Name with one consent.
cards.s_text: And all the children of men shall become righteous, and all nations shall offer adoration and shall praise Me, and all shall worship Me.
cards.t_text: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD), to serve him with one consent.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:11 — *And He made for all His works a new and righteous nature, so that they should not sin in their whole nature for ever, but should be all righteous each in his kind alway.* The plant of righteousness and truth appearing in 1 Enoch 10:16 is Jubilees' new and righteous nature made for all His works after the flood-judgement.
cards.s_text: Destroy all wrong from the face of the earth and let every evil work come to an end: and let the plant of righteousness and truth appear: and it shall prove a blessing; the works of righteousness and truth shall be planted in truth and joy for evermore.
cards.t_text: And He destroyed all from their places, and there was not left one of them whom He judged not according to all their wickedness.

cards.note: Amos 9:13 — *Behold, the days come, saith Yahuah (LORD), that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.* The thousandfold seed and overflowing wine of 1 Enoch 10:19 is Amos' day of overtaking harvests and mountains dropping sweet wine.
cards.s_text: And all desirable trees shall be planted on it, and they shall plant vines on it: and the vine which they plant thereon shall yield wine in abundance, and as for all the seed which is sown thereon each measure (of it) shall bear a thousand, and each measure of olives shall yield ten presses of oil.
cards.t_text: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that sows seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 10:9 — *And to Gabriel said Yahuah (God): 'Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men.* Enoch's own earlier command to Gabriel is the twin of the order in 1 Enoch 10:15 to destroy the spirits of the reprobate and the children of the Watchers.
cards.s_text: And destroy all the spirits of the reprobate and the children of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind.
cards.t_text: And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.

cards.note: Jubilees 10:5 — *and as for these spirits which are living, imprison them and hold them fast in the place of condemnation, and let them not bring destruction on the sons of your servant, my Elohim (God); for these are malignant, and created in order to destroy.* Noah's prayer asks for exactly what 1 Enoch 10:15 commands — that the reprobate spirits and children of the Watchers be destroyed and bound away from mankind.
cards.s_text: And destroy all the spirits of the reprobate and the children of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind.
cards.t_text: And You know how Your Watchers, the fathers of these spirits, acted in my day: and as for these spirits which are living, imprison them and hold them fast in the place of condemnation, and let them not bring destruction on the sons of your servant, my Elohim (God); for these are malignant, and created in order to destroy.

cards.note: Revelation 20:2 — *And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years.* The chaining and sealed prison of the abyss in 1 Enoch 10:13 is the same binding John sees laid upon the dragon.
cards.s_text: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.
cards.t_text: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

cards.note: Isaiah 24:21 — *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.* Isaiah lifts the binding of the Watchers in Enoch 11:2 to the day of judgement, when the host of the high ones is finally visited.
cards.s_text: And truth and peace shall be associated together throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations of men.’
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:6 — *And against the angels whom He had sent upon the earth, He was exceedingly wroth, and He gave commandment to root them out of all their dominion, and He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound in the midst of them, and are (kept) separate.* Jubilees tells the same binding Michael is commanded to perform in Enoch 11:2, in the depths of the earth.
cards.s_text: And truth and peace shall be associated together throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations of men.’
cards.t_text: And against the angels whom He had sent upon the earth, He was exceedingly wroth, and He gave commandment to root them out of all their dominion, and He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound in the midst of them, and are (kept) separate.

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment.* Peter and Enoch 11:2 give the same verdict: the sinning angels are bound fast and reserved unto judgement.
cards.s_text: And truth and peace shall be associated together throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations of men.’
cards.t_text: For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* Jude carries forward the Watchers bound for judgement that Enoch 11:2 describes, chained until the day that is for ever and ever.
cards.s_text: And truth and peace shall be associated together throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations of men.’
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: Genesis 6:3 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.* The shortening of days and the coming flood-judgement of Enoch 11 is the same sentence Yahuah pronounces in Genesis 6.
cards.s_text: And in those days I will open the store chambers of blessing which are in the heaven, so as to send them down upon the earth over the work and labour of the children of men.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* This is the very defilement Michael is sent to punish in Enoch 11:1 — the Watchers who united themselves with women.
cards.s_text: And in those days I will open the store chambers of blessing which are in the heaven, so as to send them down upon the earth over the work and labour of the children of men.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:10 — *And their fathers were witnesses (of their destruction), and after this they were bound in the depths of the earth for ever, until the day of the great condemnation when judgment is executed on all those who have corrupted their ways and their works before Yahuah (God).* Jubilees confirms the supplication of 1 Enoch 12:6 wins no mercy — the binding holds until the great judgement.
cards.s_text: The murder of their beloved ones shall they see, and over the destruction of their children shall they lament, and shall make supplication unto eternity, but mercy and peace shall ye not attain.”’
cards.t_text: And their fathers were witnesses (of their destruction), and after this they were bound in the depths of the earth for ever, until the day of the great condemnation when judgment is executed on all those who have corrupted their ways and their works before Yahuah (God).

cards.note: 1 Enoch 10:12 — *And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated.* Yahuah's own decree spells out the murder of the beloved children the Watchers must watch in 1 Enoch 12:6.
cards.s_text: The murder of their beloved ones shall they see, and over the destruction of their children shall they lament, and shall make supplication unto eternity, but mercy and peace shall ye not attain.”’
cards.t_text: And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 13:1 — *And Enoch went and said: ’Azâzêl, thou shalt have no peace: a severe sentence has gone forth against thee to put thee in bonds.* Enoch carries the same 'no peace' sentence of 1 Enoch 12:5 to Azazel by name.

cards.t_text: And Enoch went and said: ‘Azâzêl, thou shalt have no peace: a severe sentence has gone forth against thee to put thee in bonds:

cards.note: Isaiah 57:20 — *But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.* The restless, unforgiven wicked of Isaiah picture the Watchers who attain no peace in 1 Enoch 12:5.
cards.s_text: “Ye have wrought great destruction on the earth: And ye shall have no peace nor forgiveness of sin: and inasmuch as they delight themselves in their children,
cards.t_text: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

cards.note: Isaiah 57:21 — *There is no peace, saith my Elohim (God), to the wicked.* Isaiah's verdict is the very 'no peace' Enoch pronounces over the Watchers in 1 Enoch 12:5.
cards.s_text: “Ye have wrought great destruction on the earth: And ye shall have no peace nor forgiveness of sin: and inasmuch as they delight themselves in their children,
cards.t_text: There is no peace, says my Elohim (God), to the wicked.

cards.note: the Wisdom of Solomon 14:6 — *For in the old time also, when the proud giants perished, the hope of the world governed by your hand escaped in a weak vessel, and left to all ages a seed of generation.* Wisdom ties the perishing of the giants of 1 Enoch 12:4 to the seed preserved in the ark.
cards.s_text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:
cards.t_text: For in the old time also, when the proud giants perished, the hope of the world governed by your hand escaped in a weak vessel, and left to all ages a seed of generation.

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 16:7 — *He was not pacified toward the old giants, who fell away in the strength of their foolishness.* Ben Sira remembers the giants and the destruction of 1 Enoch 12:4 as proof that Elohim does not relent toward the rebellious.
cards.s_text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:
cards.t_text: He was not pacified toward the old giants, who fell away in the strength of their foolishness.

cards.note: Genesis 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* The filled-with-violence earth is the very ruin Enoch names in 1 Enoch 12:4.
cards.s_text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:
cards.t_text: The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.

cards.note: Genesis 6:4 — *There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.* The giants are the great destruction Enoch lays at the Watchers' feet in 1 Enoch 12:4.
cards.s_text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:
cards.t_text: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:1 — *And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* Jubilees recounts the same descent and taking-of-wives that Enoch is sent to declare in 1 Enoch 12:4.
cards.s_text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:
cards.t_text: And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 15:3 — *Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons?* Yahuah Himself repeats Enoch's indictment of 1 Enoch 12:4 when the Watchers' petition is refused.
cards.s_text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:
cards.t_text: Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons?

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment.* Peter likewise grounds his warning in the angels that sinned, the Watchers of 1 Enoch 12:4.
cards.s_text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:
cards.t_text: For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* Jude reads the Watchers' leaving the high heaven (1 Enoch 12:4) as settled apostolic doctrine.
cards.s_text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* This is the very descent and taking-of-wives that Enoch is sent to confront in 1 Enoch 12:4.
cards.s_text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:5 — *By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim (God).* The New Testament names the translation that put Enoch's days among the holy ones (1 Enoch 12:2).
cards.s_text: And his activities had to do with the Watchers, and his days were with the holy ones.
cards.t_text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 5:24 — *And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him.* Torah's terse note that Enoch was taken is exactly the hiddenness 1 Enoch 12:1 describes — no man knew where he abode.
cards.s_text: Before these things Enoch was hidden, and no one of the children of men knew where he was hidden, and where he abode, and what had become of him.
cards.t_text: And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him.

cards.note: Leviticus 16:22 — *And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.* The Torah's scapegoat — the same Azazel bound in the desert (1 Enoch 10) — showing iniquity is carried off by the Creator's appointed judgement, not by the forbearance the Watchers beg for in 13:4.
cards.s_text: And they besought me to draw up a petition for them that they might find forgiveness, and to read their petition in the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of heaven.
cards.t_text: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:10 — *And their fathers were witnesses (of their destruction), and after this they were bound in the depths of the earth for ever, until the day of the great condemnation when judgment is executed on all those who have corrupted their ways and their works before Yahuah (God).* Why the petition Enoch reads before God in 13:10 fails — the Watcher-fathers are bound, not forgiven.
cards.s_text: And I recounted before them all the visions which I had seen in sleep, and I began to speak the words of righteousness, and to reprimand the heavenly Watchers.
cards.t_text: And their fathers were witnesses (of their destruction), and after this they were bound in the depths of the earth for ever, until the day of the great condemnation when judgment is executed on all those who have corrupted their ways and their works before Yahuah (God).

cards.note: 1 Enoch 14:1 — *The book of the words of righteousness, and of the reprimand of the eternal Watchers in accordance with the command of the Holy Great One in that vision.* The heading of the very document Enoch writes out and reads before Elohim (God) in 13:6 and 13:10 — a book of reprimand, not of pardon.
cards.s_text: Then I wrote out their petition, and the prayer in regard to their spirits and their deeds individually and in regard to their requests that they should have forgiveness and length.
cards.t_text: The book of the words of righteousness, and of the reprimand of the eternal Watchers in accordance with the command of the Holy Great One in that vision.

cards.note: Genesis 6:3 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.* The Creator's limit on rebellious flesh — the chastisement the night vision of 13:8 confirms against the Watchers and their works.
cards.s_text: And behold a dream came to me, and visions fell down upon me, and I saw visions of chastisement, and a voice came bidding (me) I to tell it to the sons of heaven, and reprimand them.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

cards.note: Job 33:15 — *In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;* — the very scene of 13:7, Enoch falling asleep over the petition and a dream of chastisement falling upon him.
cards.s_text: And I went off and sat down at the waters of Dan, in the land of Dan, to the south of the west of Hermon: I read their petition till I fell asleep.
cards.t_text: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

cards.note: Numbers 12:6 — *And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I Yahuah (LORD) will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.* The Torah's own rule for prophetic revelation — exactly the vision-and-voice by which Enoch is commissioned to reprimand the sons of heaven in 13:8.
cards.s_text: And behold a dream came to me, and visions fell down upon me, and I saw visions of chastisement, and a voice came bidding (me) I to tell it to the sons of heaven, and reprimand them.
cards.t_text: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I Yahuah (LORD) will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 10:8 — *And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.* Enoch's own indictment naming Azazel as the source of the unrighteousness he is sentenced for in 13:2.
cards.s_text: And thou shalt not have toleration nor request granted to thee, because of the unrighteousness which thou hast taught, and because of all the works of godlessness and unrighteousness and sin which thou hast shown to men.’
cards.t_text: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’

cards.note: Jubilees 5:2 — *And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth-all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.* Jubilees describes the spreading corruption that 13:2 charges to the unrighteousness Azazel taught.
cards.s_text: And thou shalt not have toleration nor request granted to thee, because of the unrighteousness which thou hast taught, and because of all the works of godlessness and unrighteousness and sin which thou hast shown to men.’
cards.t_text: And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth-all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.

cards.note: Genesis 6:5 — *And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.* The whole-earth corruption that flowed from the works Azazel taught men in 13:2.
cards.s_text: And thou shalt not have toleration nor request granted to thee, because of the unrighteousness which thou hast taught, and because of all the works of godlessness and unrighteousness and sin which thou hast shown to men.’
cards.t_text: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

cards.note: Genesis 6:4 — *There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.* The Watchers' descent that bred the giants — the very rebellion whose teaching of unrighteousness Enoch arraigns Azazel for in 13:2.
cards.s_text: And thou shalt not have toleration nor request granted to thee, because of the unrighteousness which thou hast taught, and because of all the works of godlessness and unrighteousness and sin which thou hast shown to men.’
cards.t_text: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment.* Peter echoes Enoch 13:4 — angels reserved unto judgement, their requested forgiveness withheld.
cards.s_text: And they besought me to draw up a petition for them that they might find forgiveness, and to read their petition in the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of heaven.
cards.t_text: For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* Jude states the verdict Enoch records in 13:4 — the Watchers' petition for forgiveness cannot reverse a reservation in chains unto the judgement.
cards.s_text: And they besought me to draw up a petition for them that they might find forgiveness, and to read their petition in the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of heaven.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: Isaiah 24:22 — *And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.* The host on high held in prison until the appointed visitation — the same reserved sentence that leaves the Watchers in 13:5 unable to lift their eyes to heaven.
cards.s_text: For from thenceforward they could not speak (with Him) nor lift up their eyes to heaven for shame of their sins for which they had been condemned.
cards.t_text: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 10:10 — *And no request that they (i.e. their fathers) make of thee shall be granted unto their fathers on their behalf; for they hope to live an eternal life, and that each one of them will live five hundred years.* The decree that explains why no request is granted to Azazel in 13:2 — the refusal was settled before Enoch ever drafted the petition.
cards.s_text: And thou shalt not have toleration nor request granted to thee, because of the unrighteousness which thou hast taught, and because of all the works of godlessness and unrighteousness and sin which thou hast shown to men.’
cards.t_text: And no request that they (i.e. their fathers) make of thee shall be granted unto their fathers on their behalf; for they hope to live an eternal life, and that each one of them will live five hundred years.’

cards.note: Jubilees 5:16 — *He is not one who will regard the person (of any), nor is He one who will receive gifts, if He says that He will execute judgment on each* — why no toleration nor request can be granted to Azazel in 13:2: the Judge accepts no bribe to overturn the sentence.
cards.s_text: And thou shalt not have toleration nor request granted to thee, because of the unrighteousness which thou hast taught, and because of all the works of godlessness and unrighteousness and sin which thou hast shown to men.’
cards.t_text: And He is not one who will regard the person (of any), nor is He one who will receive gifts, if He says that He will execute judgment on each: if one gave everything that is on the earth, He will not regard the gifts or the person (of any), nor accept anything at his hands, for He is a righteous judge.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 12:5 — *And ye shall have no peace nor forgiveness of sin: and inasmuch as they delight themselves in their children,* — the verdict over all the Watchers that 13:1 now lays specifically on their chief, Azazel.
cards.s_text: And Enoch went and said: ‘Azâzêl, thou shalt have no peace: a severe sentence has gone forth against thee to put thee in bonds:
cards.t_text: “Ye have wrought great destruction on the earth: And ye shall have no peace nor forgiveness of sin: and inasmuch as they delight themselves in their children,

cards.note: Isaiah 57:21 — *There is no peace, saith my Elohim (God), to the wicked.* The prophet repeats word-for-word the sentence already gone forth against Azazel in 13:1.
cards.s_text: And Enoch went and said: ‘Azâzêl, thou shalt have no peace: a severe sentence has gone forth against thee to put thee in bonds:
cards.t_text: There is no peace, says my Elohim (God), to the wicked.

cards.note: Isaiah 48:22 — *There is no peace, saith Yahuah (LORD), unto the wicked.* The same standing verdict Enoch pronounces on Azazel in 13:1 — no peace for the one who broke the Creator's order.
cards.s_text: And Enoch went and said: ‘Azâzêl, thou shalt have no peace: a severe sentence has gone forth against thee to put thee in bonds:
cards.t_text: There is no peace, says Yahuah (LORD), unto the wicked.

cards.note: Genesis 1:16 — *And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.* The stars the Creator made to rule their courses are the very stars that transgressed His commandment in the beginning of their rising in 14:20.
cards.s_text: And the Great Glory sat thereon, and His raiment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

cards.note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years.* The lights were set under a commandment to keep their appointed seasons; Enoch's stars 'transgressed the commandment' by not coming forth at their appointed times (14:20).
cards.s_text: And the Great Glory sat thereon, and His raiment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment.* Peter's angels in chains of darkness reserved unto judgment are Enoch's stars bound till their guilt is consummated in 14:21 — the canon's own witness to the bound Watchers of Genesis 6.
cards.s_text: None of the angels could enter and could behold His face by reason of the magnificence and glory and no flesh could behold Him.
cards.t_text: For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* Jude names the prisoners as the rebel angels reserved in chains until the judgment — the same binding 'till the time when their guilt should be consummated' Enoch records in 14:21.
cards.s_text: None of the angels could enter and could behold His face by reason of the magnificence and glory and no flesh could behold Him.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: Jude 1:13 — *Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.* Jude's 'wandering stars' reserved in darkness are Enoch's transgressing stars shut up in the prison at the end of heaven and earth in 14:19-21.
cards.s_text: And from underneath the throne came streams of flaming fire so that I could not look thereon.
cards.t_text: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.

cards.note: Isaiah 24:22 — *And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.* The shutting-up in prison until a later visitation is exactly Enoch's binding of the stars 'till the time when their guilt should be consummated' in 14:21.
cards.s_text: None of the angels could enter and could behold His face by reason of the magnificence and glory and no flesh could behold Him.
cards.t_text: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

cards.note: Isaiah 24:21 — *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.* Isaiah's 'host of the high ones' is the very 'host of heaven' Enoch sees imprisoned at the end of heaven and earth in 14:19.
cards.s_text: And from underneath the throne came streams of flaming fire so that I could not look thereon.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

cards.note: Jeremiah 4:25 — *I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.* The fled birds match Enoch's place where 'there was no water upon it, and no birds' (14:18) — the desolation that mirrors the place of imprisonment.
cards.s_text: And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.
cards.t_text: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.

cards.note: Jeremiah 4:23 — *I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.* Jeremiah sees creation rolled back to formlessness under judgement — the same waste place with no firmament above that Enoch is shown in 14:18.
cards.s_text: And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.
cards.t_text: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.

cards.note: Genesis 1:2 — *And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of Elohim (God) moved upon the face of the waters.* The 'waste and horrible place' with no firmament and no founded earth is the tohu-and-bohu of creation's first verse — the un-ordered ground that lies outside the Creator's order in 14:18.
cards.s_text: And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.
cards.t_text: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of Elohim (God) moved upon the face of the waters.

cards.note: Revelation 4:2 — *And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.* John is carried up in the spirit to the same enthroned glory Enoch is carried up to see in 14:15, the one throne that stands from his vision to John's.
cards.s_text: And I beheld a vision, And lo! there was a second house, greater than the former, and the entire portal stood open before me, and it was built of flames of fire.
cards.t_text: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.

cards.note: Daniel 7:10 — *A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.* The fiery stream from the Head of Days' throne is the same river of heavenly fire Enoch beholds beyond the throne in 14:16-17.
cards.s_text: And in every respect it so excelled in splendour and magnificence and extent that I cannot describe to you its splendour and its extent.
cards.t_text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

cards.note: Daniel 7:9 — *I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.* The throne of fiery flame is the flaming fire Enoch sees blazing before the throne of Yahuah in 14:16.
cards.s_text: And in every respect it so excelled in splendour and magnificence and extent that I cannot describe to you its splendour and its extent.
cards.t_text: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.

cards.note: Ezekiel 1:26 — *And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.* Ezekiel sees the same sapphire throne reaching above the firmament that Enoch sees at the summit of the middle mountain in 14:15.
cards.s_text: And I beheld a vision, And lo! there was a second house, greater than the former, and the entire portal stood open before me, and it was built of flames of fire.
cards.t_text: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 16:4 — *Say to them therefore: “You have no peace.”* The next chapter seals the verdict Enoch 15:9-11 announces: the Watchers and their destroying spirits are granted no peace, only the consummation.
cards.s_text: Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.
cards.t_text: Say to them therefore: “You have no peace.”’

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* Jude's 'judgment of the great day' is Enoch 15:11's 'great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless.'
cards.s_text: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: Genesis 6:3 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.* The mortality decreed on flesh in Genesis 6:3 is the very death Enoch 15:4-11 traces — the giants 'die and perish,' and their spirits are loosed until the great judgement.
cards.s_text: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 14:6 — *For in the old time also, when the proud giants perished, the hope of the world governed by your hand escaped in a weak vessel, and left to all ages a seed of generation.* Wisdom remembers the proud giants of Enoch 15:6 perishing in the Flood while righteous seed was preserved in the ark.
cards.s_text: But you were formerly spiritual, living the eternal life, and immortal for all generations of the world.
cards.t_text: For in the old time also, when the proud giants perished, the hope of the world governed by your hand escaped in a weak vessel, and left to all ages a seed of generation.

cards.note: Jubilees 10:1 — *And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.* Jubilees shows the spirits of Enoch 15:7 already at work after the Flood — the surviving giant-spirits leading astray and destroying mankind.
cards.s_text: And therefore I have not appointed wives for you; for as for the spiritual ones of the heaven, in heaven is their dwelling.
cards.t_text: And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.

cards.note: Matthew 12:43 — *When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.* The restless, earth-bound spirit Yahusha (Jesus) describes is exactly Enoch 15:6's giant-spirit whose dwelling is on the earth, seeking a body and finding no true home.
cards.s_text: But you were formerly spiritual, living the eternal life, and immortal for all generations of the world.
cards.t_text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seeking rest, and finds none.

cards.note: Jubilees 7:21 — *owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men, and took themselves wives of all which they chose: and they made the beginning of uncleanness.* Noah names the sin Enoch 15:4 condemns — Watchers transgressing 'the law of their ordinances,' rebellion against the Creator's appointed order, not law made curse.
cards.s_text: And though ye were holy, spiritual, living the eternal life, you have defiled yourselves with the blood of women, and have begotten (children) with the blood of flesh, and, as the children of men, have lusted after flesh and blood as those also do who die and perish.
cards.t_text: For owing to these three things came the flood upon the earth, namely, owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men, and took themselves wives of all which they chose: and they made the beginning of uncleanness.
