cards.note: Job 38:6 — *Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;* Job's question about what the foundations are fastened upon answers to Enoch's vision of the winds that are the pillars of heaven.
cards.s_text: And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven, and have their station between heaven and earth: these are the pillars of the heaven.
cards.t_text: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;

cards.note: Job 38:4 — *Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.* The foundations laid before man existed are the pillars and supports Enoch is shown holding up heaven and earth.
cards.s_text: And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven, and have their station between heaven and earth: these are the pillars of the heaven.
cards.t_text: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if you have understanding.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 2:1 — *Observe ye everything that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, and the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order.* Enoch's own opening summons echoes 43:3 — the luminaries keep their appointed order and never transgress it.
cards.s_text: And I asked the angel who went with me who showed me what was hidden: ‘What are these?’
cards.t_text: Observe ye everything that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, and the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order.

cards.note: Jeremiah 33:25 — *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD); If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;* The covenant fixedness of day, night, and the heavenly ordinances is the same unswerving order in which Enoch's lights return to their place.
cards.s_text: And I asked the angel who went with me who showed me what was hidden: ‘What are these?’
cards.t_text: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

cards.note: Jeremiah 31:35 — *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD), which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name:* The unbreakable ordinances Jeremiah names are the prescribed law Enoch sees the lights never transgress.
cards.s_text: And I asked the angel who went with me who showed me what was hidden: ‘What are these?’
cards.t_text: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), which gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divides the sea when the waves thereof roar; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name:

cards.note: Job 38:33 — *Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?* The unknowable ordinances of heaven Job is rebuked for not knowing are precisely the measured revolutions Enoch was shown.
cards.s_text: And I saw how they are weighed in a righteous balance according to their proportions of light: (I saw) the width of their spaces and the day of their appearing, and how their revolution produces lightning: and (I saw) their revolution according to the number of the angels, and (how) they keep faith with each other.
cards.t_text: Know you the ordinances of heaven? can you set the dominion thereof in the earth?

cards.note: Job 38:31 — *Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?* The God who can bind and loose the constellations is the One Enoch sees weighing each star in the balance according to its light.
cards.s_text: And I saw how they are weighed in a righteous balance according to their proportions of light: (I saw) the width of their spaces and the day of their appearing, and how their revolution produces lightning: and (I saw) their revolution according to the number of the angels, and (how) they keep faith with each other.
cards.t_text: Can you bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 11:20 — *Yea, and without these might they have fallen down with one blast, being persecuted of vengeance, and scattered abroad through the breath of your power: but you have ordered all things in measure and number and weight.* The same triad of measure, number, and weight that Enoch sees in the weighed stars is named as the Creator's ordering of all things.
cards.s_text: And I saw how they are weighed in a righteous balance according to their proportions of light: (I saw) the width of their spaces and the day of their appearing, and how their revolution produces lightning: and (I saw) their revolution according to the number of the angels, and (how) they keep faith with each other.
cards.t_text: Yea, and without these might they have fallen down with one blast, being persecuted of vengeance, and scattered abroad through the breath of your power: but you have ordered all things in measure and number and weight.

cards.note: Baruch 3:34 — *The stars shined in their watches, and rejoiced: when he calls them, they say, Here we be; and so with cheerfulness they shewed light to him that made them.* Baruch supplies the stars' answer to Enoch's roll-call — they hearken and report present to the One who named them.
cards.s_text: And I saw other lightnings and the stars of heaven, and I saw how He called them all by their names and they hearkened unto Him.
cards.t_text: The stars shined in their watches, and rejoiced: when he calls them, they say, Here we be; and so with cheerfulness they shewed light to him that made them.

cards.note: Isaiah 40:26 — *Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.* Isaiah's calling-by-name of the host that never fails is the same obedient hearkening Enoch watched the stars give Him.
cards.s_text: And I saw other lightnings and the stars of heaven, and I saw how He called them all by their names and they hearkened unto Him.
cards.t_text: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who has created these things, that brings out their host by number: he calls them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one fails.

cards.note: Psalm 147:4 — *He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.* The Psalmist gives in one verse exactly what Enoch saw in vision: every star numbered and personally named by its Maker.
cards.s_text: And I saw other lightnings and the stars of heaven, and I saw how He called them all by their names and they hearkened unto Him.
cards.t_text: He telleth the number of the stars; he calls them all by their names.

cards.note: Genesis 1:18 — *And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and Elohim (God) saw that it was good* — the luminaries themselves are the agents of the division Enoch names in 44:5, light to the righteous and darkness to the sinners.
cards.s_text: For the sun changes oft for a blessing or a curse, And the course of the path of the moon is light to the righteous And darkness to the sinners in the name of Yahuah (Lord), Who made a separation between the light and the darkness, And divided the spirits of men, And strengthened the spirits of the righteous, In the name of His righteousness.
cards.t_text: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and Elohim (God) saw that it was good.

cards.note: Genesis 1:4 — *And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness* — the first division of creation is the pattern Enoch extends in 44:5 to the dividing of the spirits of men.
cards.s_text: For the sun changes oft for a blessing or a curse, And the course of the path of the moon is light to the righteous And darkness to the sinners in the name of Yahuah (Lord), Who made a separation between the light and the darkness, And divided the spirits of men, And strengthened the spirits of the righteous, In the name of His righteousness.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness.

cards.note: Jubilees 2:9 — *And Elohim (God) appointed the sun to be a great sign on the earth for days and for sabbaths and for months and for feasts and for years and for sabbaths of years and for jubilees and for all seasons of the years* — the monthly revolution of 44:4 is the very clockwork by which the moedim are appointed.
cards.s_text: And after that I saw the hidden and the visible path of the moon, and she accomplishes the course of her path in that place by day and by night—the one holding a position opposite to the other before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. And they give thanks and praise and rest not; For unto them is their thanksgiving rest.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) appointed the sun to be a great sign on the earth for days and for sabbaths and for months and for feasts and for years and for sabbaths of years and for jubilees and for all seasons of the years.

cards.note: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork* — the lights that praise and rest not before Yahuah of Spirits in 44:4 are the same unceasing witness the Psalm hears in the firmament.
cards.s_text: And after that I saw the hidden and the visible path of the moon, and she accomplishes the course of her path in that place by day and by night—the one holding a position opposite to the other before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. And they give thanks and praise and rest not; For unto them is their thanksgiving rest.
cards.t_text: The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament shows his handywork.

cards.note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years* — the lights were appointed as a fixed reckoning from creation, the orbit Enoch sees them never leaving in 44:3.
cards.s_text: And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

cards.note: Jeremiah 33:25 — *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD); If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth* — the sworn ordinance that holds day and night in place is the same oath by which Enoch's lights set and rise in 44:3.
cards.s_text: And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.
cards.t_text: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

cards.note: 1 Enoch 72:1 — *The book of the courses of the luminaries of the heaven, the relations of each, according to their classes, their dominion and their seasons, according to their names and places of origin, and according to their months, which Uriel, the holy angel, who was with me, who is their guide, showed me; and he showed me all their laws exactly as they are, and how it is with regard to all the years of the world and unto eternity, till the new creation is accomplished which dureth till eternity.* — the Luminaries book unfolds in detail the chambers Enoch only glimpses in 44:1.
cards.s_text: Also another phenomenon I saw in regard to the lightnings: how some of the stars arise and become lightnings and cannot part with their new form.
cards.t_text: The book of the courses of the luminaries of the heaven, the relations of each, according to their classes, their dominion and their seasons, according to their names and places of origin, and according to their months, which Uriel, the holy angel, who was with me, who is their guide, showed me; and he showed me all their laws exactly as they are, and how it is with regard to all the years of the world and unto eternity, till the new creation is accomplished which dureth till eternity.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 41:5 — *And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit* — this edition's near-twin of 44, marking the closed chambers of 44:2 as a recurring vision of the same fixed order.
cards.s_text: And there I saw closed chambers out of which the winds are divided, the chamber of the hail and winds, the chamber of the mist, and of the clouds, and the cloud thereof hovers over the earth from the beginning of the world.
cards.t_text: And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.

cards.note: Job 38:35 — *Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?* Yahuah's challenge to Job names the same secret of lightning and thunder Enoch is shown in the storehouses of 44:1.
cards.s_text: Also another phenomenon I saw in regard to the lightnings: how some of the stars arise and become lightnings and cannot part with their new form.
cards.t_text: Can you send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto you, Here we are?

cards.note: Matthew 25:31 — *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:* Yahusha takes up Enoch's exact image — the Son of Adam seated on the throne of glory to judge — which 1 Enoch 45:3 sets at the head of the Second Parable.
cards.s_text: On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall try their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable. And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones, And those who have called upon My glorious name:
cards.t_text: When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

cards.note: Matthew 19:28 — *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* The throne of glory that tries works in 1 Enoch 45:3 is the same seat from which the Son of Adam judges the regathered twelve tribes.
cards.s_text: On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall try their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable. And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones, And those who have called upon My glorious name:
cards.t_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That you which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* Daniel sees one *like* the Son of Adam (the kaph; he resembles mortal-man because he took flesh) while 1 Enoch 45:3 names that same enthroned Elect One — both land on Yahusha.
cards.s_text: On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall try their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable. And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones, And those who have called upon My glorious name:
cards.t_text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 61:8 — *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* The Father places the Elect One on the throne of glory to judge and weigh deeds — the same throne-of-glory judgement 45:3 announces.
cards.s_text: On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall try their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable. And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones, And those who have called upon My glorious name:
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 51:3 — *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* The Father's own throne is given to the Formed Son — Enoch 45:3's Elect One enthroned to try works, glorified by the Head of Days.
cards.s_text: On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall try their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable. And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones, And those who have called upon My glorious name:
cards.t_text: And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.

cards.note: Isaiah 65:17 — *For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.* The Father's promise to create new heavens and a new earth is the very change Enoch 45:4 records Him speaking over the day of the Elect One.
cards.s_text: Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:
cards.t_text: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

cards.note: Isaiah 66:22 — *For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith Yahuah (LORD), so shall your seed and your name remain.* The enduring new heavens and earth guarantee the elect's enduring name — the dwelling Enoch 45:4 prepares for the Elect One among His people.
cards.s_text: Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:
cards.t_text: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, says Yahuah (LORD), so shall your seed and your name remain.

cards.note: Revelation 21:3 — *And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).* John sees consummated what Enoch 45:4 foretells: the Elect One caused to dwell among His people on the renewed earth.
cards.s_text: Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:
cards.t_text: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).

cards.note: Revelation 21:1 — *And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.* The passing of the first heaven and earth is the very changing of heaven and earth Yahuah (God) of Spirits declares in 1 Enoch 45:4.
cards.s_text: Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:
cards.t_text: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.

cards.note: Jubilees 1:29 — *...from the day of the new creation when the heavens and the earth shall be renewed and all their creation according to the powers of the heaven, and according to all the creation of the earth, until the sanctuary of Yahuah (God) shall be made in Jerusalem on Mount Zion, and all the luminaries be renewed for healing and for peace and for blessing for all the elect of Yashar'el (Israel)...* Jubilees ties the renewed heaven and earth to the elect of Israel — the same renewal Enoch 45:4 makes for the elect to dwell.
cards.s_text: Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:
cards.t_text: And the angel of the presence who went before the camp of Yashar’el (Israel) took the tables of the divisions of the years –from the time of the creation–of the law and of the testimony of the weeks, of the jubilees, according to the individual years, according to all the number of the jubilees according to the individual years, from the day of the new creation when the heavens and the earth shall be renewed and all their creation according to the powers of the heaven, and according to all the creation of the earth, until the sanctuary of Yahuah (God) shall be made in Jerusalem on Mount Zion, and all the luminaries be renewed for healing and for peace and for blessing for all the elect of Yashar’el (Israel), and that thus it may be from that day and to all the days of the earth.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 48:6 — *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* The Son chosen and hidden before the creation of the world is the One who chooses the righteous in 1 Enoch 51:2 — the Lamb foreknown before the foundation of the world.
cards.s_text: And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.
cards.t_text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.

cards.note: Isaiah 42:1 — *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.* The Father's own "mine elect" Servant is the Elect One of Enoch who chooses the righteous in 45:12 to bring forth judgement.
cards.s_text: And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.
cards.t_text: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; my elect, in whom my soul delights; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

cards.note: Matthew 13:42 — *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* Yahusha's furnace of fire for the wicked is the very furnace into which Enoch 45:6 casts the sinners.
cards.s_text: For I have provided and satisfied with peace My righteous ones And have caused them to dwell before Me: But for the sinners there is judgement impending with Me, So that I shall destroy them from the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

cards.note: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* The righteous shining as the sun matches Enoch 45:9, the bright counterpart to the sinners-as-straw of 45:5-6.
cards.s_text: For I have provided and satisfied with peace My righteous ones And have caused them to dwell before Me: But for the sinners there is judgement impending with Me, So that I shall destroy them from the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who has ears to hear, let him hear.

cards.note: Malachi 4:1 — *For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.* The wicked as stubble in the burning day is Enoch 45:5's sinners as straw in the unquenchable fire.
cards.s_text: And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.
cards.t_text: For, behold, the day comes, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that comes shall burn them up, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.* The righteous flaming over the stubble is the bright reverse of Enoch 45:5, where the sinners themselves become the straw that burns.
cards.s_text: And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.
cards.t_text: And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.

cards.note: John 5:28 — *Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,* The hour when the graves hear the Son's voice is 1 Enoch 51:1's day when the earth gives back what was entrusted to it.
cards.s_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.
cards.t_text: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

cards.note: 2 Esdras 7:32 — *And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.* The earth restoring its sleepers is 1 Enoch 51:1's earth and Sheol giving back what was entrusted to them.
cards.s_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.
cards.t_text: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.

cards.note: Revelation 6:15 — *And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;* The strong whose pride He abases and whose countenance He covers with shame (46:6) are these kings fleeing to the rocks before the wrath of the throne.
cards.s_text: And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame. And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;

cards.note: John 5:27 — *And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam.* Yahusha holds judgment authority precisely as the Son of Adam — the very title and office Enoch saw raising up and putting down the kings (46:4).
cards.s_text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.
cards.t_text: And has given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:4 — *But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.* The Spirit-anointed Branch who smites the earth and slays the wicked is the Son of Adam who lays low the inhabitants and breaks the sinners' teeth (46:4).
cards.s_text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.
cards.t_text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

cards.note: Psalm 2:9 — *Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.* The Anointed who breaks the rebellious is Enoch's Son of Adam who breaks the teeth of the sinners and puts down the strong (46:4).
cards.s_text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.
cards.t_text: You shall break them with a rod of iron; you shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

cards.note: Psalm 2:2 — *The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahuah (LORD), and against his anointed, saying,* The kings who will not extol the Son of Adam (46:5) are the conspiring rulers of Psalm 2 ranged against Yahuah's Anointed.
cards.s_text: [And he shall put down the kings from their thrones and kingdoms] Because they do not extol and praise Him, Nor humbly acknowledge whence the kingdom was bestowed upon them.
cards.t_text: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahuah (LORD), and against his anointed, saying,

cards.note: 1 Enoch 71:14 — *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* Parables restates 46:3 — the same Son of Adam over whom righteousness abides, never forsaken by the Head of Days.
cards.s_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
cards.t_text: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’

cards.note: 1 Enoch 48:2 — *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* The choosing of 46:3 reaches back to a naming before the Head of Days — the Formed Son named before He is confessed.
cards.s_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
cards.t_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.note: Isaiah 53:11 — *He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.* The righteous servant in whom righteousness dwells (46:3) is the same One who justifies many by bearing their iniquities.
cards.s_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
cards.t_text: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.

cards.note: Isaiah 42:1 — *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.* The Father's chosen, Spirit-rested elect servant is Enoch's Son of Adam whom Yahuah of Spirits hath chosen (46:3) — election before confession.
cards.s_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
cards.t_text: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; my elect, in whom my soul delights; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

cards.note: Matthew 26:64 — *Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* Yahusha claims under oath the title Enoch named (46:2) — the Son of Adam beside the Head of Days, coming in the clouds as Daniel foresaw.
cards.s_text: And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?
cards.t_text: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, You have said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall you see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

cards.note: Revelation 1:14 — *His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire.* On Patmos John sees the Son of Adam (1:13) himself now bearing the white-wool hair Enoch saw on the Head of Days (46:1) — the Formed Son shares the Father's glory.
cards.s_text: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.
cards.t_text: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

cards.note: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* Daniel sees one *like* the Son of Adam (the kaph-comparative, for the Formed Son took on flesh) coming to the Ancient of Days; Enoch 46:2 NAMES that same One who goes with the Head of Days — same figure, different grammar, both Yahusha.
cards.s_text: And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?
cards.t_text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

cards.note: Daniel 7:9 — *I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.* Daniel's Ancient of Days with hair like pure wool is Enoch's Head of Days whose head is white like wool (46:1) — the formless Father on His throne.
cards.s_text: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.
cards.t_text: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.

cards.note: Matthew 26:64 — *Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* Yahusha claims Daniel's kaph-clouds and the throne-seat of the Head of Days, the very Son of Adam enthroned in Enoch 47:3.
cards.s_text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,
cards.t_text: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, You have said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall you see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The One named before the sun and stars were made (Enoch 48:3) is the Word who was in the beginning with the Father, the Formed Son enthroned beside the Head of Days in Enoch 47:3.
cards.s_text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* Daniel sees one LIKE the Son of Adam brought near the Ancient of days, the comparative kaph; Enoch 47:3 names that same One enthroned beside the Head of Days.
cards.s_text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,
cards.t_text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 48:3 — *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* The Son of Adam named before creation is the One enthroned beside the Head of Days whose court Enoch 47:3 describes.
cards.s_text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,
cards.t_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 46:3 — *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* The chosen Son of Adam of ch46 is the One sharing the throne-court where the Head of Days seats Himself in Enoch 47:3.
cards.s_text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,
cards.t_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.note: Revelation 6:11 — *And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.* The completing of the brethren's number is the same fulness Enoch 47:4 calls 'the number of the righteous had been offered.'
cards.s_text: And the hearts of the holy were filled with joy; Because the number of the righteous had been offered, And the prayer of the righteous had been heard, And the blood of the righteous been required before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.

cards.note: Revelation 13:8 — *And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.* The names were inscribed before the foundation of the world — election precedes confession, so the number of the righteous in Enoch 47:4 is fixed, not assembled.
cards.s_text: And the hearts of the holy were filled with joy; Because the number of the righteous had been offered, And the prayer of the righteous had been heard, And the blood of the righteous been required before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

cards.note: Revelation 20:15 — *And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.* The reckoning turns on whether the name stands in the book — the same books of the living whose tally of the righteous gladdens heaven in Enoch 47:4.
cards.s_text: And the hearts of the holy were filled with joy; Because the number of the righteous had been offered, And the prayer of the righteous had been heard, And the blood of the righteous been required before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.

cards.note: Daniel 12:1 — *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* Deliverance belongs to those already written in the book — the named, counted righteous whose number Enoch 47:4 says has been offered.
cards.s_text: And the hearts of the holy were filled with joy; Because the number of the righteous had been offered, And the prayer of the righteous had been heard, And the blood of the righteous been required before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which stands for the children of your people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

cards.note: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* John's opened books and the book of life are Enoch 47:3's books of the living opened before the Head of Days.
cards.s_text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,
cards.t_text: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

cards.note: Daniel 7:10 — *A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.* The myriads standing before Him and the books opened are precisely the host, counsellors, and books of the living of Enoch 47:3.
cards.s_text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,
cards.t_text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

cards.note: Daniel 7:9 — *I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.* Daniel's white-haired Ancient of days seating Himself to judge is Enoch 47:3's Head of Days seating Himself upon the throne of His glory.
cards.s_text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,
cards.t_text: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.

cards.note: Revelation 6:11 — *And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.* The 'little season' until the number is full is Enoch 47:2's prayer that the righteous not suffer for ever — vindication delayed, never in vain.
cards.s_text: In those days the holy ones who dwell above in the heavens Shall unite with one voice And supplicate and pray [and praise, And give thanks and bless the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits] On behalf of the blood of the righteous which has been shed, And that the prayer of the righteous may not be in vain before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, That judgement may be done unto them, And that they may not have to suffer for ever.
cards.t_text: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.

cards.note: Revelation 6:10 — *And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah (Lord), holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?* The martyrs' 'how long' is the answered echo of the holy ones' plea in Enoch 47:2 that judgement be done for the blood of the righteous.
cards.s_text: In those days the holy ones who dwell above in the heavens Shall unite with one voice And supplicate and pray [and praise, And give thanks and bless the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits] On behalf of the blood of the righteous which has been shed, And that the prayer of the righteous may not be in vain before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, That judgement may be done unto them, And that they may not have to suffer for ever.
cards.t_text: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah (Lord), holy and true, do you not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

cards.note: Revelation 6:9 — *And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of Elohim (God), and for the testimony which they held:* John sees the shed blood of the righteous gathered under the altar, the same blood Enoch 47:1 sees ascending before Yahuah of Spirits.
cards.s_text: And in those days shall have ascended the prayer of the righteous, And the blood of the righteous from the earth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of Elohim (God), and for the testimony which they held:

cards.note: Psalm 56:8 — *Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?* The Father keeps an exact account of the suffering of the righteous, the same reckoning Enoch 47:1 says rises before Yahuah of Spirits.
cards.s_text: And in those days shall have ascended the prayer of the righteous, And the blood of the righteous from the earth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: You tell my wanderings: put you my tears into your bottle: are they not in your book?

cards.note: Genesis 4:11 — *And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand;* The earth that opened to receive Abel's blood is the same earth from which the righteous blood ascends in Enoch 47:1.
cards.s_text: And in those days shall have ascended the prayer of the righteous, And the blood of the righteous from the earth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: And now are you cursed from the earth, which has opened her mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand;

cards.note: Genesis 4:10 — *And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.* The first shed blood already cried from the earth before Yahuah, exactly as Enoch 47:1 says the blood of the righteous ascends from the ground.
cards.s_text: And in those days shall have ascended the prayer of the righteous, And the blood of the righteous from the earth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: And he said, What have you done? the voice of your brother’s blood cries unto me from the ground.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 46:4 — *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* The kings who implore too late (48:8) are the kings and mighty the Son of Adam raises from their seats at ch46:4.
cards.s_text: In these days downcast in countenance shall the kings of the earth have become, And the strong who possess the land because of the works of their hands, For on the day of their anguish and affliction they shall not (be able to) save themselves.
cards.t_text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.

cards.note: Psalms 72:17 — *His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.* The name named before the sun (48:3) and worshipped by all (48:5) is the name continued as long as the sun, before which the kings of 48:8 must answer.
cards.s_text: In these days downcast in countenance shall the kings of the earth have become, And the strong who possess the land because of the works of their hands, For on the day of their anguish and affliction they shall not (be able to) save themselves.
cards.t_text: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

cards.note: Psalms 72:11 — *Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.* The earth falling down to worship before Him (48:5) is the Psalm's all kings falling down and all nations serving Him.
cards.s_text: All who dwell on earth shall fall down and worship before him, And will praise and bless and celebrate with song Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

cards.note: Philippians 2:11 — *And that every tongue should confess that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) is Lord, to the glory of Elohim (God) the Father.* The worship before the Son bends to the Father, just as Enoch's worshippers praise and bless Yahuah of Spirits (48:5) — the Son worshipped, the glory the Father's.
cards.s_text: All who dwell on earth shall fall down and worship before him, And will praise and bless and celebrate with song Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: And that every tongue should confess that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) is the Lord, to the glory of Elohim (God) the Father.

cards.note: Philippians 2:10 — *That at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;* All who dwell on earth falling down to worship before Him (48:5) is every knee bowing at the name of Yahusha.
cards.s_text: All who dwell on earth shall fall down and worship before him, And will praise and bless and celebrate with song Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: That at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

cards.note: Micah 5:2 — *But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Yahudah (Judah), yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Yashar'el (Israel); whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.* The One in whose name the righteous are saved (48:7) is the ruler whose goings forth are from of old, from everlasting.
cards.s_text: And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.
cards.t_text: But you, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though you be little among the thousands of Yahudah (Judah), yet out of you shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Yashar'el (Israel); whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:10 — *And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.* The staff on whom the righteous stay themselves (48:4) is the root of Jesse standing as an ensign to which the Gentiles seek.
cards.s_text: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.
cards.t_text: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

cards.note: Isaiah 49:6 — *And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.* The Son of Adam as light of the Gentiles (48:4) first raises up the tribes of Jacob and restores scattered Yashar'el, then reaches the nations.
cards.s_text: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.
cards.t_text: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

cards.note: Isaiah 49:1 — *Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; Yahuah (LORD) hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.* The Servant's name made mention of from the womb answers the Son of Adam whose name was named and who is the hope of the troubled (48:4).
cards.s_text: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.
cards.t_text: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, you people, from far; Yahuah (LORD) has called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother has he made mention of my name.

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,* The Son chosen and hidden before the creation (48:6) was foreordained before the foundation of the world and manifest in the flesh as Yahusha.
cards.s_text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: Colossians 1:17 — *And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.* The One chosen and hidden before the creation of the world (48:6) is He who is before all things and in whom all things consist.
cards.s_text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.
cards.t_text: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

cards.note: Proverbs 8:23 — *I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.* Wisdom's everlasting setting-up before the earth matches the name named before the stars of heaven were made (48:3).
cards.s_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* Enoch dates the naming before the stars were made (48:3); John names Him the One by whom those very things were made.
cards.s_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The name named before the sun and signs were created (48:3) is the Word who was in the beginning, with the Father and yet ordered as the Formed Son.
cards.s_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: 1 Enoch 61:8 — *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* The Son of Adam named in 48:2 is the Elect One placed on the throne of glory to judge.
cards.s_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 46:3 — *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* The naming of the Son of Adam at ch48:2 echoes His choosing and pre-eminence first declared at ch46:3.
cards.s_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.
cards.t_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.note: Daniel 7:14 — *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* The Son of Adam named before the Head of Days (48:2) is the One given the everlasting kingdom Daniel records.
cards.s_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.
cards.t_text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

cards.note: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* Daniel sees one LIKE the Son of Adam (the kaph: He resembles mortal-man because He took flesh, while remaining the cloud-rider); Enoch 48:2 NAMES that same One in the presence of the Head of Days.
cards.s_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.
cards.t_text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 9:9 — *And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.* The fountains of wisdom around Enoch's spring (48:1) flow from the Wisdom that stood with Elohim at the making of the world.
cards.s_text: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.
cards.t_text: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.

cards.note: John 4:14 — *But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.* Yahusha gives the inexhaustible water Enoch saw, so that the thirsty (48:1) thirst no more.
cards.s_text: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.
cards.t_text: But whosoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

cards.note: Isaiah 12:3 — *Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.* The thirsty who drink and are filled with wisdom in Enoch 48:1 are those Isaiah sees drawing with joy from salvation's wells.
cards.s_text: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.
cards.t_text: Therefore with joy shall you draw water out of the wells of salvation.

cards.note: Jeremiah 2:13 — *For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.* Enoch's inexhaustible fountain of righteousness (48:1) is the very fountain of living waters Yahuah's people abandoned for cracked cisterns.
cards.s_text: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.
cards.t_text: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 51:1 — *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* Enoch's own ch51 makes the Elect One the agent of resurrection — the rising of the righteous who fell asleep in Him.
cards.s_text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
cards.t_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.note: John 5:28 — *Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,* Yahusha names Himself the voice that wakes the graves — the Elect One whose might over the sleeping righteous Enoch sees in 49:3.
cards.s_text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
cards.t_text: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

cards.note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The fallen-asleep-in-righteousness whose spirit rests with the Elect One are Daniel's sleepers in the dust who awake to everlasting life.
cards.s_text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: Isaiah 26:19 — *Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.* The 'spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness' resting on the Elect One points to Isaiah's dust-dwellers waking — the earth casting out its dead.
cards.s_text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
cards.t_text: Your dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, you that dwell in dust: for your dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 61:8 — *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* The office of judging the secret things named in 49:4 is the throne-of-glory judgement given here.
cards.s_text: And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits according to His good pleasure.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:4 — *But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.* The Spirit-anointed branch judges in righteousness, not by sight — the very judging of secret things Enoch ascribes to the Elect One.
cards.s_text: And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits according to His good pleasure.
cards.t_text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

cards.note: Daniel 7:14 — *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* The everlasting dominion given to the Son of Adam is the judging authority Enoch sees vested in the Elect One forever.
cards.s_text: And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits according to His good pleasure.
cards.t_text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

cards.note: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* Daniel sees one LIKE the Son of Adam (the kaph-comparative — he resembles mortal-man because he took flesh); Enoch names that same Elect One who judges before Yahuah of Spirits.
cards.s_text: And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits according to His good pleasure.
cards.t_text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 48:1 — *And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.* Enoch's own fountains of wisdom in ch48 are here gathered into the Elect One, from whom wisdom is poured out like water.
cards.s_text: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.
cards.t_text: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.

cards.note: Proverbs 8:12 — *I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.* The Wisdom Proverbs personifies as present from the beginning is the same wisdom Enoch sees poured out without fail from the Elect One.
cards.s_text: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.
cards.t_text: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 1:24 — *But unto them which are called, both Yahudim (Jews) and Greeks, Messiah (Christ) the power of Elohim (God), and the wisdom of Elohim (God).* The wisdom flowing from the Elect One is named in the Messiah Himself, who is the wisdom of Elohim.
cards.s_text: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.
cards.t_text: But unto them which are called, both Yahudim (Jews) and Greeks, Messiah (Christ) the power of Elohim (God), and the wisdom of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Colossians 2:3 — *In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.* The wisdom Enoch sees poured out like water from the Elect One is, in Paul, the whole treasury hidden in the Messiah.
cards.s_text: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.
cards.t_text: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

cards.note: Matthew 12:18 — *Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.* Matthew reads Isaiah's elect-servant straight onto Yahusha — the same chosen One Enoch names standing before Yahuah of Spirits.
cards.s_text: For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.
cards.t_text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

cards.note: John 3:34 — *For he whom Elohim (God) hath sent speaketh the words of Elohim (God): for Elohim (God) giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.* When the Elect One came in flesh as Yahusha, the Spirit that dwells in Him was given without measure, exactly as Enoch saw it indwelling Him in full.
cards.s_text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
cards.t_text: For he whom Elohim (God) has sent speaks the words of Elohim (God): for Elohim (God) gives not the Spirit by measure unto him.

cards.note: Isaiah 42:1 — *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.* Isaiah's 'mine elect' on whom the Spirit is put is Enoch's named 'Elect One' standing before Yahuah of Spirits.
cards.s_text: For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.
cards.t_text: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; my elect, in whom my soul delights; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:2 — *And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);* the very sevenfold Spirit Enoch sees dwelling in the Elect One is Isaiah's Spirit resting on the branch of Jesse.
cards.s_text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
cards.t_text: And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);

cards.note: 1 Enoch 51:1 — *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* Enoch's own next chapter sets the righteous judgement of 50:4 after the resurrection, when the Elect One arises to judge.
cards.s_text: And He is righteous also in His judgement, And in the presence of His glory unrighteousness also shall not maintain itself: At His judgement the unrepentant shall perish before Him.
cards.t_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.note: Romans 2:5 — *But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of Elohim (God).* Paul's 'righteous judgment of Elohim' against the impenitent heart is Enoch's righteous judgement under which the unrepentant perish (50:4).
cards.s_text: And He is righteous also in His judgement, And in the presence of His glory unrighteousness also shall not maintain itself: At His judgement the unrepentant shall perish before Him.
cards.t_text: But after your hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of Elohim (God);

cards.note: Isaiah 30:15 — *For thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.* The unrepentant who perish (50:4) are those who 'would not' return to the salvation that was offered.
cards.s_text: And He is righteous also in His judgement, And in the presence of His glory unrighteousness also shall not maintain itself: At His judgement the unrepentant shall perish before Him.
cards.t_text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); In returning and rest shall you be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and you would not.
