cards.note: *And the Great Glory sat thereon, and His raiment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow.* (1 Enoch 14:20). *I saw Yahuah (the Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple* (Isaiah 6:1). Enoch saw the Great Glory seated, his raiment brighter than the sun and whiter than snow. The train that filled the temple is the raiment Enoch could not look upon.
cards.s_text: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also Adonai (Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
cards.t_text: And the Great Glory sat thereon, and His raiment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow.

cards.note: *And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.* (1 Enoch 14:18). *I saw Yahuah (the Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up* (Isaiah 6:1). Enoch saw the same lofty throne — crystal, wheels like the shining sun, cherubim — and the Glory none could approach (1 Enoch 14:20–21). The prophet and the patriarch stood before one throne.
cards.s_text: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also Adonai (Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
cards.t_text: And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.

cards.note: *The first voice blesses Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 40:4). *The whole earth is full of his glory* (Isaiah 6:3) is sung in heaven without ceasing: the first voice blesses Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever. One worship, in heaven and over all the earth.
cards.s_text: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): the whole earth is full of his glory.
cards.t_text: The first voice blesses Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.

cards.note: *And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (Lord) of glory.* (1 Enoch 40:3). The seraphim who *cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy* (Isaiah 6:3) are the holy ones Enoch hears at the throne — the four presences who *uttered praises before Yahuah (God) of glory*. The restored witness shows the same ceaseless worship before the same throne of glory that filled Isaiah's temple.
cards.s_text: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): the whole earth is full of his glory.
cards.t_text: And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (Lord) of glory.

cards.note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 48:3). The son given, named *Avi-ad (The everlasting Father)* (Isaiah 9:6), was named before creation itself — *before the sun and the signs were created... His name was named*. The everlasting One is the Formed Son foreknown before the world, drawn from the Formless Father.
cards.s_text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, El Gibbor (The mighty God), Avi-ad (The everlasting Father), Sar Shalom (The Prince of Peace).
cards.t_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days* (1 Enoch 48:2). The child whose *name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, El Gibbor (The mighty God)* (Isaiah 9:6) is the One the restored witness sees named in heaven — *that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits*. The Formed Son, the Elect One, bears his Name before the throne.
cards.s_text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, El Gibbor (The mighty God), Avi-ad (The everlasting Father), Sar Shalom (The Prince of Peace).

cards.note: *And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness* (1 Enoch 49:3). The *spirit of wisdom and understanding... the spirit of counsel and might* resting on the Branch (Isaiah 11:2) is the same anointing the restored witness names on the Elect One — *in him dwells the spirit of wisdom... the spirit of understanding and of might*. The sevenfold Spirit on the chosen One.
cards.s_text: And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);
cards.t_text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.

cards.note: *For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness... Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations* (1 Enoch 49:2). The One on whom *the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest* (Isaiah 11:2) is the Elect One who *standeth before Yahuah (God) of Spirits*, mighty *in all the secrets of righteousness* — the Branch anointed to *judge the secret things* (1 Enoch 49:4; Isaiah 11:3-4).
cards.s_text: And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);
cards.t_text: For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.

cards.note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). The *righteous servant* who shall *justify many* (Isaiah 53:11) is the Son of Adam *born unto righteousness*, hidden from before the world and now revealed — the Elect One in whom righteousness dwells. The restored witness binds the suffering-and-justifying servant to the exalted Son of Adam before the Head of Days.
cards.s_text: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
cards.t_text: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’

cards.note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). The servant who was *numbered with the transgressors* (Isaiah 53:12) — humbled, despised, slain — is the same Son of Adam exalted to judge the kings and the mighty. The pattern is one: rejected and cut off, then *divide him a portion with the great* (53:12); the suffering servant and the enthroned Elect One are the same Formed Son.
cards.s_text: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he has poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
cards.t_text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 20:3 — *Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is over the spirits of men.* Raphael, fourth of the archangels named to bury Adam, is set over the spirits of men in Enoch's catalogue.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) spake to the archangel(s) Michael, (Gabriel, Uriel, and Raphael): 'Go away
cards.t_text: Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is over the spirits of men.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 20:2 — *Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is over the world and over Tartarus.* Uriel, third of the four sent for the burial, stands in the same roster of named holy angels.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) spake to the archangel(s) Michael, (Gabriel, Uriel, and Raphael): 'Go away
cards.t_text: Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is over the world and over Tartarus.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 20:7 — *Gabriel, one of the holy angels, who is over Paradise and the serpents and the Cherubim.* Gabriel, sent to the third-heaven Paradise to prepare Adam, is the angel set over Paradise in Enoch's list.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) spake to the archangel(s) Michael, (Gabriel, Uriel, and Raphael): 'Go away
cards.t_text: Gabriel, one of the holy angels, who is over Paradise and the serpents and the Cherubim.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 20:5 — *Michael, one of the holy angels, to wit, he that is set over the best part of mankind and over chaos.* Michael, named first to bury Adam, is the chief of the holy angels in the Watcher-tradition's own roster.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) spake to the archangel(s) Michael, (Gabriel, Uriel, and Raphael): 'Go away
cards.t_text: Michael, one of the holy angels, to wit, he that is set over the best part of mankind and over chaos.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 6:2 — *And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: 'Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.'* The angels who rebelled with the adversary in Adam & Eve 58:1 are remembered in the book of the fathers as the Watchers, the children of heaven who forsook their estate.
cards.s_text: with thee.' And I said, 'If He be wrath with me, I will set my seat above the stars of heaven and will be like the Highest.'
cards.t_text: And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’

cards.note: Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven... And he was the first to write a testimony.* Enoch the first writer is the pattern of Eve's charge — the antediluvian life set down in a testimony that outlasts the generations.
cards.s_text: But hearken unto me, my children. Make ye then tables of stone and others of clay, and write
cards.t_text: And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.

cards.note: Jude 1:14 — *And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) cometh with ten thousands of his saints.* The antediluvian testimony did survive the flood — Enoch's prophecy, preserved and quoted by the apostle, is the very record Eve sought to keep.
cards.s_text: on them, all my life and your father's (all) that ye have heard and seen from us. If by water Yahuah (Lord) judge our race, the tables of clay will be dissolved and the tables of stone will remain; but if by fire, the tables of stone will be broken up and the tables of clay will be baked (hard).'
cards.t_text: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) comes with ten thousands of his saints,

cards.note: *Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light: And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.* (1 Enoch 45:4–5). *For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth* (Isaiah 65:17). Enoch heard the same promise from the same mouth: the heaven transformed into an eternal blessing and light, the earth transformed into a blessing, the Elect One dwelling among his people. The prophet's new creation is the age of the Parables.
cards.s_text: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
cards.t_text: Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:

cards.note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). *Yahuah (LORD) will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury* (Isaiah 66:15); *by fire and by his sword will Yahuah (LORD) plead with all flesh* (66:16). 1 Enoch sees the same coming-in-judgement to *convict all flesh* — the verse Jude later quotes by name; the library's own witness to the fiery advent.
cards.s_text: For, behold, Yahuah (LORD) will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
cards.t_text: And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.

cards.note: *And I will give them over into the hands of Mine elect: As straw in the fire so shall they burn before the face of the holy: As lead in the water shall they sink before the face of the righteous, And no trace of them shall any more be found.* (1 Enoch 48:9). *By fire and by his sword will Yahuah (the LORD) plead with all flesh* (Isaiah 66:16); *neither shall their fire be quenched* (Isaiah 66:24). Enoch sees the sinners given into the hands of the elect, burning as straw before the face of the holy, sinking as lead before the face of the righteous. The fire that closes Isaiah is the fire of the Parables.
cards.s_text: For by fire and by his sword will Yahuah (LORD) plead with all flesh: and the slain of Yahuah (LORD) shall be many.
cards.t_text: And I will give them over into the hands of Mine elect: As straw in the fire so shall they burn before the face of the holy: As lead in the water shall they sink before the face of the righteous, And no trace of them shall any more be found.

cards.note: *Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light: And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.* (1 Enoch 45:4–5). *As the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me* (Isaiah 66:22). Enoch heard Yahuah (Lord) promise to transform the heaven and the earth and set his elect upon it, the sinners shut out. The renewal in which the seed and the name remain is the renewal the Parables saw.
cards.s_text: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, says Yahuah (LORD), so shall your seed and your name remain.
cards.t_text: Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:

cards.note: *Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations* (1 Enoch 49:2). *Mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth* (Isaiah 42:1) is named in the restored apocalyptic witness as the Elect One who stands before Yahuah of Spirits — *And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might* (1 Enoch 49:3): the Servant on whom the Father has *put my spirit*.
cards.s_text: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; my elect, in whom my soul delights; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.

cards.note: *He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart* (1 Enoch 48:4). The Servant who *shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles* (Isaiah 42:1) is the Elect One named *the light of the Gentiles* — chosen and hidden before the creation of the world (1 Enoch 48:6), the same light-to-the-nations the Servant Songs sing.
cards.s_text: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; my elect, in whom my soul delights; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.

cards.note: *He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart* (1 Enoch 48:4). The restored library carries the identical title for the Chosen One named before the Head of Days (48:2-3): *the light of the Gentiles* — the very phrase of Isaiah 49:6, *I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles*. The Servant and the Elect One are one: a light to the nations, the hope of the troubled.
cards.s_text: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
cards.t_text: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.

cards.note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes* (1 Enoch 51:1). *The earth shall cast out the dead* (Isaiah 26:19) is the very picture the restored witness paints — *the earth also shall give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back*. The grave is a steward holding the dead in trust, and at the rising it gives them all back.
cards.s_text: Your dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, you that dwell in dust: for your dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
cards.t_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). *The chariots of Elohim (God) are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: Yahuah (the Lord) is among them, as in Sinai* (Psalm 68:17): the psalm's thousands are angels, the chariotry of the coming One. Enoch's ten thousands of holy ones are another company — the seed of promise, gathered and coming with him into the land (Zechariah 14:5). The angels attend him; his saints come with him.
cards.s_text: The chariots of Elohim (God) are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: Adonai (Lord) is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
cards.t_text: And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.

cards.note: *And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens* (1 Enoch 1:4). *even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of Elohim (God)* (Psalm 68:8), to *him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens* (68:33): Enoch names the same Sinai-treading from the heaven of heavens — the eternal Elohim coming down upon the mount in the strength of His might. The theophany of the psalm is the appearing Enoch foresaw.
cards.s_text: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of Elohim (God): even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.

cards.note: *And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame* (1 Enoch 1:6). *As wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of Elohim (God)* (Psalm 68:2): the same melting-wax image marks the day of His coming — the mountains and the wicked alike melt like wax before the flame of His presence. What the psalm prays, Enoch sees fulfilled at the theophany.
cards.s_text: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame.

cards.note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days* (1 Enoch 48:2). The Arm called to *awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old* (51:9) was named before the generations were — *before the sun and the signs were created... His name was named* (48:3). The Redeemer-Arm, the Formed Son, was named before the Head of Days, drawn from the Formless and standing forth to save.
cards.s_text: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Yahuah (LORD); awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Are you not it that has cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
cards.t_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). *Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still* (Psalm 76:8): the restored apocalyptic sees the same judgment come down from above — He comes with His holy ones to execute judgment upon all, the earth made still before the One who arises to judge.
cards.s_text: You did cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
cards.t_text: And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.

cards.note: *And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years.’* (1 Enoch 18:16). The *host of the high ones that are on high* whom Yahuah will *punish* (Isaiah 24:21) are the stars of heaven who transgressed — and Yahuah *bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated*. The punishment of the high host is their binding in the prison of the abyss.
cards.s_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
cards.t_text: And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years.’

cards.note: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever* (1 Enoch 10:13). *Shut up in the prison* (Isaiah 24:22) is Enoch's own word — *the prison in which they shall be confined* — the abyss where the host of high ones is held until the day of visitation.
cards.s_text: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
cards.t_text: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.

cards.note: *And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated* (1 Enoch 10:12). The Watchers are *bind them fast... till the day of their judgement* — the very *shut up in the prison, and after many days... visited* of Isaiah 24:22. Bound now, judged at the appointed day.
cards.s_text: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
cards.t_text: And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated.

cards.note: *And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years.’* (1 Enoch 18:16). *They shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited* (Isaiah 24:22) — exactly the sentence Enoch sees: *bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated*. The host is shut in the pit *till the time* of visitation; the prophet and the witness see one judgment.
cards.s_text: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
cards.t_text: And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years.’

cards.note: *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.* (1 Enoch 18:15). *Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high* (Isaiah 24:21) — the restored witness names that host: the stars that *transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (God)*, the rebel powers above who *did not come forth at their appointed times*. The high ones on high are the transgressing host bound for judgment.
cards.s_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
cards.t_text: And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.

cards.note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *Yahuah (The LORD) reigneth, he is clothed with majesty... the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved* (Psalm 93:1). The restored witness shows the reign as the Father placing the Son on the throne of glory to judge; the One who reigns is the One who seats, and the One seated is the Formed.
cards.s_text: Yahuah (LORD) reigns, he is clothed with majesty; Yahuah (LORD) is clothed with strength, wherewith he has girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.

cards.note: *And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens* (1 Enoch 1:4). The watcher of old saw the same descent as *Yahuah (LORD) descended upon it in fire* (Exodus 19:18): *the eternal Elohim will tread upon the earth, even on Mount Sinai... appear in the strength of His might*. The Holy One coming down on Sinai is the great manifestation of His might, the Formed presence treading the mount.
cards.s_text: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah (LORD) descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
cards.t_text: And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.

cards.note: *And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.* (1 Enoch 41:5). The sun and moon that *shall not smite thee by day... nor... by night* (Psalm 121:6) are not powers to dread but oath-bound servants of the Maker, keeping the courses he set. The Keeper rules the very lights, so they cannot harm the one he keeps.
cards.s_text: The sun shall not smite you by day, nor the moon by night.
cards.t_text: And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.

cards.note: *On that day shall raise one voice, and bless and glorify and exalt in the spirit of faith, and in the spirit of wisdom, and in the spirit of patience, and in the spirit of mercy, and in the spirit of judgement and of peace, and in the spirit of goodness, and shall all say with one voice: "Blessed is He, and may the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits be blessed for ever and ever."* (1 Enoch 61:11). The capstone's summons of *every thing that hath breath* is the host of heaven raising ONE voice — the same final, unanimous Hallelujah the Psalter ends on.
cards.s_text: Let every thing that has breath praise Yahuah (LORD). Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
cards.t_text: On that day shall raise one voice, and bless and glorify and exalt in the spirit of faith, and in the spirit of wisdom, and in the spirit of patience, and in the spirit of mercy, and in the spirit of judgement and of peace, and in the spirit of goodness, and shall all say with one voice: "Blessed is He, and may the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits be blessed for ever and ever."

cards.note: *And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (Lord) of glory.* (1 Enoch 40:3). The praise the capstone commands below is already sounding above — the four presences before the throne uttering the praise *every thing that hath breath* is now gathered into.
cards.s_text: Let every thing that has breath praise Yahuah (LORD). Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
cards.t_text: And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (Lord) of glory.

cards.note: *And these are the names of the holy angels who watch* (1 Enoch 20:1). Daniel's *a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven* (Daniel 4:13) and *the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones* (Daniel 4:17) name the very order the restored book of Enoch lists: the HOLY angels who keep vigil — Uriel, Raphael, Michael, Gabriel and their fellows — the set-apart ones who execute the Most High's verdict. These are not the fallen Watchers of Genesis 6 but the holy ones through whom *the El Elyon (most High) ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will*.
cards.s_text: This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the El Elyon (most High) rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomsoever he will, and sets up over it the basest of men.
cards.t_text: And these are the names of the holy angels who watch.

cards.note: *And his activities had to do with the Watchers, and his days were with the holy ones* (1 Enoch 12:2). The Watchers-and-holy-ones pairing that frames Daniel's decree — *the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones* (Daniel 4:17) — is the same heavenly council Enoch walks among. The holy ones carry the word of the Most High; the verdict on Babylon's king issues from that throne, that the living may know who *ruleth in the kingdom of men*.
cards.s_text: This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the El Elyon (most High) rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomsoever he will, and sets up over it the basest of men.
cards.t_text: And his activities had to do with the Watchers, and his days were with the holy ones.

cards.note: *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not* (1 Enoch 99:2). The library itself pronounces the woe Matthew 5:19 implies — the one who breaks the least commandment and teaches men so is the perverter of the eternal law.
cards.s_text: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
cards.t_text: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.

cards.note: *And there I saw One who had a head of days, and His head was white like wool, and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels* (1 Enoch 46:1). The Book of Parables sees exactly Daniel's vision — a Head of Days (white like wool, Daniel 7:9) and beside him *another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man* (the kaph again, *one like the Son of Adam*, Daniel 7:13). The restored witness reads this messianically.
cards.s_text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.
cards.t_text: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.

cards.note: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him* (1 Enoch 46:3). Enoch's interpreting angel names the man-like One of Daniel 7:13 *the Son of Adam* — the chosen, righteous One who stands before the Head of Days, the Formed Son drawn near before the Ancient of Days.
cards.s_text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.
cards.t_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days* (1 Enoch 48:2). The One given *dominion, and glory, and a kingdom* (Daniel 7:14) is named before the Head of Days — the same Ancient of Days of Daniel's throne. The Son of Adam's name lifted up before the Father, who grants him the everlasting reign.
cards.s_text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.
cards.t_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 48:3). The Son of Adam who receives *an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away* (Daniel 7:14) was named before creation itself — the Formed Son, expressed from the Formless Father before the sun and stars, not a thing made among them.
cards.s_text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.
cards.t_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.note: *Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations* (1 Enoch 49:2). The everlasting *glory, and a kingdom* (Daniel 7:14) of the Son of Adam is the *glory... for ever and ever* of the Elect One who stands before the Father. The Similitudes bind Daniel's cloud-rider, the Son of Adam, and the Elect One into one Person — the Formed Son.
cards.s_text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.
cards.t_text: For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.

cards.note: *And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.* (1 Enoch 14:18). Enoch is carried up and sees the throne of the Most High, a vision twin to Daniel's — *his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire* (Daniel 7:9). The same heavenly throne-room of the Ancient of Days, seen by Enoch before Daniel.
cards.s_text: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.
cards.t_text: And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.

cards.note: *In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated Himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him* (1 Enoch 47:3). The Similitudes show the very scene of Daniel 7:9-10 — the Head of Days enthroned, *the books of the living were opened* (so *the judgment was set, and the books were opened*, Daniel 7:10), the host standing before him.
cards.s_text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.
cards.t_text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,

cards.note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes* (1 Enoch 51:1). The restored witness sees Daniel's resurrection — *many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake* (Daniel 12:2) — as the earth and Sheol giving back the dead entrusted to them. The dust, the grave, and the pit all surrender their sleepers at the appointed day.
cards.s_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
cards.t_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.note: *Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.* (1 Enoch 104:2). *They that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament... as the stars for ever and ever* (Daniel 12:3). Enoch tells the righteous the same: they shall shine as the lights of heaven, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to them.
cards.s_text: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
cards.t_text: Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.

cards.note: *And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before Yahuah (God) of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth* (1 Enoch 40:7). The adversary of *Satan standing at his right hand to resist him* (Zechariah 3:1) is the same accuser the restored witness shows fended off — forbidden to come before Yahuah to accuse the people. The court that stands over Joshua is the court where the Satans are barred.
cards.s_text: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of Yahuah (LORD), and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.
cards.t_text: And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.

cards.note: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). The pierced One *they shall look upon* (Zechariah 12:10) is the Son of Adam the restored witness sees revealed in the day — *this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen* — before whom the kings and the mighty are abased. The day of looking upon the pierced One is the day of the Son of Adam's appearing.
cards.s_text: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourns for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
cards.t_text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.

cards.note: *And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) cometh with ten thousands of his saints,* (Jude 1:14). Jude names the prophet and quotes the line that answers *and all the saints with thee* (14:5): Yahuah *cometh with ten thousands of his saints*. The saints are the seed of promise — the righteous raised and the scattered gathered to him, rising up with him and coming with him into the land — not angels, and not souls coming down from heaven. Jude draws the witness from the restored book of Enoch.
cards.s_text: And you shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, you shall flee, like as you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Yahudah (Judah): and Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) shall come, and all the saints with you.
cards.t_text: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) comes with ten thousands of his saints,

cards.note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). This is the very line Jude quotes, and it answers *Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) shall come, and all the saints with thee* (14:5). The holy ones who come with him are the seed of promise, gathered out of all nations and coming with him into the land while the ungodly are judged — not angels, and not souls come down from heaven.
cards.s_text: And you shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, you shall flee, like as you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Yahudah (Judah): and Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) shall come, and all the saints with you.
cards.t_text: And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.

cards.note: *[As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]* (1 Enoch 15:10). The library tells where these unclean spirits came from — the spirits of the giants, earth-bound, given over to the earth.
cards.s_text: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with you, Yahusha (Jesus), you Son of Elohim (God)? are you come hither to torment us before the time?
cards.t_text: [As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]

cards.note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The very work of the demons in the tombs — afflicting, destroying — and they know their judgement is coming.
cards.s_text: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with you, Yahusha (Jesus), you Son of Elohim (God)? are you come hither to torment us before the time?
cards.t_text: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.

cards.note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). This is why they cry *art thou come hither to torment us before the time?* — they know the appointed day of the great judgement, and they tremble that He is here.
cards.s_text: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with you, Yahusha (Jesus), you Son of Elohim (God)? are you come hither to torment us before the time?
cards.t_text: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."

cards.note: *In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated Himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him* (1 Enoch 47:3). Malachi's *book of remembrance was written before him* (Malachi 3:16) is the restored witness's *books of the living... opened before Him* at the throne. The remembered righteous are recorded before the Head of Days.
cards.s_text: Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.
cards.t_text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,

cards.note: *And wait ye indeed till sin has passed away, for their names shall be blotted out of the book of life and out of the holy books, and their seed shall be destroyed for ever, and their spirits shall be slain, and they shall cry and make lamentation in a place that is a chaotic wilderness, and in the fire shall they burn; for there is no earth there.* (1 Enoch 108:3). Malachi's spared jewels — *I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him* (Malachi 3:17) — stand against those whose *names shall be blotted out of the book of life*. The book of remembrance keeps the faithful; the wicked are blotted out.
cards.s_text: And they shall be mine, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serves him.
cards.t_text: And wait ye indeed till sin has passed away, for their names shall be blotted out of the book of life and out of the holy books, and their seed shall be destroyed for ever, and their spirits shall be slain, and they shall cry and make lamentation in a place that is a chaotic wilderness, and in the fire shall they burn; for there is no earth there.

cards.note: *And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame* (1 Enoch 1:6). The day that *shall burn as an oven* (Malachi 4:1) is the day Enoch beholds when even the hills *melt like wax before the flame*. The proud who become *stubble* fare no better than the mountains melting before the fire of the coming day.
cards.s_text: For, behold, the day comes, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that comes shall burn them up, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.
cards.t_text: And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame.

cards.note: *And the earth shall be wholly rent in sunder, And all that is upon the earth shall perish, And there shall be a judgement upon all (men)* (1 Enoch 1:7). The burning day of Malachi 4:1 that leaves the wicked *neither root nor branch* is the judgement Enoch foresees — *a judgement upon all*, when *all that do wickedly* are consumed. The restored witness frames Malachi's oven-day as the universal reckoning.
cards.s_text: For, behold, the day comes, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that comes shall burn them up, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.
cards.t_text: And the earth shall be wholly rent in sunder, And all that is upon the earth shall perish, And there shall be a judgement upon all (men).

cards.note: *He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart* (1 Enoch 48:4). The *Sun of righteousness* arising with *healing* (Malachi 4:2) is the One the restored witness calls *the light of the Gentiles* and *the hope of those who are troubled of heart* — the rising light and healing of all who fear the Name.
cards.s_text: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and you shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
cards.t_text: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.

cards.note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). The library tells where the unclean spirits came from — the souls of the dead giants, the offspring of the Watchers. These are the very devils the Son binds and casts out.
cards.s_text: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow does not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
cards.t_text: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."

cards.note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 48:3). His name named before the stars — the Formed Son foreknown of the Father, not a creature of the moment nor a co-equal second.
cards.s_text: And Simon Peter answered and said, You are the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). The library's own vision of the Son of Adam seated to judge — born unto righteousness, the Head of Days behind him, rewarding every man.
cards.s_text: For the Son of Adam shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
cards.t_text: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’

cards.note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The *unclean spirits* the twelve are given power over are named here — the spirits gone out from the slain giants, the offspring of the Watchers. The library tells you what they are; the Son gives His sent ones authority over them.
cards.s_text: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
cards.t_text: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.

cards.note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). They destroy *until the day of the consummation* — but the Son, before that day, already hands their conquest to twelve men with nothing but a staff.
cards.s_text: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
cards.t_text: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."

cards.note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The library names the foul spirits the Son rebukes — the unclean spirits that *afflict* are the souls gone forth from the slain giants, born of the Watchers' rebellion.
cards.s_text: When Yahusha (Jesus) saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, You dumb and deaf spirit, I charge you, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
cards.t_text: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.

cards.note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). These spirits *destroy until the day of the consummation* — but the Formed Son, with a word, charges this one to *come out of him, and enter no more*: a foretaste of the consummating judgement.
cards.s_text: When Yahusha (Jesus) saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, You dumb and deaf spirit, I charge you, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
cards.t_text: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."

cards.note: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes* (1 Enoch 51:1). Hosea's *I will ransom them from the power of the grave* (Hosea 13:14) is the restored witness's resurrection morning — *Sheol also shall give back that which it has received*. The grave does not keep what Yahuah has ransomed; it gives back its dead.
cards.s_text: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be your plagues; O grave, I will be your destruction: repentance shall be hid from my eyes.
cards.t_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The library names what the *spirit* that *teareth* the child is — the afflicting spirits proceeding from the giants, the Watcher-rebellion's aftermath.
cards.s_text: And, lo, a spirit takes him, and he suddenly cries out; and it tears him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departs from him.
cards.t_text: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.

cards.note: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). These spirits destroy until the judgment; the Son rebukes one here as a foretaste of the consummation that ends them.
cards.s_text: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Yahusha (Jesus) rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
cards.t_text: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."

cards.note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Luke 22:30). The Elect One placed on the throne of glory to judge is the Son of Adam who shares that seat with the twelve.
cards.s_text: That you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.

cards.note: *And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.* (1 Enoch 62:5). *Hereafter shall the Son of Adam sit on the right hand of the power of Elohim (God)* (Luke 22:69). Enoch saw the faces of those who see that Son of Adam sitting on the throne of his glory — terror and pain. The council heard the claim; the vision shows them seeing it kept.
cards.s_text: Hereafter shall the Son of Adam sit on the right hand of the power of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.

cards.note: *For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness... Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever... And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him.* (1 Enoch 49:2,4). The Elect One stands *before* the Lord of Spirits — never instead of him — and judges by the authority he has been given. This is John 5:22 in older ink: the Father *hath committed all judgment unto the Son.*
cards.s_text: For the Father judges no man, but has committed all judgment unto the Son:
cards.t_text: For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.

cards.note: *And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.* (1 Enoch 69:27). *And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam* (John 5:27). Enoch saw the sum of judgement given to the Son of Adam on the throne of his glory. The authority is given — by the Father — and it is given to the Son of Adam by that name.
cards.s_text: And has given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam.
cards.t_text: And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.

cards.note: *He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.* (1 Enoch 48:4). The Son of Adam named before the Head of Days is *the light of the Gentiles* — *All who dwell on earth shall fall down and worship before him* (1 Enoch 48:5): the lifted-up One who draws all, the hope of the troubled-of-heart.
cards.s_text: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
cards.t_text: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.

cards.note: *at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 48:2). The One who suffers is the One named before creation and revealed in glory — the same Son of Adam, the watchers' book and Daniel and Isaiah converging on the one Formed Son.
cards.s_text: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of Adam be ashamed, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
cards.t_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). Named before the sun was made (48:3) — the Formed Son, begotten before the world, now confessed by Peter at Caesarea Philippi.
cards.s_text: And he says unto them, But whom say you that I am? And Peter answers and says unto him, You are the Messiah (Christ).
cards.t_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.note: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness... because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 46:3). The watchers' own book names him: the Son of Adam beside the Head of Days, chosen and pre-eminent. Not a co-equal — the chosen One of the Father of Spirits.
cards.s_text: And he says unto them, But whom say you that I am? And Peter answers and says unto him, You are the Messiah (Christ).
cards.t_text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

cards.note: *And he took up his parable and said—Enoch a righteous man, whose eyes were opened by Elohim (God), saw the vision of the Holy One in the heavens, which the angels showed me, and from them I heard everything, and from them I understood as I saw, but not for this generation, but for a remote one which is for to come* (1 Enoch 1:2). The seer's opened eyes are Amos's charter in person: *he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets* (3:7). Enoch *understood as I saw* — the disclosed counsel given to a servant, kept for a generation to come.
cards.s_text: Surely Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) does nothing without first revealing his secret unto his servants the prophets.
cards.t_text: And he took up his parable and said—Enoch a righteous man, whose eyes were opened by Elohim (God), saw the vision of the Holy One in the heavens, which the angels showed me, and from them I heard everything, and from them I understood as I saw, but not for this generation, but for a remote one which is for to come.

cards.note: *Concerning the elect I said, and took up my parable concerning them: The Holy Great One will come forth from His dwelling* (1 Enoch 1:3). The restored witness opens with Micah's very announcement — *Yahuah (LORD) cometh forth out of his place* (Micah 1:3): *The Holy Great One will come forth from His dwelling*. The Judge comes forth out of his place to come down upon the earth.
cards.s_text: For, behold, Yahuah (LORD) comes forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
cards.t_text: Concerning the elect I said, and took up my parable concerning them: The Holy Great One will come forth from His dwelling,

cards.note: *And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.* (1 Enoch 1:4). This is Micah's *tread upon the high places of the earth* (1:3) word for deed — *the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth*. The descending One who treads is the same in the prophet and the witness; he appears in the strength of his might.
cards.s_text: For, behold, Yahuah (LORD) comes forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
cards.t_text: And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.

cards.note: *And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame* (1 Enoch 1:6). A near-verbatim witness to Micah's *the mountains shall be molten under him... as wax before the fire* (1:4): *the high mountains shall be shaken... And shall melt like wax before the flame*. The high places brought low, the mountains melting as wax — one theophany, the prophet and the witness saying the same thing.
cards.s_text: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
cards.t_text: And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame.

cards.note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days* (1 Enoch 48:2). The ruler *whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting* (Micah 5:2) is the Son of Adam whose name was named in the presence of Yahuah of Spirits before the Head of Days — the pre-existent One, drawn from the Formless Father, who HAS a Father.
cards.s_text: But you, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though you be little among the thousands of Yahudah (Judah), yet out of you shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Yashar'el (Israel); whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
cards.t_text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

cards.note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 48:3). Micah's *from of old, from everlasting* (Micah 5:2) is this very thing: the ruler's name named *before the sun and the signs were created*. He is the Formed Son brought forth from the Formless Most High before all worlds — not a second unoriginate, not co-equal persons; he comes *forth unto ME [the Father]*.
cards.s_text: But you, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though you be little among the thousands of Yahudah (Judah), yet out of you shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Yashar'el (Israel); whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
cards.t_text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

cards.note: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore* (1 Enoch 48:6). The ruler *whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting* (Micah 5:2) is the One chosen and hidden *Before the creation of the world* — the pre-existent Word who is Yahuah and yet stands before the Father, hidden until he came forth in Bethlehem.
cards.s_text: But you, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though you be little among the thousands of Yahudah (Judah), yet out of you shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Yashar'el (Israel); whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
cards.t_text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.

cards.note: *He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart* (1 Enoch 48:4). The ruler who *shall stand and feed in the strength of Yahuah (LORD)* and be *great unto the ends of the earth* (Micah 5:4) is the staff and the light of the restored witness — *the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart*.
cards.s_text: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of Yahuah (LORD), in the majesty of the name of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God); and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
cards.t_text: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.

cards.note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The afflicting spirit that seized the man is exactly what Enoch described — and it knows its Judge. When the Holy One of Elohim commands, the bound offspring of the Watchers must obey; the sentence already gone forth against them stands.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) rebuked him, saying, Hold your peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
cards.t_text: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.

cards.note: *[As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]* (1 Enoch 15:10). Enoch names the origin of the unclean spirits: they are the disembodied spirits of the giants, the offspring of the fallen Watchers, loosed upon the earth. This is the *unclean devil* the Son confronts.
cards.s_text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth? are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are; the Holy One of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: [As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]

cards.note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The library names the unclean spirits Yahusha casts out — the disembodied spirits of the fallen Watchers' giant offspring, the very strong man's armoury now overcome.
cards.s_text: When a strong man armed keeps his palace, his goods are in peace:
cards.t_text: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.

cards.note: *And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before Yahuah (God) of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth* (1 Enoch 40:7). The seer beholds the very court of Job 1 — the adversaries who would *present themselves before Yahuah* (Job 1:6) and go *to and fro in the earth* (Job 1:7) to accuse — and an angelic voice forbidding their accusation. The library reads its own scene: the Accuser is a real, restrained adversary, fended off before the throne.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Whence come you? Then Satan answered Yahuah (LORD), and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
cards.t_text: And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.
