cards.note: Jubilees records the same fall: *And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants* (Jubilees 5:1). When the night-voice says *his angels he charged with folly* (Job 4:18), Jubilees and Enoch supply the history — the servants Yahuah put no trust in are these.
cards.s_text: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
cards.t_text: And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.

cards.note: The 1 Enoch witness names the folly directly, the charge spoken against the Watchers: *Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons?* (1 Enoch 15:3). *His angels he charged with folly* (Job 4:18) — this is that folly, the watchers who abandoned the holy heaven, the Genesis 6 rebellion the apparatus carries.
cards.s_text: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
cards.t_text: Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons?

cards.note: *And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells* (1 Enoch 7:2). The restored Watcher-witness names the origin of the giant line: the Nephilim begotten when the sons of Elohim took wives of the daughters of men (Genesis 6). Og, *of the remnant of giants* (Deuteronomy 3:11) with his iron bedstead *nine cubits... the length thereof*, is a surviving stump of that judged seed — the conquest finishing what the flood began.
cards.s_text: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
cards.t_text: And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells:

cards.note: The flesh restored is the earth giving back its dead: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received* (1 Enoch 51:1). Job's *in my flesh shall I see Eloah (God)* (Job 19:26) is this same restitution — the body the grave consumed given back, the dust returning its trust at the rising of the Elect One.
cards.s_text: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see Elohim (God):
cards.t_text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

cards.note: *Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink wine in large bowls, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.* (1 Enoch 96:5). Enoch's woe names Job's strong man — *He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life* (Job 24:22). The same trampling power that makes men despair of their lives is the very thing heaven marks for woe.
cards.s_text: He draws also the mighty with his power: he rises up, and no man is sure of life.
cards.t_text: Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink wine in large bowls, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.

cards.note: *Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.* (1 Enoch 96:8). *They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low* (Job 24:24). Enoch's woe to the mighty who oppress the righteous says the same: the day of their destruction is coming. The might does not keep.
cards.s_text: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
cards.t_text: Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.

cards.note: *I saw the treasuries of all the winds: I saw how He had furnished with them the whole creation and the firm foundations of the earth.* (1 Enoch 18:1). Enoch is shown the very *corner stone* of Job 38:6 — the world founded by Wisdom, the pillars on which the earth is set.
cards.s_text: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
cards.t_text: I saw the treasuries of all the winds: I saw how He had furnished with them the whole creation and the firm foundations of the earth.

cards.note: *And through it the earth was founded upon the water, And from the secret recesses of the mountains come beautiful waters, From the creation of the world and unto eternity.* (1 Enoch 69:17). The sea *shut up... with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb* (Job 38:8) is bound by the same creating oath — the sand its appointed limit, which it dare not overpass.
cards.s_text: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
cards.t_text: And through it the earth was founded upon the water, And from the secret recesses of the mountains come beautiful waters, From the creation of the world and unto eternity.

cards.note: *Observe ye everything that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, and the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order* (1 Enoch 2:1). This IS the *ordinances of heaven* (Job 38:33): the luminaries keeping their seasons, the fixed order Enoch is told to observe — the appointed-times calendar that governs the earth.
cards.s_text: Know you the ordinances of heaven? can you set the dominion thereof in the earth?
cards.t_text: Observe ye everything that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, and the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order.

cards.note: *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.* (1 Enoch 18:15). The *ordinances of heaven* (Job 38:33) are commandment: even the stars are judged by whether they come forth at their *appointed times* — the fixed order no man can set, which Yahuah alone governs.
cards.s_text: Know you the ordinances of heaven? can you set the dominion thereof in the earth?
cards.t_text: And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.

cards.note: 'But the male is named Behemoth, who occupies with his breast a waste wilderness named Dudain, east of the garden where the elect and righteous dwell' (1 Enoch 60:8). Enoch names Behemoth outright and gives him his appointed place — the untameable beast of Job 40:19 set in his bounds by El, who alone 'can make his sword to approach unto him.'
cards.s_text: He is the chief of the ways of Elohim (God): he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
cards.t_text: But the male is named Behemoth, who occupied with his breast a waste wilderness named Dûidâin, on the east of the garden where the elect and righteous dwell, where my grandfather was taken up, the seventh from Adam, the first man whom Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits created.

cards.note: 'And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster whose name is Leviathan, dwelling in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters' (1 Enoch 60:7). The restored Enoch names the very pair Job 40 sets before us — Behemoth its mate — confirming that the chief of the ways of Elohim (God) (Job 40:19) is no myth but a real creature appointed and bounded by its Maker.
cards.s_text: He is the chief of the ways of Elohim (God): he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
cards.t_text: And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster named Leviathan, to dwell in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters.

cards.note: *And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster named Leviathan, to dwell in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters.* (1 Enoch 60:7). The restored witness names the same abyss-monster the LORD reserves:  (1 Enoch 60:7). Job's *Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook?* (Job 41:1) asks of a creature of the deep that man cannot reach — held in the abyss under Yahuah's (God's) hand alone.
cards.s_text: Can you draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which you lettest down?
cards.t_text: And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster named Leviathan, to dwell in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters.

cards.note: *And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.* (1 Enoch 14:18). *I saw Yahuah (the LORD) sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him* (1 Kings 22:19). Enoch saw the same throne — lofty, crystal, cherubim about it, ten thousand times ten thousand before him (1 Enoch 14:22). The restored witness joins the prophets: Yahuah (Lord) is enthroned in the heights, the host attending.
cards.s_text: And he said, Hear you therefore the word of Yahuah (LORD): I saw Yahuah (LORD) sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
cards.t_text: And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.

cards.note: *By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim (God)* (Hebrews 11:5). The roll of faith names Enoch's translation as the type; *Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven* (2 Kings 2:11) is its second witness — the prophet who pleased Yahuah and *should not see death*.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
cards.t_text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim (God).

cards.note: *And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him* (Genesis 5:24). As *Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven* (2 Kings 2:11), he joins Enoch — the second man translated alive, not tasting death. The seed-line keeps a standing testimony that death is not the last word.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
cards.t_text: And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him.

cards.note: *And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him* (Genesis 5:24). When *Yahuah (LORD) would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind* (2 Kings 2:1), it is the Enoch pattern repeated — the man of Yahuah who does not see death but is taken by Elohim directly. Two witnesses across the whole canon to the same escape from the grave.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, when Yahuah (LORD) would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
cards.t_text: And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him.

cards.note: *And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood and stone and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.* (1 Enoch 99:7). Enoch puts idol-worship and demon-worship in one breath, just as the Song does — *to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up* (Deuteronomy 32:17) — *whom your fathers feared not*.
cards.s_text: They sacrificed unto devils, not to Elohim (God); to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
cards.t_text: And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood and stone and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.

cards.note: *And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.* (1 Enoch 1:4) Enoch's opening parable names the very mountain — Yahuah treading on Sinai in his might — the same theophany Moses blesses by: *Yahuah (LORD) came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran* (Deuteronomy 33:2).
cards.s_text: And he said, Yahuah (LORD) came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
cards.t_text: And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.

cards.note: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). *He came with ten thousands of saints* (Deuteronomy 33:2). Enoch's ten thousands of holy ones are the same accompanying host — the verse Jude later quotes by name. The Formed One comes attended by the holy ones.
cards.s_text: And he said, Yahuah (LORD) came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
cards.t_text: And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.

cards.note: *And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 49:4). The judgment of *every secret thing* (Ecclesiastes 12:14) is committed to the Elect One — the Formed Son before whom no secret and no lie can stand, sealing the conclusion of the whole matter.
cards.s_text: For Elohim (God) shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
cards.t_text: And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits according to His good pleasure.

cards.note: *And again Yahuah (God) said to Raphael: 'Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein* (1 Enoch 10:4). The live goat is the goat *for the scapegoat* (Hebrew Azazel), sent *by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness* (Leviticus 16:21); 1 Enoch names Azazel bound and cast into the desert to bear the corruption — the wilderness as the place where defilement is removed from the camp of Yahuah.
cards.s_text: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
cards.t_text: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.

cards.note: *And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) cometh with ten thousands of his saints* (Jude 1:14). Where the Chronicler writes *Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech* (1 Chronicles 1:3), the New Testament counts him: Enoch is *the seventh from Adam* — the seventh name in this very seed-line — and a prophet of the coming of Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
cards.t_text: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) comes with ten thousands of his saints,

cards.note: *And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells* (1 Enoch 7:2). The restored witness names the origin of the giant-seed: the Watchers' offspring, the same line whose remnant -- *of the children of the giant* (1 Chronicles 20:4) -- David's men were still cutting off in the land generations later.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
cards.t_text: And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells:

cards.note: *And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells:* (1 Enoch 7:2) The *giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants* of Numbers 13:33 are the brood the Watchers' rebellion loosed upon the earth -- the Nephilim whose monstrous stature 1 Enoch records. They are the seed-war flesh that swallowed the unbelieving eye, so that *we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight* (Numbers 13:33).
cards.s_text: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
cards.t_text: And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells:

cards.note: *'And' then shall ye see Enoch, Noah, and Shem, and Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, rising on the right hand in gladness. Then shall we also rise, each one over our tribe, worshipping the King of heaven... Then also all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame. And Yahuah (Lord) shall judge Yashar'el (Israel) first, for their unrighteousness... And then shall He judge all the Gentiles...* (Testament of Benjamin 10:6-9). John sees *the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God)... and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works* (Revelation 20:12). Benjamin's *all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame* is that standing of small and great: the rising first, then the judging.
cards.s_text: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
cards.t_text: Then also all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame. And Yahuah (Lord) shall judge Yashar'el (Israel) first, for their unrighteousness; [for when He appeared as Elohim (God) in the flesh to deliver them they believed Him not].

cards.note: *'And' then shall ye see Enoch, Noah, and Shem, and Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, rising on the right hand in gladness. Then shall we also rise, each one over our tribe, worshipping the King of heaven... Then also all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame. And Yahuah (Lord) shall judge Yashar'el (Israel) first, for their unrighteousness... And then shall He judge all the Gentiles...* (Testament of Benjamin 10:6-9). Benjamin sets the rising in order: the fathers first, then the sons each over his tribe, and last *all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame,* and then the judging. Revelation names that last hour: *the time of the dead, that they should be judged* (Revelation 11:18). The fathers and the tribes rise before; the rising of all men, to glory or to shame, comes at the time of the dead, when the one judgment is set.
cards.s_text: And the nations were angry, and your wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that you should give reward unto your servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear your name, small and great; and should destroy them which destroy the earth.
cards.t_text: Then also all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame. And Yahuah (Lord) shall judge Yashar'el (Israel) first, for their unrighteousness; [for when He appeared as Elohim (God) in the flesh to deliver them they believed Him not].

cards.note: *And there I saw Enoch and all who were with him, stript of the garments of the flesh, and I saw them in their garments of the upper world, and they were like angels, standing there in great glory.* (Ascension of Isaiah 9:9). Those on high are seen *stript of the garments of the flesh* and clothed *in their garments of the upper world* — the garments of 4:17, where the saints *turn themselves upward in their garments, and their body will be left in the world.* So the catching-up Paul names — *caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet Yahusha (Lord) in the air: and so shall we ever be with Yahusha (Lord)* (1 Thessalonians 4:17) — is a going up out of the garments of the flesh into the garments of the upper world, after the reign.
cards.s_text: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
cards.t_text: And there I saw Enoch and all who were with him, stript of the garments of the flesh, and I saw them in their garments of the upper world, and they were like angels, standing there in great glory.

members.member_note: The Son of Adam named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits — before sun and stars. The Yahusha (Jesus) named at Matt 1:21 IS the figure 1 Enoch 48:2 names by title.
His name was named before the sun and the signs were created. The pre-existent naming the framework reads as the Formed's existence-before-creation.
Chosen and hidden before the creation of the world — the Formed-pre-existent who becomes Immanuel.

The enthronement of the Elect One — Yahuah of Spirits named him and seated him. The Messianic-enthronement the apostolic witness will articulate at the resurrection (Acts 13:33, Phil 2:9-11) is named here before the world began.
The revelation of the name of the Son of Adam to the holy ones — the name itself is the gospel, and the Hebrew library named it before the angel announced it to Yoseph (Joseph).

The Book of Luminaries opening — *the book of the courses of the luminaries of the heaven, the relations of each, according to their classes, their dominion and their seasons.* The Hebrew prophetic-astronomy the Magi inherited.
The Messianic-figure white-bull vision of the Animal Apocalypse — what the Magi who knew the Hebrew prophetic tradition were watching for.
The Lamb who is also the great-horned one — *that lamb became a great animal and had great black horns on its head.* The Messianic-Lamb / King doubled identity the Magi recognized in the star.

*Let the plant of righteousness and truth appear* — 1 Enoch 10:16's extracanonical Branch-Messiah register. The *netser* of Isaiah 11:1 and the *plant of righteousness* of 1 Enoch name the same figure; Matt 2:23 anchors the figure geographically at Natsareth (Nazareth) — *Branch-town.*

1 Enoch 10:16 again — read at Matt 3:10: the destruction of the wrong-bearing trees is the clearing for the plant of righteousness to appear. The Hebrew library names the post-harvest sifting at the front of the gathering.
1 Enoch 14:18 — the Throne-room the open heaven gives access to. Sapphire, fire, the Father on the Throne; the cosmological room into which Matt 3:16's opened heaven gives access.
1 Enoch 71:1 — Enoch's ascent into the heavens and the revelation of the Son of Adam. The Throne-room the Father's voice speaks from at Matt 3:17.

Luke uniquely says *the heaven was opened* (rather than Matthew's *heavens were opened to him*) — the opening of heaven at the investiture is the same priestly-installation pattern 1 Enoch carries. The Son is installed in the priestly office by the Father's voice from the open heaven.

1 Enoch 49:3 — *in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might.* The Spirit-pattern on the Elect One; Isaiah 11:2 in the Hebrew library's parallel witness.

1 Enoch 40:5 — *the voice of the Holy One ... in the heaven, and the voice of the Elect One ... from the throne of glory.* The doubled Father / Son voice the Hebrew library promises; Matt 3:17 enacts the Father side publicly.
1 Enoch 71:14 — the direct Father-voice naming the Son of Adam: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* The construction Matt 3:17 enacts at the Yarden (Jordan).
1 Enoch 6:1 — the opening of the Watcher-rebellion narrative.
1 Enoch 6:2 — the lust-and-beget mechanism by which the Watchers seeded the tares into the human race.
1 Enoch 10:9 — the judgment specifically against *the children of the Watchers,* the post-Flood persistence of the planted seed-line.

1 Enoch 8:1 — *Azazel taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates.* The Watcher who taught forbidden arts; the leading edge of the rebellion that seeded the corruption of the earth.

1 Enoch 10:4 — *Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dudael, and cast him therein.* The Hebrew library locates the Watcher-chief's binding judgment IN THE WILDERNESS — the same ground Matt 4:1 names as the location of Yahusha's (Jesus's) temptation.

1 Enoch 10:5 — *cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever, and cover his face that he may not see light.* The completion of the wilderness-binding; Yahusha (Jesus) walks the testing-arc on the bound Watcher's ground.

1 Enoch 10:8 — *the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azazel: to him ascribe all sin.* The Yom Kippur scapegoat-for-Azazel architecture (Leviticus 16:10 in shorthand); Matt 4:1 places Yahusha (Jesus) in the wilderness in the same register.

1 Enoch 90:6 — *lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see.* The late-age awakening of the lambs; the fishers-of-men commission at Matt 4:19 enters the gathering of the scattered-and-now-awakening sheep.

*But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.* (1 Enoch 1:8). *Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 5:3). The blessing is not an entry fee; it is the Father's own word over those who are already his. Enoch heard the same word before the Beatitudes were spoken: peace, protection, mercy, belonging — pronounced over the elect, not offered to applicants.

1 Enoch 1:8 — *with the righteous He will make peace ... light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.* The comfort-and-light promise on the elect; Matt 5:4's *they shall be comforted* walks the same architecture.
1 Enoch 58:2 — *Blessed are ye, ye righteous and elect, For glorious shall be your lot.* Beatitude-form pronounced over the gathered in the Hebrew library; Matt 5:10 walks the same.

*And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy without number.* (1 Enoch 58:3). *Ye are the light of the world* (Matthew 5:14) — not *become*; *are.* Enoch says why: the righteous are set in the light of the sun and the elect in the light of eternal life. The light the disciples carry is the light they were placed in.

1 Enoch 38:4 — *those that possess the earth shall no longer be strong and exalted ... for Yahuah (God) of Spirits has appeared upon the throne of His glory.* The throne-of-glory appearing; Matt 5:14's *city set on an hill* foreshadows the consummation-city.

*And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.* (1 Enoch 38:2). *Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 5:16). Enoch saw the day the light appears on the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth — and the question that day asks of the sinners. The shining is the Father's doing; the glory goes to him.

1 Enoch 99:2 — *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law.* The woe-pattern against the alter-and-transgress diagnostic; Matt 5:19's kingdom-status diagnostic walks the same architecture.

*Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.* (1 Enoch 104:9). Enoch's charge to his children is the charge Matthew 5:19 makes to every teacher: do not alter the words of uprightness. *Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven.* To alter the words and to teach men so are one act; both are named here before the gospel names them.

*And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.* (1 Enoch 104:10). Enoch knew the mystery before the pulpit practised it: sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness, and write books about it. *Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so* (Matthew 5:19) — the teaching is the perverting; the books are the sermons. The kingdom-status of such teachers was fixed long before the sermon was preached.

*And they said to Yahuah (Lord) of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim (God) of gods, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!* (1 Enoch 9:4). Enoch's angels pray what the disciples are taught to pray: the holy and blessed name, the throne of glory that stands to all generations, the King of kings. *Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come* (Matthew 6:9–10) is the same prayer in the mouth of the children.

*‘Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (Lord), King, Great and mighty in Thy greatness, Yahuah (Lord) of the whole creation of the heaven, King of kings and Elohim (God) of the whole world. And Thy power and kingship and greatness abide for ever and ever, And throughout all generations Thy dominion; And all the heavens are Thy throne for ever, And the whole earth Thy footstool for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 84:2). *Hallowed be thy name* (Matthew 6:9). Enoch's own prayer blesses the King whose dominion is through all generations and whose throne is the heavens. The disciples are taught to pray what the patriarch prayed.

*Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.* (1 Enoch 9:5). The One whose kingdom the disciples pray to come is the One who made all things and holds power over all things, from whom nothing hides. *Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven* (Matthew 6:10) asks nothing new; it asks that what is already true in heaven be seen on earth.

1 Enoch 94:1 — *paths of righteousness ... paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed.* The Two-Ways teaching in the patriarch's wisdom-testimony; Matt 7:13's wide gate to destruction walks the same.
1 Enoch 94:2 — *certain men of a generation ... shall not find mercy.* The Hebrew library's asymmetric few-walk-aright architecture; Matt 7:14's *few there be that find it* walks the same.

*And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *Many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Avraham (Abraham), and Yitschaq (Isaac), and Ya'aqov (Jacob), in the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 8:11). Enoch saw the sitting-down: all that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in the house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoicing because they had returned. The many from east and west are the dispersed of the house coming home — the scattered sheep, not a new flock.

1 Enoch 46:1 — *I saw One who had a head of days ... and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man.* The throne-room vision's opening; the Head of Days with the Christ-figure beside Him before the incarnation.

*And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). Enoch asks who *that Son of Adam* is — a figure named by title, standing beside the Head of Days. When Yahusha (Jesus) says *the Son of Adam hath not where to lay his head* (Matthew 8:20) he takes that title for himself: the named one of the Parables, now with no bed on the earth he came to.

1 Enoch 46:3 — *the Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* The Christ identified by role — chosen, pre-eminent, revealer of hidden treasures; Matt 8:20 walks the same identification at the King's own self-naming.

1 Enoch 15:11 — *the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth.* The spirits-from-the-giants demon-origin architecture; Matt 8:28's demoniacs walk the same.

1 Enoch 48:2 — *at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* The Similitudes name the Son of Adam's pre-existence-and-naming-before-the-Head-of-Days; Matt 9:6's authority-on-earth is the in-flesh exercise of the eternally-pre-existent figure.

1 Enoch 48:3 — *yea, before the sun and the signs were created ... His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* The pre-existence is named before creation itself; the in-flesh exercise of the Father's forgiveness-prerogative at Matt 9:6 is the present-tense demonstration of what the figure had before the foundation of the world.

1 Enoch 71:14 — *this is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him.* The Son of Adam's righteousness-abides-eternally architecture; Matt 9:6's authority to forgive sins is the present-tense exercise of the righteousness that abides over him.

*And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). The shepherds who were set over the sheep and destroyed more than they were bidden end here, judged and cast into the fiery abyss. When Yahusha (Jesus) saw the multitudes *as sheep having no shepherd* (Matthew 9:36), he was looking at the flock those shepherds had left; the vision had already recorded their sentence.

*And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.* (1 Enoch 90:29). The shepherdless sheep of Matthew 9:36 are not left shepherdless. Enoch saw the Lord of the sheep bring a new house, greater and loftier than the first, with all the sheep within it. The compassion that moved him at the sight of the scattered flock is the compassion that builds the house.

*And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *When he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad* (Matthew 9:36). Enoch saw where the scattering ends: all that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in the house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoicing because they had returned.

*I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.* (1 Enoch 104:1). *Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 10:32). Enoch swears to the righteous that their names are already written before the glory of the Great One. The Son confesses before the Father the ones whose names were written before they ever confessed.

*And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.* (1 Enoch 103:4). *But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 10:33). Enoch's word to the righteous who die in righteousness is that their memorial does not perish before the Great One. The warning of Matthew 10:33 is the other side of that promise: a memorial can be kept, and a name can be blotted out (1 Enoch 108:3). The denier is not a tare who never had a name; he is wheat that did not endure.

1 Enoch 99:5 — *in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them.* The wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-day-of-destruction household-disintegration; Matt 10:35's *I am come to set a man at variance against his father* walks the same household-division-pattern at the kingdom-hearing-of-his-voice register.

1 Enoch 100:1 — *the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten, And brothers one with another shall fall in death.* The wisdom-stream's explicit family-betrayal-in-the-day-of-destruction; Matt 10:36's *a man's foes shall be they of his own household* walks the same diagnostic in the present-age kingdom-hearing register.

*But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.* (1 Enoch 1:8). The answer sent to Yochanan (John) — *the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them* (Matthew 11:5) — is the peace, protection, mercy, and light Enoch saw promised to the righteous, now arriving in flesh.

*And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.* (1 Enoch 10:17). Enoch saw the days when the righteous escape and complete their years in peace, the earth tilled in righteousness and cleansed of oppression (1 Enoch 10:17–22). The works Yahusha (Jesus) lists for Yochanan (John) at Matthew 11:5 are the first fruits of those days — the age Enoch saw, beginning.

1 Enoch 46:1 — *I saw One who had a head of days ... and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man.* The wisdom-stream's Father-Son architecture at the apocalyptic-register; Matt 11:25-27 names the same architecture operative in the King's own voice.

1 Enoch 46:3 — *this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.* The Red Line #12 title-naming case (kaph-comparative NOT operative); the Son-of-Adam-revealing-mysteries architecture Matt 11:27 names operative.

1 Enoch 48:6 — *for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* The Red Line #11 names-written-before-the-foundation architecture extended to the Son himself; Matt 11:27's unique-mutual-knowledge between the chosen-and-hidden-Son and the Father.

1 Enoch 48:7 — *the wisdom of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous.* The revelation-economy aligned with Red Line #11's seed-war-hearing-pattern; Matt 11:25's *hid from the wise and prudent, revealed unto babes* names the same architecture.

*Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.* (1 Enoch 95:7). *Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him* (Matthew 12:14). Enoch's woe already names them: sinners who persecute the righteous, and the heavy yoke that waits for them. The council against the Righteous One is the act the woe was written for.

1 Enoch 49:1 — *for wisdom is poured out like water ... he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness.* The wisdom-stream's direct wisdom-poured-out-on-the-Elect-One architecture; Matt 12:18 names the operative-fact at the Galilean-ministry.

1 Enoch 49:3 — *in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might.* The wisdom-stream restatement of Isaiah 11:2's four-spirits-cluster applied to the Elect-One; the same Spirit-anointing Matt 12:18 names operative.

*And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). *Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles* (Matthew 12:18). Enoch saw the same: the spirit of righteousness poured out on the Elect One seated on the throne, and the word of his mouth bringing judgment. The servant of Isaiah and the Elect One of the Parables are one figure, and the Spirit upon him is the same Spirit.

*The Spirit of Yahuah (the Lord) is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised, to preach the acceptable year of Yahuah (the Lord).* Luke 4:18-19 IS the Spirit-anointed-Elect-One-self-identification — the same 1 Enoch 49 / 62 register Matthew 12:18 carries, here read by the Son from the scroll at the Natsareth (Nazareth) synagogue and applied to himself in real time. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

1 Enoch 10:4 — *bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness ... cover him with darkness.* The wisdom-stream's binding-of-the-watchers-leader-Azazel architecture; the King's exorcisms-and-spoiling at Matt 12:28-29 are the inaugurated-form.

1 Enoch 54:5 — *these are being prepared for the hosts of Azazel, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation.* The wisdom-stream's chains-prepared-and-abyss-of-condemnation architecture; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-action that culminates here.

*No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.* The Markan parallel to Matthew 12:29's binding-of-the-strong-man — the same architecture, 1 Enoch 10's chaining of Azazel hand-and-foot and Jubilees 10's binding of nine-tenths of the malignant spirits underlying both gospel-witnesses. The King's ministry is the incursion that binds the strong-man so the captives can be released.

1 Enoch 10:4 — *Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness ... and cast him therein.* The binding-of-the-watcher-leader Azazel; Luke 11:22's *a stronger than he ... taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils* walks the inaugurated form of the binding-architecture the wisdom-stream named.

The Lukan Beelzebub-controversy and the divided-house argument — same architecture as Matthew 12 / Mark 3, with the *stronger-than-he* binding-the-strong-man substance the framework reads as the Watcher-binding architecture from 1 Enoch 10 / Jubilees 10.

*And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.* (1 Enoch 65:11). *But the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Ghost) shall not be forgiven unto men* (Matthew 12:32). Enoch heard the sentence on those who showed what was hidden and became the damned: no place of repentance for ever. There is a sin that closes the door from the inside; the Pharisees who called the Spirit's work the work of Beelzebub stood at that door.

1 Enoch 51:1 — *the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received.* The wisdom-stream's earth-and-Sheol-and-hell-giving-back architecture; Matt 12:40 names the inaugurated-form in the King's future-resurrection.

*And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). *Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given* (Matthew 13:11). Enoch says who the *you* are: the holy and righteous to whom the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits reveals him, who have hated this world of unrighteousness. The revealing follows the belonging; it does not create it.

*And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). *Then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart* (Matthew 13:19). Enoch names the spirits of the Watchers assuming many forms, leading mankind astray — the actor behind the catching-away. He is not a figure of speech; the restored library records his origin and his end.

1 Enoch 6:1 — *the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.* THE foundational wisdom-stream anchor for the tares-sown-by-the-enemy architecture; the watchers' incursion produces the corrupted-line operating-within-the-field-of-the-world.

*And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.* (1 Enoch 10:9). *The tares are the children of the wicked one* (Matthew 13:38). Enoch names them before the parable does: the children of the Watchers, a seed with a father of its own, distinguished from the line of Adam and marked for destruction. The tares are not bad wheat; they are another seed.

1 Enoch 15:8 — *the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth.* The wisdom-stream names the spirits-of-the-giants as evil-spirits-on-the-earth; the operative-instruments of the wicked-one's sowing across the age operate-on-the-earth as the spirits-of-the-corrupted-line.

Jubilees 5:1 — *the angels of Yahuah (the Lord) saw them ... and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare unto them sons and they were giants.* The wisdom-stream's second-witness to the watchers' incursion alongside 1 Enoch 6 — two-wisdom-stream witnesses establish the substance the King's parable names.

*In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth* (Matthew 13:42). Enoch saw the abyss of fire and the prison appointed for the Watchers — the furnace the parable names, already mapped.

*And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’* (1 Enoch 54:6). *The reapers are the angels* (Matthew 13:39), and here they are by name: Michael, Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, casting the hosts of Azazel into the burning furnace on the great day. The furnace of Matthew 13:42 has its angels, its day, and its reason — vengeance for leading astray those who dwell on the earth.

1 Enoch 104:2 — *now shall ye shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for Matt 13:43's righteous-shall-shine-forth-as-the-sun substance; the shall-be-seen + portals-of-heaven substance carries the kingdom-of-the-Father vindication-architecture.

1 Enoch 48:6 — *for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before him, before the creation of the world and for evermore.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for Matt 13:35's things-kept-secret-from-the-foundation-of-the-world; the Elect-One was-chosen-and-hidden-before-the-creation and revealed-at-the-appointed-time.

*And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *All these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables* (Matthew 13:34). Enoch had named the Son of Adam as the one who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden. The parables are that revealing — hidden things opened, by the one chosen to open them.

1 Enoch 100:5 — *over all the righteous and holy he will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels to guard them as the apple of an eye.* The wisdom-stream names the angelic-architecture; the Son-of-Adam-sends-the-angels at Matt 13:41, 49 for both the gathering-of-the-righteous AND the severing-of-the-wicked.

*And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’* (1 Enoch 22:7). *The good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one* (Matthew 13:38). The seed war is older than the parable. Enoch is shown the spirit of Hevel (Abel), the first righteous blood, making its suit against the seed of Qayin (Cain) until that seed is gone from among the seed of men. Two seeds, from Genesis 4 to the harvest.

*And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). *Whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?* (Matthew 16:13). The question uses the title Enoch asked about — *that Son of Adam,* the one who went with the Head of Days. The King asks whether men have recognized the figure the Parables named.

*And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). *Thou art the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God)* (Matthew 16:16). Kefa (Peter) confesses what Enoch was told: the Son of Adam who has righteousness, whom Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has chosen, whose lot has the pre-eminence for ever. The confession at Caesarea Philippi is the angel's answer at 1 Enoch 46:3, spoken on earth.

1 Enoch 48:2 — *that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the heavenly-naming-of-the-Christ at the throne — Kefa's (Peter's)-confession articulates the earthly-confession of the same architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the heavenly-throne-pivot.

1 Enoch 48:3 — *before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the before-the-foundation-of-the-world naming. The Father's-revelation to Kefa (Peter) at Matt 16:17 reveals what was always true — the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates at the Father's revealing the same substance the wisdom-stream had carried.

*For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.* (1 Enoch 49:2). *I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 16:19). The secrets of righteousness belong to the Elect One who stands before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits; the keys Kefa (Peter) receives are stewardship of what is his. The one who holds the secrets delegates their opening.

*And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3). *I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 16:19). Enoch saw the Elect One seated on the Father's throne, his mouth pouring out the secrets of wisdom and counsel. The keys are given by the one who sits on that throne; the house of David's key (Isaiah 22:22) is on his shoulder before it is in Kefa's (Peter's) hand.

*And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *Flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 16:17). The Father's naming of the Son of Adam at 1 Enoch 71:14 is the same revealing — the Head of Days declaring who he is. Kefa (Peter) receives on earth what Enoch heard in heaven, and the keys follow the revealing.

*And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.* (1 Enoch 69:27). *Whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven* (Matthew 16:19). The sum of judgement was given to the Son of Adam on the throne of his glory; what the apostles bind and loose is bound and loosed under that judgement, not beside it.

1 Enoch 51:1 — *Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, and hell shall give back that which it owes.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Sheol-giving-back-the-dead substance — the resurrection-architecture the gates-of-hell-shall-not-prevail at v.18 enacts at the gospel-pivot.
All the righteous escape and live — the gathering completing; Enoch witnesses the end declared from the beginning

*And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* (1 Enoch 8:1). *Whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck* (Matthew 18:6). The stumbling-blocks laid across the way of the little ones have a history: Azazel taught men the arts that became the snares. The millstone is the King's answer to the teacher of the snare.

1 Enoch 10:8 — *The whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the inevitability-of-offences-in-the-present-age substance — the architecture under the King's *it must needs be that offences come* at Matt 18:7. The inevitability does-not-excuse the man-by-whom-the-offence-comes; the offence-coming-of-necessity is the architectural-consequence of the corruption-already-running.

1 Enoch 19:1 — *Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the lying-spirits-leading-astray in many-forms across the present-age — the architecture under every-system-of-stumbling-block the King's Matt 18:7 woe lands-on (the four-costumes of the antichrist-architecture per voice skill's framework). Patience-not-condescension toward the little-ones-led-astray as victims-not-enemies; the woe is system-and-leadership-aimed.

*Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.* (1 Enoch 22:11). *It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea* (Matthew 18:6). Better than what? Than the place Enoch was shown — spirits set apart in great pain until the great day of judgement, and bound there. The sea is the lesser end.

1 Enoch 27:2 — *This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (the Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the accursed-valley-of-judgment substance — the Watcher-Book passage describing the valley at the centre of the holy mountain that pre-figures the *gei-Hinnom* (Valley of the sons of Hinnom) on the southern-edge of Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) the King's gehenna at Matt 18:9 names.

*And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’* (1 Enoch 40:9). *In heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 18:10). Enoch is given the names of the four who stand before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits — mercy, healing, power, and repentance unto hope. The little ones are watched over from the throne itself.

*And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.* (1 Enoch 90:18). *For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost* (Matthew 18:11). The Lord of the sheep comes to the flock in person, staff in hand, and the beasts and birds that devoured them are swallowed by the earth. The saving of the lost is the Lord of the sheep arriving.

*And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.* (1 Enoch 89:54). *If a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?* (Matthew 18:12). Enoch's vision names the owner of the flock: Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, whose house and tower the sheep forsook. The shepherd of the parable is not a hired man; he is the Lord of the sheep seeking his own.

*And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *He rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray* (Matthew 18:13). Enoch saw that joy at the end: the Lord of the sheep rejoicing with great joy because all that had been dispersed had returned to his house. The parable's one sheep is the vision's whole flock.

1 Enoch 90:6 — *Behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the lambs-that-open-their-eyes substance — the post-judgment opening of the eyes-of-the-sheep-who-had-been-blinded under the seventy-shepherds-administration; the architecture under Matt 18:14's Father's-will *that one of these little ones should perish* not-be — the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11, NOT universalist-overriding-determinism.

*Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.* (1 Enoch 94:8). *A rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 19:23). Enoch's woe says why: those who trust in riches depart from them, having not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of their wealth. The difficulty is not the money; it is the trust.

*Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.* (1 Enoch 97:7). *A rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 19:23). The young ruler's confidence — *all these things have I kept from my youth up* — is the sinner's confidence Enoch names: a remembrance that is evil against him, however secure the holdings look.

*And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,* (1 Enoch 97:9). *It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God)* (Matthew 19:24). Enoch gives the rich man's own speech — silver gathered, granaries full, *let us do what we purposed.* That speech is the needle's eye closing.

1 Enoch 98:10 — *ye shall depart and die; For ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement.* The Enochic *ye know no ransom* substance — the architecture the disciples' *who then can be saved?* at Matt 19:25 presupposes-the-failure-of (riches as ransom is failed-substance; the rich-as-blessed-by-default-substance is inherited-substance that-collapses against the Enochic and the King's warning).

*And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.* (1 Enoch 100:6). *With men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible* (Matthew 19:26). Enoch saw the day the children of the earth understand that riches cannot save them. What riches cannot do, Elohim (God) does — that is the whole of the disciples' hope, and the whole of the rich man's.

*But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.* The Lukan Woes are the 1 Enoch 94-100 woes-on-the-rich register in the King's own mouth — the reversal-architecture Wisdom of Solomon 3 and 5 also carry. The woes are paired with the blessings so the reader hears both sides of the post-harvest sifting at once.

The Lukan rich-young-ruler parallel to Matthew 19, where the woes-on-the-rich architecture from 1 Enoch 94-100 carries the same substance. *It is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).*

*And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.* (1 Enoch 62:8). *So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen* (Matthew 20:16). Enoch saw the chosen gathered: the congregation of the elect and holy sown, and all the elect standing before him on that day. The few are not fewer because they tried harder; they are the elect, and the elect are revealed by their standing.

1 Enoch 48:1 — *I saw the fountain of righteousness which was inexhaustible: and around it were many fountains of wisdom: and all the thirsty drank of them, and were filled with wisdom.* The broad-proclamation-substance that reaches-the-many — the gospel-proclamation goes-out broadly at Matt 20:16's *many be called* because the citizens-of-the-kingdom are scattered-among-the-nations and the proclaimers do-not-know-the-citizens-by-sight.

1 Enoch 46:3 — *this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the named Son-of-Adam-who-hath-righteousness substance — the same Son-of-Adam the King names at Matt 20:28 as the One who-came-not-to-be-ministered-unto-but-to-minister-and-give-his-life-a-ransom-for-many. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR per Red Line #12's Son-of-Adam-restoration.

1 Enoch 48:2 — *at that hour that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days.* The Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation substance — the substantial-ransom at Matt 20:28 was determined by-the-Father from-before-the-foundation-of-the-world (per Hitgalut (Revelation) 13:8's *Lamb slain from the foundation of the world*); the substantial-coming-of-the-Son-of-Adam is NOT a defeat-imposed-by-circumstances but the substance the Son walked-into-knowingly under-the-Father's-determination from-before-the-foundation.

*And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *The Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many* (Matthew 20:28). The same Son of Adam, Enoch saw, raises the kings and the mighty from their seats and breaks the teeth of the sinners. The one who serves is the one who judges; the ransom and the reckoning belong to the same hands.

*But He remained unmoved, though He saw it, and rejoiced that they were devoured and swallowed and robbed, and left them to be devoured in the hand of all the beasts.* (1 Enoch 89:58). *Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away* (Matthew 21:19). Enoch saw the Lord of the sheep do the same to a flock that had abandoned him: unmoved, leaving them to be devoured. The withered tree is the leadership that bore no fruit, left to its own harvest.

*And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). *He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen* (Matthew 21:41). The husbandmen answer their own parable; Enoch's vision records the sentence they pronounced — the seventy shepherds judged, found guilty, and cast into the fiery abyss.

1 Enoch 46:3 — *this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden ... whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor — the Parables-of-Enoch identify the Son-of-Adam by name (the named-title case per Red Line #12, NOT the kaph-comparative case); the substance the Pharisaic-answer at Matt 22:42 (*the son of David*) cannot-account-for is the pre-eminence-before-Yahuah-of-Spirits the wisdom-stream had named the substance for. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

1 Enoch 48:2 — *at that hour that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days.* The wisdom-stream articulation of the Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-Head-of-Days substance — the pre-existence and eternal-naming of the Son before the foundation of the world; the substance David-in-the-Spirit at Matt 22:43 calls *my Lord* is the substance 1 Enoch 48:2 had named before the Davidic-line existed. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

*And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3). *Yahuah (The LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand* (Matthew 22:44; Psalm 110:1). Enoch heard the same seating spoken by the Father: *the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne.* The Pharisees could not say how David's son is David's Lord; the Parables had already seated him.

*And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool* (Matthew 22:44). The Head of Days placing the Elect One on the throne of glory is Psalm 110:1 seen from the throne room — the Father seating the Son, the Son judging. The Formless seats the Formed; the One who is seated is Elohim (God) and has a Father.

*And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?* (Matthew 22:45). The Father answers at 1 Enoch 71:14: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* Born — David's son after the flesh; named by the Head of Days — David's Lord. The question the Pharisees could not answer, the Parables had answered.

1 Enoch 99:2 — *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, and transgress the eternal law, and transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners].* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the pervert-the-words-of-uprightness-and-transform-themselves-into-sinners substance — the substance the proselyte made-twofold-the-child-of-Gehinnom (Gehenna) at Matt 23:15 is converted-into. Fails the contrary-to-Torah-test the apostle-Yochanan (John) names at 1 John 2:3-4.

*And he said unto me: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’* (1 Enoch 21:10). *Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of Gehinnom (hell)?* (Matthew 23:33). Enoch was shown the prison of the angels and told it holds them for ever. The judgment the serpents cannot escape is the judgment their fathers, the Watchers, are already held for; the seed goes where the seed came from.

*And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’* (1 Enoch 22:7). *That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Hevel (Abel)* (Matthew 23:35). Enoch saw the spirit of Hevel (Abel) making its suit against the seed of Qayin (Cain) until that seed is destroyed. The blood that cries from the ground (Genesis 4:10) is still crying in Enoch's vision, and the King hands the sum of it to the generation standing in front of him.

1 Enoch 10:2 — *Go to Noach (Noah) and tell him in My Name "Hide thyself!" and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the proclamation-to-Noach (Noah) substance the King walks at Matt 24:37 — the Watcher-rebellion-and-judgment-pattern the substantial-end-of-the-age recapitulates per Jude 14-15 + 2 Peter 2:5 + 2 Peter 3:3-7.

*And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”* (1 Enoch 65:10). *As in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noach (Noah) entered into the ark* (Matthew 24:38). Enoch heard the sentence pronounced over those days: judgement determined, not to be withheld, the earth and its dwellers to be destroyed for the sorceries they had learned. The eating and drinking went on under a sentence already passed.

*In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be* (Matthew 24:39). The flood took the wicked away; it did not carry the righteous off. Enoch's word for the Watchers is the same taking: led off to the abyss of fire, to the prison. The ones taken at the coming are the ones taken at the flood — the judged.

1 Enoch 57:1 — *I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the *coming on the winds from the east, and from the west* substance the King walks at Matt 24:27 — the substantial-public-visible-second-coming substance against the substantial-modern-dispensational-Christian-secret-rapture-eschatology.

1 Enoch 57:2 — *the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the *from one end of heaven to the other* substance the King walks at Matt 24:31's four-winds-gathering — the substantial-cosmic-sound-from-end-to-end the wisdom-stream had named at the Parables; the King walks the substantial-substance at the Olivet-discourse.

1 Enoch 61:5 — *these measures shall reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth, and those who have been destroyed by the desert, and those who have been devoured by the beasts, and those who have been devoured by the fish of the sea, that they may return and stay themselves on the day of the Elect One.* The gathering-of-the-destroyed-and-devoured substance — the substantial-Father's-substance preserves the substantial-scattered-and-lost-of-the-seed-of-promise across the substantial-period and returns-them at the substantial-day-of-the-Elect-One; the architecture the substantial-four-winds-gathering at Matt 24:31 walks-within.

*And it looked at them [and their eyes opened], and it cried to the sheep, and the rams saw it and all ran to it.* (1 Enoch 90:10). *And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds* (Matthew 24:31). Enoch saw the gathering as a flock: the great horn cried to the sheep, their eyes opened, and the rams all ran to it. The gathering is the sheep running to the horn that called them.

*And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.* (1 Enoch 62:5). *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch saw that seat and the faces of those who see it — terror, pain, downcast countenance, when they see that Son of Adam sitting on the throne of his glory. The sheep-and-goats judgment opens on the throne the Parables had already set.

*And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.* (1 Enoch 61:10). *And all the holy angels with him* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch gives the roll: the host of the heavens, the holy ones above, Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophannim, the angels of power and of principalities — and the Elect One among them. The company of the coming was mustered in the Parables before the gospel named it.
