Three moves: Wisdom of Solomon 2:24 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it* (the devil-as-source-of-death entering-the-world; they-that-hold-of-his-side find-death — the architecture the children-of-the-wicked-one operate within); 1 Enoch 22:5-7 names the spirits-of-the-dead separated-into-four-divisions with the spirit-of-Hevel (Abel) crying-out-against-Qayin (Cain) as the seed-war's first-victim-crying-for-vindication; Jubilees 4:2 names the wisdom-stream restatement of the Bereshit (Genesis) 4 architecture — *Qayin (Cain) slew Hevel (Abel) because (God) accepted the sacrifice of Hevel (Abel), and did not accept the offering of Qayin (Cain) ... and his blood cried from the ground to heaven.* The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the Red Line #11 seed-war architecture: the wisdom-stream identifies the devil as the source-of-death-and-corruption from the beginning (the serpent of Bereshit 3 + the envy that brings death into the world); the wisdom-stream identifies Qayin (Cain) as the seed-war's first-fruit of the children-of-the-wicked-one (corroborated by 1 Yochanan (John) 3:12's *not as Qayin (Cain), who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother*); the wisdom-stream identifies Hevel (Abel) as the first-victim of the architecture. The King at Matt 13:38-39 names the operative-form of the architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the foundational register. The architecture operates from Bereshit (Genesis) 3 forward through the field-of-the-world to the harvest; the devil's envy at Bereshit 3 + the devil's seduction at the watchers (1 Enoch 6-11) + the devil's sowing-of-tares at Matt 13:39 = one architecture of the source-of-death-and-corruption across the canon and the wisdom-stream.

threads.title: The Son of the living Elohim named before the foundation — 1 Enoch 46 and 48, and Wisdom of Solomon 2 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 16:13-17's Caesarea-Philippi-confession sequence — the King's-credentialing-question *whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?* (v.13), Kefa's (Peter's) *thou art the Messiah, the Son of the living Elohim (God)* (v.16), and the King's-blessing *flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven* (v.17) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam / Son-of-the-living-Elohim named-before-the-foundation substance. Five moves: 1 Enoch 46:2 names the wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Son-of-Adam title the King uses of himself (*concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, and why he went with the Head of Days*); 1 Enoch 46:3 names the depth of the Son-of-Adam's identity (*this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness*); 1 Enoch 48:2 names the heavenly-naming-of-the-Christ at the throne (*that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days*); 1 Enoch 48:3 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the before-the-foundation-of-the-world naming (*before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits*); Wisdom of Solomon 2:18 names the just-man-as-the-son-of-Yahuah substance in the prefiguring-passage (*if the just man be the son of Yahuah (God), he will help him*). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operating at the Caesarea-Philippi-confession. Kefa's (Peter's)-confession articulates at the earthly-gospel-pivot what the Parables-of-Enoch and the Wisdom-of-Solomon-prefiguring-passage had named at the heavenly-throne and wisdom-stream-prefiguring registers centuries before. The Father's-revelation to Kefa (Peter) reveals what was always true — the Son-of-Adam's name was named before the foundation of the world; the cause-and-effect-of-hearing operates at the Father's revealing the same substance the wisdom-stream had carried.

threads.title: The Elect One on the throne and the Davidic stewardship keys — 1 Enoch 49, 51, 62, and 69 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 16:19's *I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Elect-One on the throne and the sum-of-judgment-committed-unto-the-Son-of-Adam substance. Four moves: 1 Enoch 49:2 names the Elect-One-as-the-Standing-One-before-Yahuah-of-Spirits to whom the secrets-of-righteousness are committed (*he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness ... because the Elect One stands before Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits*); 1 Enoch 51:3 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the Elect-One-on-the-throne substance (*the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, and his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel*); 1 Enoch 62:7 names the Son-of-Adam revealed-to-the-holy-and-elect substance (*the righteousness of the Elect One of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and elect*); 1 Enoch 69:27 names the sum-of-judgment-given-unto-the-Son-of-Adam substance (*he sat on the throne of his glory, and the sum of judgment was given unto the Son of Adam*). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the apostolic-stewardship's derivation from the King's-own-throne-position. The short.md walks the Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 22:15-25 Shevna-and-Elyakim succession as the Tanakh-architecture for the demotion-of-the-self-credentialing-Shevna-class (the contemporary Pharisaic-and-Sadducean second-Temple-aristocracy) and the elevation-of-the-Elyakim-class-of-apostolic-stewardship the King establishes at Kefa's confession; the 1 Enoch Parables-cluster carries the upstream-architecture for the King's-own-throne-position from which the keys are delegated. The King-as-the-Elect-One holds-the-throne and the sum-of-judgment; the King delegates the keys-of-the-kingdom-of-heaven to the apostolic-stewardship from that throne-position; the binding-and-loosing-substance the apostolic-stewardship exercises operates downstream-of-and-in-accountability-to the Son-of-Adam's-own-sum-of-judgment. The inherited-Roman-Catholic-magisterial-authority-to-define-doctrine-against-scripture reading is ruled out — the apostolic-keys administer what-the-Master-of-the-House-has-given, not what-the-stewards-define-against-the-Master.

threads.title: The gates of Sheol and the resurrection substance — Wisdom of Solomon 1 and 16, 1 Enoch 51, and 2 Esdras 4
threads.summary_md: Matt 16:18's *the gates of hell shall not prevail against it* — the King's-promise to the assembly-built-on-the-Rock that the gates-of-Sheol/Hades will not have-final-authority — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the gates-of-Sheol and the resurrection-substance. Four moves: Wisdom of Solomon 1:13 names the death-is-not-from-Yahuah substance (*Yahuah (God) made not death: neither has he pleasure in the destruction of the living*); Wisdom of Solomon 16:13 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the gates-of-hell-and-the-bringing-up-again substance (*you have power of life and death: you leadest to the gates of hell, and bringest up again*); 1 Enoch 51:1 names the Sheol-giving-back-the-dead substance (*Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, and hell shall give back that which it owes*); 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:35 names the souls-of-the-righteous-in-their-chambers substance (*did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion?*). The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of the gates-of-Sheol/Hades-substance the King's-promise enacts. The gates-of-Sheol carry the power-of-death-and-the-grave that entered through the curse-of-Bereshit (Genesis)-3 (Wisdom of Solomon 1:13's articulation that the Father is-not-the-source-of-death); the Father's-power leads-to-the-gates-and-brings-up-again (Wisdom of Solomon 16:13); the eschatological-architecture has Sheol-giving-back-the-dead and the chambers-delivering-the-souls (1 Enoch 51:1 + 2 Esdras 4:35); the King's-resurrection at the sign-of-Yonah is the operative-substance that breaks the gates' hold-against the assembly-built-on-him; the assembly partakes-of-the-resurrection-substance through-the-King at the first-resurrection per Revelation 20:4-6. The framework reads against the inherited-Christian-eternal-conscious-torment-hell reading of *gates of hell* — the Tanakh-substance and the wisdom-stream-substance carry the gates as the power-of-death-and-the-grave, not as the door to an eternal-conscious-torment institutional-Christian-doctrine.

threads.title: The Watcher-rebellion as the stumbling-block architecture — 1 Enoch 8-27 read against Matt 18:6-9's millstone-warning + sin-amputation + gehenna (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 18:6-9's millstone-warning against offending the little-ones-who-believe + the sin-amputation against the disciple's-own-stumbling-substance + the gehenna-of-fire-judgment — read against the wisdom-stream's articulation of the original-stumbling-block architecture in 1 Enoch. Five moves: 1 Enoch 8:1 names THE architectural-root of the *skandalon* substance — the watchers' teaching of the corrupting-arts (weapons, antimony-for-the-eyelids, costly stones, colouring-tinctures) the substance-of-which placed-the-stumbling-blocks across the way of the walker; 1 Enoch 10:8 names the whole earth's-corruption-through-the-watcher-taught-substance — the architecture under the King's *it must needs be that offences come* (Matt 18:7); 1 Enoch 19:1 names the lying-spirits-leading-astray in many-forms across the present-age — the architecture under every-system-of-stumbling-block the King's millstone-warning lands-on (the institutional-Christianity's antinomian-doctrine, the Hebrew-Roots false-inclusion gospel, the Pharisaic-traditions-of-the-elders, the Galatian-circumcision-party, the Islamic-transfer — the four-costumes per voice skill framework); 1 Enoch 22:11 names the place-of-the-eternal-judgment for those who-perpetuated-the-substance — the consummation-of-the-judgment the King names as *better* than the millstone-and-the-sea-mercy; 1 Enoch 27:2 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the accursed-valley-of-judgment substance — the Watcher-Book passage describing the valley at the centre of the holy mountain that pre-figures the *gei-Hinnom* (Valley of the sons of Hinnom) on the southern-edge of Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) the King's gehenna names. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR: the wisdom-stream's articulation of the seed-war operating architecturally from the watcher-fall through the present-age is the architecture under the inevitability-of-offences the King names; the woe-to-the-man-by-whom-the-offence-cometh is the same architecture 1 Enoch names the eternal judgment-substance for; the gehenna-substance is the Tanakh-and-wisdom-stream's accursed-valley-of-judgment carried-forward, NOT the inherited-Christian-eternal-conscious-torment doctrine read-back into the substance. The little-ones-led-astray are victims-not-enemies per voice skill's patience-not-condescension posture; the systems-and-the-leadership-who-perpetuate-the-corruption are where the woe lands.

threads.title: The Lord of the sheep and the gathering — 1 Enoch's Animal Apocalypse (ch 89-90) read against Matt 18:10-14's despise-not-the-little-ones + their-angels + the lost-sheep parable (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 18:10-14's pivot — the despise-not-the-little-ones warning + the guardian-messengers-behold-the-face-of-my-Father substance + the Son-of-Adam-is-come-to-save-the-lost mission-statement + the lost-sheep-shepherd parable + the Father's-will-substance — read against the wisdom-stream's most-direct shepherd-substance running-in-parallel with Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34's Tanakh-shepherd-substance. Five moves: 1 Enoch 40:9 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the four-presences-before-the-Father — Michael the merciful-and-long-suffering, Raphael over sickness-and-wounds, Gabriel over the powers, Phanuel over the repentance-unto-hope — the messengers' direct-throne-access architecture the King names at v.10 (*in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father*); 1 Enoch 89:42 names the Lord-of-the-sheep's-acting-substance against the beasts-and-birds-of-the-heaven who devour the sheep — the wisdom-stream's Animal-Apocalypse carrying-forward of the Tanakh-Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34 shepherd-substance into apocalyptic-vision-form; 1 Enoch 89:54 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the Lord-of-the-sheep-title-substance — the wisdom-stream identifies the Lord-of-the-sheep with Yahuah by name; 1 Enoch 90:6 names the lambs-that-open-their-eyes-substance the post-judgment opening-of-the-eyes-of-the-sheep-who-had-been-blinded; 1 Enoch 90:18 names the consummation-rejoicing the Lord-of-the-sheep walks-toward — *all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to fall down upon his face and to worship him* — the wisdom-stream's articulation of the gathering-substance the King's shepherd-parable enacts at the historical-pivot. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR per Red Line #7's reading of the lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) mission-scope: the Matt 18 shepherd-parable lands at two-levels-simultaneously — the assembly's-internal-little-ones AND the canon-wide lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) mission-scope per Matt 10:6 and Matt 15:24. Both levels derive from the same Lord-of-the-sheep architecture 1 Enoch had carried-forward from Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34. The cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates in the architecture of the lambs-who-open-the-eyes being-the-substance who-hear-when-the-Shepherd-calls; the gathering is the Father's-will-substance per v.14, not the universalist-overriding-determinism.

threads.title: Woes on the rich and riches cannot save — 1 Enoch 94-100 on Matt 19:23-26
threads.summary_md: Matt 19:23-26's camel-through-the-eye-of-a-needle hyperbole + the disciples' *who then can be saved?* + the King's *with men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible* — the substance the rich-young-ruler at vv.16-22 has-just-illustrated extended to the substance the kingdom-citizens'-substance carries-with-them as-the-substantial-warning — read against the Enochic wisdom-stream's extended-corpus-of-woes-against-trust-in-wealth and the *riches shall not be able to save them* substance. Five moves: 1 Enoch 94:3 names THE direct Enochic verbal-anchor for the woe-against-trust-in-riches substance (*woe to you who are rich! For you have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall you depart, Because you have not remembered Yahuah (God) of Spirits in the days of your riches*) — the same substance the King names at Matt 19:23's *a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven*; 1 Enoch 97:7 names the rich-man's-self-congratulation substance (*we have become rich with riches and have possessions; And we have acquired everything that we have desired*) — the architecture the rich-young-ruler-substance carried-out at his departure-sorrowful; 1 Enoch 94:8 names the rich-man's-internal-monologue substance (*let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses*) — the substance the rich-fool parable at Luke 12:16-21 will-name explicitly (*I will pull down my barns, and build greater*); 1 Enoch 98:10 names the *ye know no ransom* substance — the architecture the disciples' *who then can be saved?* at Matt 19:25 presupposes-the-failure-of (the inherited-substance that-had-associated-material-prosperity-with-the-Father's-blessing collapses against the Enochic and the King's warning); 1 Enoch 100:6 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the *riches shall not be able to save them* substance — the substance the King's-statement at Matt 19:26's *with men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible* lands. The framework reads the cluster as the Enochic wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of the King's-warning. The framework rules out: the Needle's-Eye-gate explanation (no historical-evidence at any period); the prosperity-gospel-collapse-of-Tanakh-substance (Avraham (Abraham)'s-wealth and Yitschaq (Isaac)'s-hundredfold and the Deuteronomy 28-blessings stand in the Tanakh-context where the heart-was-with-Yahuah, NOT as universal-equation of riches-equals-blessing); the universalist-reading the v.26 substance does NOT support (the substance is the Father-able-to-soften-the-heart-the-possessions-hold per Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27's new-heart substance + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:33's heart-Torah substance, NOT determinist-saving-of-all-rich-men-regardless-of-disposition). Grace is the door-home, the means-of-return-to-the-Father's-Way, NOT the cancellation-of-the-substance-the-Father-commands per the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* section of framework-deep.md.

threads.title: Many be called, but few chosen — 1 Enoch 39 + 1 Enoch 48 + 2 Esdras 8's wisdom-stream witness to Matt 20:16's cause-and-effect-of-hearing
threads.summary_md: Matt 20:16's closing-line of the laborers-parable — *so the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11. The framework reads the substance carefully — the substance is BOTH-AND, not EITHER-OR. The Reformed-monergistic-determinism that would collapse the substance into Father-unilaterally-chooses-without-disposition-walked is read-out by the cause-and-effect-architecture (the substance the citizen-walks is the substance-the-Father-knew-from-the-foundation, and the substance-walked is the substance-walked-by-the-citizen-who-is). The Arminian-libertarian-freedom that would collapse the substance into citizen-chooses-without-the-Father's-foreknowledge is also read-out (the hearing-reveals-what-was-already-true; the substance-of-disposition is the substance-the-Father-knew-from-the-foundation; the hearing-does-not-create the substance-of-disposition). The *many-called-but-few-chosen* substance is the seal of both substances at once — the broad-call going-out because the sheep-are-scattered, and the *chosen* (Greek *eklektoi*) walking-as-the-citizens-the-Father-has-known-from-before-the-foundation (Hitgalut (Revelation) 13:8, 17:8; John 10:26-27's *ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep ... my sheep hear my voice*). Four moves: 1 Enoch 39:1 names the wisdom-stream articulation of the elect-and-holy-children-of-the-earth-who-behold-the-secrets-of-the-heaven substance — the *eklektoi* the King names at v.16 are the same elect-and-holy-children the wisdom-stream names; 1 Enoch 48:1 names the broad-fountain-the-thirsty-drink-from substance — the broad-proclamation-substance that reaches-the-many because the citizens are scattered-among-the-nations; 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 8:1 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the world-made-for-many-but-the-world-to-come-for-few substance; 2 Esdras 8:3 names the even-more-pointed *there be many created, but few shall be saved* — the wisdom-stream prefiguring the King's-own-mouth substance. The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of Red Line #11's cause-and-effect-of-hearing + post-harvest-sifting architecture — the harvest separates wheat-from-tares (Matt 13:30); the gathered-wheat then passes through a post-harvest-sifting (Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 20:37-38; Matt 25:32; Luke 3:17); names get-blotted-out at the post-harvest-sifting for lawlessness; the warning is to wheat, not to tares. The *few* the parable names are the wheat-that-bears-fruit-and-is-not-blotted-out, not a Reformed-eternal-security-without-the-walking nor an Arminian-perfectability-by-effort.

threads.title: The Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many — 1 Enoch's Son-of-Adam Parables (ch 46, 48, 62) + Testaments of the Twelve 94 + Sirach 3 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 20:25-28's chapter-pivot — the King's categorical-inversion *but it shall not be so among you ... whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister (diakonos); and whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant (doulos)* + the framework-major v.28 *even as the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many* — read against the wisdom-stream and pseudepigraphal-stream articulation of the Son-of-Adam-lowly-on-earth-and-glorious-in-heaven + greatness-through-humility architecture. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR per Red Line #12's Son-of-Adam-restoration and the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* section of framework-deep.md. The King names himself explicitly as the Tanakh-Suffering-Servant of Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 53 and the *kofer*-ransom-substance of the Torah (Shemot (Exodus) 21:30; 30:12-13, 16; Bamidbar (Numbers) 35:31-33; Psalm 49:6-9; Daniel 9:24-27); the *many* (Greek *pollōn*) reads as the *rabbim* of the Servant-passage — the substantial-multitude the Father's-Book-of-Life from-the-foundation-of-the-world has named, neither the universalist-collapse nor the limited-atonement-restrictivism but the Three-Categories-architecture the framework reads across the gathering-arc. Five moves: 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-who-hath-righteousness — the named Son-of-Adam in the Parables-of-Enoch the gospels articulate at the gospel-pivot; 1 Enoch 48:2 names the Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation-of-the-world substance — the substantial-ransom was determined by-the-Father from-before-the-foundation (per Hitgalut (Revelation) 13:8's *Lamb slain from the foundation of the world*); 1 Enoch 62:9 names the eschatological-judgment-and-vindication of the Son-of-Adam — the same Son-of-Adam who-walks-the-substantial-ransom at the first-coming will-walk the substantial-judgment at the second-coming; Testaments of the Twelve 94:5 (Testament of Benjamin) names THE direct extras-stream verbal-anchor for the lowly-on-earth-and-glorious-in-heaven substance — the kenotic-incarnational architecture the King articulates at v.28; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 3:18 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the greater-the-more-humble substance — the inverse-architecture the King names at vv.26-27's *whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister.* The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream and pseudepigraphal-stream's direct corroboration of the Son-of-Adam-came-not-to-be-ministered-unto-but-to-minister-and-give-his-life-a-ransom-for-many architecture; the substance is the same-substance through-the-wisdom-stream and-through-the-King and-through-the-apostolic-witness (Philippians 2:6-11's *made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant*; 1 Timothy 2:5-6's *who gave himself a ransom (antilytron) for all*; Hebrews 9:11-15's *by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption*; 1 Peter 1:18-19's *redeemed ... with the precious blood of Messiah (Christ)*; Hitgalut (Revelation) 5:9's *thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to Elohim (God) by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation*). The framework reads the substance in continuity with the cross-opens-the-door-home-without-cancelling-the-curse-system architecture per the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* section — the cup-the-King-drinks opens-the-door-to-the-new-heart-substance the Spirit causes-the-disciple-to-walk-in (Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27; Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:31-34); the cross does NOT cancel-the-Torah-substance the Spirit-causes-the-disciple-to-keep.

threads.title: Leaves without fruit judged — Wisdom of Solomon 4's flourish-in-branches-for-a-time, Sirach 23:25's no-root-no-fruit, and 1 Enoch 89's consequences-on-the-scattered-flock
threads.summary_md: Matt 21:18-22's cursed-fig-tree-substance — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walking the substantial-prophetic-action against the leaves-without-fruit substance the Pharisaic-Sadducean-leadership had-walked; the Tanakh-fig-tree-substance of Hosheia (Hosea) 9:10, Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 8:13, Yo'el (Joel) 1:7, and Mikhah (Micah) 7:1 carried-forward as the covenant-fruitfulness-substance the leadership-substance had-corrupted — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the unfruitful-branches-substance-judged architecture. Four moves: Wisdom of Solomon 4:4 names the wisdom-stream's direct verbal-anchor for the flourishing-in-branches-for-a-time-but-standing-not-last substance (*for though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not last, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out*); Wisdom of Solomon 4:5 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the imperfect-branches-broken-off-and-the-fruit-unprofitable substance (*the imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yes, meet for nothing*) — the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substance the King-walks-against at the fig-tree-substance; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 23:25 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the no-root-and-no-fruit substance (*her children shall not take root, and her branches shall bring forth no fruit*); 1 Enoch 89:35 names the Animal-Apocalypse's articulation of the consequences-on-the-scattered-flock-when-the-unfruitful-leadership-walks (*and the Lord of the sheep was silent, and the beasts and birds devoured the sheep, and the sheep were scattered*). The framework reads the cluster per the framework's system-not-people-posture — the substance the King-walks-against at the fig-tree-substance is the Pharisaic-Sadducean-leadership-substance the wisdom-stream-corpus and the Animal-Apocalypse-substance had-named the architecture-of; the substance is-NOT the people-of-Yashar'el (Israel) categorically, per the same diagnostic the matt-13-tares, the matt-15-blind-leaders-of-the-blind, and the matt-23-seven-woes hold throughout the gospel. The framework reads the Tanakh-prophets' shepherd-substance — Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34's *woe be to the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) that do feed themselves!* + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 23's *woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!* — in continuity with the King's-own-substance at John 10:11-16 (*I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep*) — the unfruitful-leadership-substance produces-the-scattered-flock; the King-substance comes-to-gather the scattered-substance the unfruitful-leadership had-scattered.

threads.title: The wicked husbandmen — prophets slain, house desolate, corrupt shepherds judged, and the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob) gathered as from the beginning (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 21:33-46's FRAMEWORK-MAJOR parable-of-the-wicked-husbandmen — the Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 5:1-7 vineyard-of-Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) substance walked-out at the leadership-level (the husbandmen are the LEADERSHIP-substance, NOT the people-of-Yashar'el (Israel) categorically); the servants-substance is the prophets-substance the Tanakh names; the killing-and-stoning is the Tanakh-prophet-killing-pattern; the *last of all he sent unto them his son* substance is the King's-walking-toward-the-cross; the King citing Tehillim (Psalm) 118:22-23 *the stone which the builders rejected*; the chapter-pivot at v.43 — *the kingdom of Elohim (God) shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof* — the framework-MAJOR-substance for the kingdom-stewardship-transferred-from-the-current-leadership-stewards-of-Yahudah (Judah) to-the-bringing-forth-fruit-remnant-of-the-gathering-of-the-scattered-seed-of-both-houses-of-Yashar'el (Israel), with the Greek *ethnos* SINGULAR-not-plural locking the reading against the inherited-Christian-replacement-theology collapse — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulations of (a) the prophets-slain substance + (b) the house-desolate substance + (c) the corrupt-shepherds-judged substance + (d) the gather-all-the-tribes-of-Ya'aqov-as-from-the-beginning substance the v.43 framework-MAJOR-pivot walks-into. Four moves: 2 Esdras 1:32 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the servants-the-prophets-taken-and-slain substance (*I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands*) the parable walks-out at vv.34-36; 2 Esdras 1:33 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the house-desolate substance (*your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind does stubble*) the consequence-of-the-killing-of-the-Son at v.39 walks-into per the Olivet-discourse-substance at Matthew 24:1-2; 1 Enoch 89:45 names the Animal-Apocalypse's direct verbal-anchor for the leadership-judgment-substance (*the shepherds who had not fed the sheep were judged, and cast into the same fiery abyss with the beasts*) the *he will miserably destroy those wicked men* at v.41 walks-into; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36:11 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the gather-all-the-tribes-of-Ya'aqov substance (*gather all the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob) together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning*) the chapter-pivot at v.43 walks-into per Red Line #11's ingathering-of-the-paternal-blood-remnant-of-all-twelve-tribes architecture. The framework reads the v.43 *nation* (Greek *ethnos*, SINGULAR-not-plural) as the gathered-bringing-forth-fruit-remnant of the twelve-tribes-of-Ya'aqov the wisdom-stream-Sirach-36:11 substance had-prayed-the-Father-for, NOT the categorical-displacement of Yashar'el (Israel) by the church. The framework rules out THREE inherited readings of v.43: (1) the Christian-replacement-theology that-the-categorical-church-replaces-Yashar'el collapses the singular-*ethnos* against the wisdom-stream's-direct-naming of the substance as *all the tribes of Ya'aqov*; (2) the Hebrew-Roots-false-inclusion that-the-Torah-keeping-categorical-anyone replaces-the-current-leadership collapses the paternal-blood-substance the *tribes of Ya'aqov* names by-name-by-tribe per Red Line #3; (3) the Reformation-sola-fide-without-fruit that-the-bringing-forth-fruit is-incidental collapses the load-bearing-clause itself — the bringing-forth-fruit-substance is the Spirit-empowered-heart-Torah-walking substance per Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:31-34 + Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27 + James 2:14-26's faith-without-works-is-dead substance. The apostolic-witness's twelve-tribes-restoration architecture — Matt 19:28's *twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el* + Acts 26:6-7's *twelve tribes, instantly serving Elohim (God) day and night, hope to come* + James 1:1's *to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad* + Revelation 7:4-8's twelve-tribes-sealed + Revelation 21:12-14's twelve-gates-of-the-twelve-tribes + Ephesians 2:20's apostolic-foundation + 1 Peter 2:9-10's holy-*ethnos* singular addressed to the *strangers scattered* — IS the substance the wisdom-stream had-named, the substance the framework reads at-the-Red-Line-#11-load-bearing-anchor.

threads.title: The resurrection of the righteous — 2 Maccabees 7's mother-and-seven-sons witness and the wisdom-stream corroboration at Matt 22:23-33
threads.summary_md: Matt 22:23-33's Sadducees-on-resurrection question — the priestly-aristocracy-substance (the *Tsadoqim* descended from Tsadoq (Zadok) per Ezekiel 44:15-16 + 2 Samuel 8:17 + 1 Kings 1:8) whose-Torah-only-no-resurrection-no-angels-no-spirit-substance Luke names at Acts 23:8, constructing the hypothetical-substance of seven-brethren-and-one-wife on the levirate-marriage-substance of Devarim (Deuteronomy) 25:5-10 to mock the resurrection; the King's rebuke *ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of Elohim (God)*; *as the angels of Elohim (God) in heaven* — the non-fallen-still-in-heaven-substance (NOT the categorically-non-marrying-of-all-angels per the watcher-substance of Genesis 6:1-4 + 1 Enoch 6-7 + Jude 6); the King's-citation of Exodus 3:6 — *I am the Elohim (God) of Avraham (Abraham), and the Elohim (God) of Yitschaq (Isaac), and the Elohim (God) of Ya'aqov (Jacob); Elohim (God) is not the Elohim (God) of the dead, but of the living* — read against the wisdom-and-martyrdom-stream's strongest external-witness articulation of the resurrection-of-the-righteous substance. Four moves: 2 Maccabees 7:9 names THE direct verbal-anchor — the second son of the mother-and-seven-sons-substance under Antiochus Epiphanes confessing-the-*King of the world shall raise us up, who have died for his laws, to everlasting life*; 2 Maccabees 7:23 names the mother-confessing the Creator-shall-give-breath-and-life-again substance to her sons as they die for the Torah; 2 Esdras 7:32 names the earth-shall-restore-those-that-are-asleep substance the prophet Daniel had named at Daniel 12:2 carried-forward at the apocalyptic-wisdom-stream-register; Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 names the souls-of-the-righteous-in-the-hand-of-Yahuah substance — read carefully through the framework, this is the asleep-in-the-Father's-keeping substance, NOT the inherited-Christian immediate-conscious-disembodied-soul-going-to-heaven-or-hell-at-death substance (the Wisdom of Solomon 3 surrounding-context at vv.7-8 — *and in the time of their visitation they shall shine ... they shall judge the nations* — makes plain the visitation-and-shining-and-judging belongs to the resurrection-day-substance, not to the immediate-after-death-substance). The framework reads the cluster in continuity with the apostle Yochanan (John) at Revelation 20:4-6's *first resurrection* and the apostle Sha'ul (Paul) at 1 Thessalonians 4:13-17's *them which are asleep ... them also which sleep in Yahusha (Jesus) will Elohim (God) bring with him* — the asleep-awaiting-the-first-resurrection substance the framework reads against the inherited-Christian collapsed-into-immediate-disembodied-substance. The substance the citizen-of-the-kingdom walks-with at the grief-of-the-loved-one is the substance the seven-martyred-sons-and-their-mother walked-with at the cost-of-blood: they-sleep-in-Yahuah-awaiting-the-King's-coming-to-raise. The wisdom-and-martyrdom-stream had already-confessed the substance the King defends at vv.23-33 centuries before the Sadducean-trap-question.

threads.title: The Elect One at the right hand — 1 Enoch Parables (chs 46, 48, 51, 61, 62) and the framework-major Formless-Father / Formed-Son architecture at Matt 22:41-46 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 22:41-46's David's-Lord question — the framework-major moment for the nature-of-God substance the Synoptic-substance reaches — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam / Elect-One named-before-the-Head-of-Days and seated-on-the-throne-of-glory at the Head-of-Days' right hand in the Parables-of-Enoch (1 Enoch chs 37-71). Five moves: 1 Enoch 46:3 names THE direct verbal-anchor for *this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness* — the Parables identify the Son-of-Adam by name (per Red Line #12's Son-of-Adam architecture, this is the named-title case, NOT the kaph-comparative case of Daniel 7:13 / Revelation 1:13 / Revelation 14:14 the Red Line carves-out separately) and articulate the pre-eminence-before-Yahuah-of-Spirits substance; 1 Enoch 48:2 names the *Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days* — the pre-existence and eternal-naming of the Son before the foundation of the world the apostle Yochanan (John) will name at Revelation 13:8 + 17:8; 1 Enoch 51:3 names THE direct verbal-anchor for *the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne* — the same substance Psalm 110:1 walks at *sit thou on my right hand*; 1 Enoch 61:8 names the Head-of-Days placing-the-Elect-One on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance; 1 Enoch 62:7 names the Son-of-Adam-born-unto-righteousness substance — the Davidic-lineage AND the righteousness-of-the-Head-of-Days abiding-over-him from-the-foundation-of-the-world. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the nature-of-God reading. The Tanakh-Hebrew of Psalm 110:1 preserves the substance with precision: the first *Lord* is *Yahuah* (the tetragrammaton, the Formless-Father per the framework's Formless-Source / Formed-Expression-from-the-Source nature-of-God reading); the second *Lord* is *Adoni* (David's personal-Lord, the Son the Davidic-lineage produces AND who is greater than David). The substance the King brings-into-the-Pharisaic-system's-face at Matt 22:41-46 is the substance 1 Enoch had named at the wisdom-stream-register: the Son-of-Adam is greater-than-David because the Son-of-Adam was-named before-the-Head-of-Days before-the-Davidic-line-existed, and the Father (the Head of Days / Yahuah of Spirits) gives-the-throne-and-the-judgment-of-the-works-of-the-holy to-the-Elect-One. The substance rules out three inherited readings of the nature-of-God: (i) the post-Nicene Trinitarian three-co-equal-persons-of-one-substance — both Psalm 110 and 1 Enoch 51:3 / 61:8 carry the Father-placing-the-Son-on-the-throne substance, substantive-subordination at the eternal-Source-and-Expression level (the King-himself walks the same substance at John 14:28 / 1 Corinthians 15:28 / Matthew 24:36); (ii) the modalist-collapse — the Father speaks TO the Son the same way the Head of Days names the Son, the two are substantively-distinct; (iii) the Arian-substance of the Son as a created-being made-at-a-point-in-time — the Son was-named before-the-Head-of-Days, the Word the apostle Yochanan (John) names at John 1:1-3 (*in the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God) ... all things were made by him*). Psalm 110 is the most-quoted Tanakh-Psalm in the apostolic-substance: the King-himself at Matt 26:64; Kefa-Pentecost at Acts 2:34-36; Stephen at Acts 7:55-56; the apostle Sha'ul (Paul) at Romans 8:34, 1 Corinthians 15:25, Ephesians 1:20, Colossians 3:1; Hebrews 1:3, 1:13, 5:6, 7:17, 7:21, 8:1, 10:12-13, 12:2; the apostle Kefa (Peter) at 1 Peter 3:22; the apostle Yochanan (John) at Revelation 3:21. The system-substance has no answer at the King's-substance; *and no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions* — the public-questioning is closed, the road to the cross opens, the husbandmen-parable-substance of Matt 21:38 walks-out within the week. The wisdom-stream and the Tanakh and the gospel and the apostolic-substance all cohere at the substance the framework's Formless-Father / Formed-Son architecture reads.

threads.title: The corrupted-priesthood and false-credentialing architecture — Testaments of Levi + 1 Enoch + Wisdom of Solomon witness to the first three woes at Matt 23:13-22 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 23:13-22's first-three-woes — the leadership-substance shutting-up-the-kingdom-of-heaven-against-men (v.13), the framework-major-direct-diagnostic of the false-inclusion-gospel at v.15 (*ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of Gehinnom (Gehenna) than yourselves* — the prototype-substance the apostle-Sha'ul (Paul)'s letter-to-the-Galatians walks-against, the same diagnostic operating in five costumes by the contrary-to-Torah-test: Pharisaic-rabbinic through ADDITION + Galatian-agitators through INVERSION + modern-institutional-Christianity through SUBTRACTION + modern-Hebrew-Roots-false-inclusion through COLLAPSE + Islam through TRANSFER), and the third-woe at vv.16-22 (the Pharisaic-oath-distinction-substance against the Torah's-direct-substance) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the corrupted-priesthood and false-credentialing architecture. Four moves: Testaments XII Levi (file ch 17, canonical Testament of Levi 16) names the deal-lawlessly-with-Yashar'el (Israel)-and-veil-of-the-temple-rent substance — the wisdom-stream's prefiguring of the substance walking-toward the historical-fulfillment at Matt 27:51; Testaments XII Levi (file ch 20, canonical Testament of Levi 17) names THE direct verbal-anchor for the priests-(who-are)-idolaters-adulterers-lovers-of-money-proud-lawless-lascivious substance — the wisdom-stream had-named the corrupted-priesthood-substance centuries before the gospel-pivot articulated the seven-woes against the same substance; 1 Enoch 99:2 names the pervert-the-words-of-uprightness-and-transform-themselves-into-sinners substance — the substance the proselyte made-twofold-the-child-of-Gehinnom (Gehenna) is converted-into; Wisdom of Solomon 6:4 names the ministers-of-the-kingdom-have-not-judged-aright-nor-kept-the-law substance — the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the contrary-to-Torah-test the apostle-Yochanan (John) names at 1 John 2:3-4 the framework applies-against any system claiming covenant-standing while teaching contrary-to-the-Torah-substance. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the *Pharisaic-leadership-system = first costume of the antichrist architecture* diagnostic per the *Judaizer Error* section of framework-deep.md — the wisdom-stream and the gospel cohere at the architecture of the corrupted-priesthood-as-the-substance-the-King-walks-against. The system-not-people posture is non-negotiable — the substance is the leadership-substance, NOT the Yahudim (Jews)-as-a-people categorically; the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) is himself a Yahudi (Jew); the apostles are Yahudim (Jews); the multitudes the King addresses at v.1 are Yahudim (Jews); the lament-substance at vv.37-39 walks the gathering-substance the leadership-substance has-kept-the-people-from.

threads.title: The blood of Hevel (Abel) crying and the mother-hen gathering — 1 Enoch 22 + 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 1's wisdom-stream witness to the seventh-woe at Matt 23:29-36 and the lament at vv.37-39 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 23:29-39's seventh-woe and lament — the leadership-substance builds-the-tombs-of-the-prophets the same leadership-substance's-fathers killed; *fill ye up then the measure of your fathers*; *ye serpents, ye generation of vipers* walking the seed-of-the-serpent-substance from Bereshit (Genesis) 3:15 and the wheat-and-tares-substance the King had-walked at Matt 13:24-30, 36-43 (the seed-war-substance walked-into-the-leadership-substance, NOT the Yahudim (Jews)-as-a-people categorically); *from the blood of righteous Hevel (Abel) unto the blood of Zecharyah (Zechariah) son of Berekhyahu (Barachias)* walking the WHOLE-Tanakh-prophet-killing-substance from Bereshit (Genesis) 4:8-10 (with the *voice of thy brother's blood crieth from the ground* substance) through 2 Divrei HaYamim (Chronicles) 24:20-22 closing the Hebrew-canon-order; *all these things shall come upon this generation* walking-toward the 70 CE Roman destruction of the Second-Temple the King will-make-explicit at Matt 24:1-2; and the lament at vv.37-39 — *O Yerushalayim (Jerusalem), Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) ... how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not! Behold, your house is left unto you desolate. For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of Yahuah (the LORD)* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Hevel-(Abel)-blood-crying-from-the-ground architecture and the prophets-slain-house-desolate-mother-hen-gathering architecture. Five moves: 1 Enoch 22:7 names the prison-of-the-angels substance — the framework's reading-context for the *damnation of Gehenna* at v.33 (NOT the inherited-Christian-Augustinian doctrine of eternal-conscious-torture-in-fire-for-the-merely-uninformed; the substance is the prison-of-the-angels-and-the-post-judgment-divisions per 1 Enoch 22 and the wheat-and-tares-substance the tares are bound and burned at the harvest); 1 Enoch 22:14 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the spirit-of-Hevel-(Abel)-makes-suit-against-Qayin (Cain) substance at v.35; 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 1:30 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *I gathered you together, as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings* substance at v.37 — the SAME hen-gathers-her-chickens-under-her-wings figure-of-speech the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) speaks-with-the-Father's-own-voice at the lament; 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 1:32 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *I sent prophets, whom you have taken and slain* substance at v.34 and the prophet-killing-pattern at vv.35-36; 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 1:33 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *Your house is desolate* substance at v.38. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR — the wisdom-stream and the Tanakh-prophets and the gospel-pivot all walk the same Father's-voice across the prophet-killing-pattern, the house-left-desolate-substance, and the Father-as-mother-bird-gathering-the-children-under-the-wings-substance. The lament-substance walks the gathering-substance EVEN-at-the-moment-of-the-substantial-judgment of the leadership-substance the seven-woes have-walked-out — the substantial-judgment of the false-shepherds is the substance that-clears-the-way for the True-Shepherd's-gathering per the prophet-Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) at Ezekiel 34:1-31. The substance walks-toward the surviving-third-substance the prophet-Zekharyah (Zechariah) walks at Zechariah 13:8-9 (*they shall call on my name, and I will hear them*) and the look-upon-me-whom-they-have-pierced substance at Zechariah 12:10. The framework reads the substance in continuity with Red Line #11's ingathering-of-the-paternal-blood-remnant-of-all-twelve-tribes architecture — the lament is not the Father's-categorical-rejection of Yerushalayim (Jerusalem); the lament is the Father's-tender-heart walking-the-gathering-substance the wild-olive-descendants-of-the-broken-off will-walk-toward through the journey-the-prophets-named (gathered-out-of-the-nations -> brought-under-the-rod -> brought-into-the-new-covenant -> grafted-into-the-natural-root-of-the-fathers).

threads.title: The days of Noach (Noah) and the Watcher-rebellion judgment-pattern — 1 Enoch 10, 65, 67 + Jubilees 5 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 24:37-39's *as the days of Noach (Noah) were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be* — the King walking the substantial-Genesis 6:1-13 Watcher-rebellion-substance the substantial Adam-and-the-tares-architecture preserves, the substance the apostle-Yehudah (Jude) quotes at Jude 14-15 from 1 Enoch and the apostle-Kefa (Peter) walks at 2 Peter 2:5 + 2 Peter 3:3-7 — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the antediluvian-judgment-architecture. Five moves: 1 Enoch 10:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the proclamation-to-Noach (Noah) substance (*Go to Noach (Noah) and tell him... reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed*); 1 Enoch 65:11 names the substantial-three-category-judgment-architecture (*the Most High shall send His punishment upon the sinners and upon the fallen angels, and upon their children* — sinners, Watchers, and the Nephilim (giants) corruption of the substantial-flesh-substance the Watchers walked-the-substantial-creation-order against); 1 Enoch 67:1 names the consummation-of-the-punishment-of-the-fallen-angels substance (*they shall be led off to the abyss of fire*) tying Matt 24:39's *took them all away* substance to the substantial-judgment-substance, NOT the substantial-modern-Christian-pre-tribulation-rapture-rescue-substance; Jubilees 5:2 names the lawlessness-increased-and-all-flesh-corrupted-its-way substance — the same Greek-anomia / torahlessness substance the King walks at Matt 24:12 (*because iniquity (anomia, torahlessness) shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold*) ties-forward-to; Jubilees 5:19 names the no-man's-person-was-accepted-save-Noach (Noah) substance the substantial *one shall be taken, and the other left* pattern at Matt 24:40-41 walks-the-architecture-of, the substance the substantial-Lukan-parallel of Luke 17:34-37 confirms (the disciples' *where, Lord?* receiving *wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together* — the substantial *taken* substance walks-into-the-substantial-judgment, NOT the substantial-rescue). FRAMEWORK-MAJOR. The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration that the days-of-Noach (Noah) pattern is the substantial-Watcher-rebellion-and-judgment-pattern the substantial-end-of-the-age recapitulates — corruption-of-the-substantial-flesh-substance, lawlessness-on-the-earth, unawareness-among-the-substantial-people-the-substantial-judgment-substance-takes-away, preservation-of-the-substantial-Father's-chosen.

threads.title: The gathering of the elect from the four winds — 1 Enoch's Parables (ch 57, 61) and Animal Apocalypse (ch 90) (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 24:27-31's framework-major substance — the *lightning out of the east, and shineth even unto the west* substance at v.27 ruling-out the substantial-secret-rapture-substance; the *Son of Adam coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory* substance at v.30 (where the Greek does NOT carry the *hōs* / *homoion* comparative — the kaph-comparative narrow-rule preserved only at Daniel 7:13 + Revelation 1:13 + Revelation 14:14 per Red Line #12); the substantial *great sound of a trumpet* + *gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other* substance at v.31 — THE central Red Line #11 four-winds-gathering verse, anchoring the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes ingathering the prophets walked. Read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the cosmic-public-coming + gathering-of-the-sheep architecture in 1 Enoch's Parables and Animal Apocalypse. Four moves: 1 Enoch 57:1 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south* substance the King walks at Matt 24:27 (the substantial-public-visible-second-coming substance against the substantial-modern-dispensational-Christian-eschatology); 1 Enoch 57:2 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the *from one end of heaven to the other* substance the King walks at Matt 24:31 — the substantial-cosmic-sound-from-end-to-end the wisdom-stream had named at the Parables; 1 Enoch 61:5 names the gathering-of-the-substance-destroyed-and-devoured substance (those-destroyed-by-the-desert, devoured-by-the-beasts, devoured-by-the-fish-of-the-sea) the Father preserves-and-returns at the substantial-day-of-the-Elect-One — the substantial-architecture the substantial-gathering-of-the-elect-from-the-four-winds operates within; 1 Enoch 90:10 names the substantial-Animal-Apocalypse-substance of the substantial-sheep-gathered-together-to-the-great-horn — the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant-of-Yashar'el (Israel) gathered-by-the-Lord-of-the-sheep, with 90:17's substantial-Lord-of-the-sheep bringing-all-the-sheep-into-the-new-house threaded-into the cross-reference note per the substantial-ingathering-of-all-twelve-tribes substance Ezekiel 37:15-28 walked. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR per Red Line #11. The framework reads the cluster as the substantial-direct-wisdom-stream-corroboration that the substantial-four-winds-gathering at Matt 24:31 is the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes the prophets walked the substantial-substance-for at Deuteronomy 30:1-4 + Isaiah 11:11-12 + Isaiah 27:12-13 + Jeremiah 23:3 + Jeremiah 31:8-10 + Ezekiel 11:17 + Ezekiel 20:34, 41 + Ezekiel 34:11-16 + Ezekiel 36:24 + Ezekiel 37:21 + Hosea 1:10-11 + Micah 2:12 + Micah 4:6-7 + Zephaniah 3:19-20 + Zechariah 8:7-8 + Zechariah 10:8-10. NOT the substantial-spiritual-category-substance the substantial-Christian-inclusion-gospel walks; the substantial-elect is the substantial-paternal-blood-remnant the substantial-substance preserved-from-the-foundation-of-the-world per Revelation 13:8 + Revelation 17:8.

threads.title: The judgment of the kings and the mighty cast down — 1 Enoch's Parables on the Son of Adam raising-up-the-mighty-from-their-thrones at the throne of his glory
threads.summary_md: Matt 25:31-46's sifting of the sheep from the goats — the Son-of-Adam-coming-in-his-glory + all-the-holy-angels-with-him + the throne-of-his-glory + all-nations-gathered-before-him + the separation-substance + the everlasting-fire-prepared-for-the-devil-and-his-angels — read against 1 Enoch's Parables (chapters 46-63) on the Son-of-Adam-on-the-throne-of-his-glory raising-up-the-kings-and-mighty-from-their-seats + putting-them-down-from-their-thrones + the kings-and-mighty-seized-with-great-terror + the secrets-of-the-Most-High-revealed-to-the-Elect-One. Five moves: 1 Enoch 62:5 names the wisdom-stream context for the throne-of-his-glory + the secrets-of-the-Most-High substance + the books-of-the-living-opened-before-him — the substantial-architecture the sheep-and-goats opening at Matt 25:31 walks-into directly; 1 Enoch 62:3 names the substantial-angelic-host-summoned-with-the-Elect-One substance — the substantial-substance Matt 25:31's *all the holy angels with him* walks, in continuity with Deuteronomy 33:2 + Daniel 7:10 + Zechariah 14:5 + Jude 14-15; 1 Enoch 62:9 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the Son-of-Adam-raising-up-the-kings-and-mighty-from-their-thrones substance (*Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, And the strong from their thrones*) — the reversal-architecture the sheep-and-goats-judgment walks-out, in continuity with Tehillim (Psalm) 2:9 + Tehillim (Psalm) 110:5-6 + Isaiah 24:21; 1 Enoch 62:11 names the humbling-of-the-strong + the abasing-of-the-pride-of-the-mighty substance + the darkness-as-dwelling architecture — the substantial-outer-darkness-substance of Matt 25:30, 22:13, and the everlasting-fire-substance of Matt 25:41; 1 Enoch 63:7 names the kings-and-mighty-seized-with-great-terror + the prayer-and-supplication-too-late substance — the substantial-substance the goats walk-into at the substantial *Lord, when saw we thee* of Matt 25:44, with the substantial-recognition-coming-too-late and the substantial-cutoff-being-substantial. The framework reads the cluster carefully — this thread sits parallel to the S154 thread `the-son-of-adam-glorified-in-1-enoch-throne-vision-and-parables` (anchored on Matt 17 transfiguration) which carried the glorified-form-substance for the pre-resurrection-foretaste; this thread carries the judgment-of-the-kings-and-mighty-cast-down + reversal architecture for the second-coming + the sheep-and-goats-judgment-at-the-throne-of-his-glory. The substantial-everlasting-fire of v.41 was-substantively-prepared-FOR-the-devil-and-his-angels per Jude 6-7 + 2 Peter 2:4 + Revelation 20:10 + 20:14-15; the goats sent toward it are the unfruitful among the gathered, sifted before the reign; the kings and the mighty who possess the earth (1 Enoch 63:7) fall at the Day with the tares abroad; the substantial-Universalist-substance is explicitly-ruled-out — the substantial-cutoff at the substantial-shut-door + the substantial-everlasting-punishment of v.46 is substantial.

threads.title: The Elect-One vindicated on the throne and the kings-and-the-mighty condemned — 1 Enoch 46 + 48 + 62 + 63's Son-of-Adam-Parables witness to Matt 26:64's Sanhedrin-trial answer (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 26:64's substantial-confluence at-the-King-of-Yashar'el (Israel)'s-own-mouth — *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* — the substantial-direct-self-identification of the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) standing-bound-before-the-Sanhedrin-Kaiapha (Caiaphas) on-oath at-the-historical-pivot, combining the substantial Psalm 110:1 substance the prophet-David walked (*Yahuah (the LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool*) and the substantial Daniel 7:13-14 substance the prophet-Daniel walked (*one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven ... his dominion is an everlasting dominion*) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substantial-Son-of-Adam-Elect-One-named-before-the-foundation-of-the-world-and-vindicated-on-the-throne-of-his-glory-against-the-kings-and-the-mighty substance the substantial 1 Enoch Parables (chs 37-71) carries-substantively. Five moves: 1 Enoch 46:2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-walking-with-the-Head-of-Days substance (the named-figure standing-beside-the-Father at the heavenly-throne-vision register); 1 Enoch 46:4 names the Son-of-Adam-vindicated-against-the-kings-and-the-mighty-from-their-seats substance (the substantial-irony the Sanhedrin-condemning-the-King-at-the-historical-pivot will-themselves-stand-condemned at the eschatological-day); 1 Enoch 48:3 names the Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation-of-the-world substance (in continuity with the names-named-before-the-foundation-of-the-world architecture of Revelation 13:8 + 17:8 per Red Line #11); 1 Enoch 62:9 names the Son-of-Adam-on-the-throne-of-his-glory-vindicated substance (the operative-substance the Daniel 7:13-14 everlasting-dominion-substance walks-into); 1 Enoch 63:3 names the kings-and-the-mighty-falling-down-on-their-faces-before-the-Son-of-Adam substance (the substantial-acknowledgement-of-Lordship-at-the-day-of-judgement the Tanakh-Isaiah-45:23 and apostolic-Philippians-2:10-11 walks-substantively-at-the-substantial-same-substance). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the Son-of-Adam-architecture per Red Line #12. Note on the kaph-comparative-narrow-rule: Matt 26:64's Greek *opsesthe ton huion tou anthrōpou* reads the title-direct (no *hōs* / no *homoion*); the Daniel 7:13 verse-the-King-quotes preserves the kaph at the Aramaic-source-register (*kbar enash* = like a son of mortal-man) which is incarnation-honoring; 1 Enoch 46:2 / 46:4 / 48:3 / 62:9 / 63:3 read the named-figure substance directly (NOT the kaph-comparative-substance the Daniel 7:13 text-itself preserves). At Matt 26:64 the King identifies-himself-as-the-Son-of-Adam Daniel 7's figure-resembled — the One the kaph at Daniel 7:13 honored, the One 1 Enoch named-substantively-the-substance-for at the named-figure register. The wisdom-stream-Parables and the King's-self-identification cohere. System-not-people posture holds non-negotiable — the substantial-substance walks against the corrupt-Sanhedrin-aristocracy-substance the King walks-out-against from-Matthew-21-onward, NEVER-against-the-Yahudi (Jewish)-people-substance the King walks-himself-as-a-Yahudi (Jew)-substance-of-the-tribe-of-Yahudah (Judah).

threads.title: The kings and the mighty condemning the Elect-One and the Elect-One vindicated on the throne of his glory — 1 Enoch 62-63's Parables witness to the cross-and-the-day-of-vindication architecture
threads.summary_md: Matt 27:1's *all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death* + Matt 27:42-43's mockers' *if he be the King of Yashar'el (Israel), let him now come down from the cross* and *he trusted in Elohim (God); let him deliver him now* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the kings-and-the-mighty-condemning-the-Elect-One AND the eschatological-reversal of the Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-his-glory architecture in 1 Enoch 62-63's Parables-of-Enoch. Four moves: 1 Enoch 63:1 names THE verbal-anchor for the kings-and-the-mighty-and-the-exalted-summoned-before-the-Elect-One substance — the present-tense-counsel-against-the-King at Matt 27:1 is the architectural-inverse of the day-of-vindication-summons the wisdom-stream named (the corrupted-Sanhedrin-leadership + Pontius-Pilate + Hordos (Herod)-Antipas take-counsel-against-the-Anointed per Tehillim (Psalm) 2:2 + Acts 4:25-28); 1 Enoch 62:3 names the Elect-One-summoned-with-the-host-of-the-heavens substance — the King COULD-have-summoned-twelve-legions-of-angels per Matt 26:53; he walks-the-cross-substantively per the Father's-purpose; 1 Enoch 62:7 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the *righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not* substance — the wisdom-stream had named the Son-of-Adam's-being-not-forsaken centuries before the cross; the King's-prayer at Matt 27:46 (*Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani*) is the Suffering-Servant-praying-Tehillim 22 (which walks AS A WHOLE from apparent-forsakenness in vv.1-21 INTO vindication in vv.22-31), NOT the Trinity-co-equal-person-being-forsaken reading the inherited-Christian-collapse walks per Red Line #10's nature-of-God reading; 1 Enoch 63:3 names the eschatological-reversal — the kings-and-the-mighty who-presently-mock at the cross shall-eventually fall-down-on-their-faces and worship the Son-of-Adam per Philippians 2:10-11's *every knee should bow.* Threaded continuity with S155 Matt 22's `the-elect-one-at-the-right-hand-the-davidic-lord-witnessed-in-1-enoch-parables` (different application — that thread anchors the Davidic-Lord-at-the-right-hand-Tehillim-110 enthronement; this thread anchors the suffering-that-precedes-the-vindication architecture the cross walks-out). The wisdom-stream and the gospel cohere at the Elect-One / Son-of-Adam architecture per Red Line #12's reading: the canon-and-the-Parables-of-Enoch witness the same Formed-Son.

threads.title: All power given the Son of Adam enthroned on the throne of glory — 1 Enoch 51, 61, and 62's wisdom-stream witness to the substantial *all power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* at Matt 28:18 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 28:18's *And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* — the substantial-Greek *pasa exousia* (all authority/power) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substantial-Son-of-Adam-given-dominion-on-the-throne-of-glory architecture in 1 Enoch's Parables (chs 37-71). Five moves: 1 Enoch 51:1 names the substantial-Elect-One-shall-arise + the earth-and-Sheol-shall-give-back-the-dead substance — the substantial-Resurrection-architecture the King walks at the firstfruits-event at Matt 28:6 + the citizens-at-the-first-resurrection per Revelation 20:4-6; 1 Enoch 51:2 names the substantial-Elect-One-shall-choose-the-righteous-and-holy substance — the post-harvest-sifting per Red Line #11 the substantial-all-power-given-substance enables; 1 Enoch 61:8 names the substantial-Head-of-Days-placed-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance — the Father-Son relational-architecture per the Formless-Source / Formed-Expression grid (the Head-of-Days at 1 Enoch 61:8 is the Father; the Elect-One is the Son); 1 Enoch 62:6 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the substantial-Father-of-Spirits-seated-the-Elect-One-on-the-throne-of-His-glory substance — the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substantial Daniel 7:13-14 dominion-and-glory-and-a-kingdom substance the King walks-out at v.18; 1 Enoch 62:9 names the substantial-Son-of-Adam-raising-up-and-putting-down-the-kings-and-the-mighty-from-their-thrones substance — the categorical-dominion-substance heaven-and-earth-substantively-comprehensively (NOT the inherited-Christian-spiritualized-kingdom-only-in-heaven substance). Per Red Line #12, the Son-of-Adam-architecture the framework reads runs through 1 Enoch 46-71's named-figure-of-the-Son-of-Adam-Elect-One (the named-Standard the framework reads at the title-naming register; NOT the kaph-comparative case of Daniel 7:13 / Revelation 1:13 / Revelation 14:14 the Red Line carves-out separately). The substantial-substance: the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) at the substantial-Resurrection-and-Ascension receives the substantial-Daniel-7:14-dominion-and-glory-and-a-kingdom substance the wisdom-stream had named at the throne-of-glory-substance for centuries before. The substantial-substance walks the substantial Psalm 110:1's right-hand-of-the-Father + Psalm 8:6's Adamic-dominion-restored (Hebrews 2:5-9's last-Adam-substance) + Ephesians 1:20-22 + Philippians 2:9-11 at the apostolic-substance. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

threads.title: Unclean spirits recognize the Holy One of Elohim before the people do
threads.summary_md: Twice in Mark 1-3 the unclean spirits cry out and name what the watching crowds cannot yet say — *thou art the Son of Elohim (God)* (Mark 3:11), *the Holy One of Elohim (God)* (Mark 1:24). The watchers' offspring (1 Enoch 15-16's bound demons) know exactly who stands in front of them, because they were there at the rebellion and they recognize the Formed one when he walks in. James 2:19's *the devils also believe, and tremble* names the same diagnostic: the demons' recognition is not the same as the sheep's hearing. The Son of Adam silences them (*Hold thy peace,* Mark 1:25; *he straitly charged them that they should not make him known,* Mark 3:12) because the testimony of an unclean spirit is not the witness through which the kingdom is announced — that comes through the prophets, the apostles, and the sheep who hear his voice.

threads.title: Tehillim (Psalm) 110:1 — David's Lord, the Formed at the right hand of the Formless
threads.summary_md:
*David himself said by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), Yahuah (the LORD) said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand* (Mark 12:36) — the King hands the Tehillim (Psalm) 110:1 architecture to the temple-crowd: David called the Messiah *Lord*, which means the Davidic-Son is more than a son. The Formless speaks to the Formed; the Formed sits at the Formless's right hand. This is the Formed-cloud-rider self-disclosure delivered by Yahusha's own mouth in the days before the cross.

*Yahuah (the LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.* (Psalm 110:1) The Tanakh-anchor is unmistakable. The first *Lord* is YHWH speaking; the second *Lord* (Adonai) is the one David addresses as his Sovereign. The Markan disclosure is the Father speaking to the Son at his right hand — the same architecture Peter walks at Pentecost (*Yahuah (the LORD) said unto my Lord,* Acts 2:34), the same architecture Hebrews carries (*sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool,* Hebrews 1:13), the same architecture Paul carries (*for he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet,* 1 Corinthians 15:25).

The 1 Enoch Parables witness the same throne-architecture. The Elect One's name was named before the Head of Days (1 Enoch 48:2-3); the Elect One sits on the throne of glory beside the Ancient of Days (1 Enoch 45:3, 49:2-4, 61:8, 62:2-5). The seat at the right hand is the seat of the Formed expression at the side of the Formless source — not two competing gods, not a single person in two poses, but the Formless and the Formed in their eternal relation, made visible in the canon's most quoted Tanakh verse.

threads.title: The rich man and Lazaros — the framework-honest sheol with two compartments and the *they have Mosheh and the prophets* standing-test
threads.summary_md: Luke-specific. The parable that carries the framework's most explicit witness to the sheol-with-two-compartments register the inherited soul-sleep doctrine and inherited eternal-conscious-torment doctrine BOTH misread. Lazaros — full of sores, laid at the rich-man's gate, dogs licking the sores — dies and is carried by the angels into Avraham's (Abraham's) bosom. The rich man dies, is buried, lifts up his eyes in torments, and sees Avraham afar off and Lazaros in his bosom. *Between us and you there is a great gulf fixed* (v.26). The conscious-witness-between-death-and-resurrection register is here — the dead remember (the rich-man knows his five brethren), the dead see (across the gulf), the dead carry their identity (Lazaros is still Lazaros, the rich-man is still the rich-man). The framework holds the middle: sheol is real, conscious, two-compartmented, AND temporal pending the resurrection-and-judgment of Revelation 11:18 / Revelation 20:11-15. The inherited soul-sleep teaching erases this; the inherited eternal-conscious-torment teaching reads the torment-side as the final-eternal-destination rather than the pre-resurrection holding-state. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR. 1 Enoch 22:9-11 carries the same sheol-with-compartments witness (extras-quoted in summary; not a member-row per canon-edition scope). The closing test — *they have Mosheh (Moses) and the prophets; let them hear them. If they hear not Mosheh (Moses) and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead* (vv.29, 31) — is the King's own anti-antinomian standing-test fulfilled historically when Lazaros (a different Lazaros) is raised at John 11 and the chief priests seek to kill him. The rich-man's brothers are five — five-fifths of Yahudah (Judah), the same leadership-of-the-house who refuses the resurrection of the King a chapter later.

threads.title: The unclean spirits as the watchers' bound offspring who recognize the Holy One — 1 Enoch
threads.summary_md: Twice in Mark 1-3 the unclean spirits cry out and name what the watching crowds cannot yet say — *I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of Elohim (God)* (Mark 1:24), *Thou art the Son of Elohim (God)* (Mark 3:11). The Enochic library names exactly who they are. 1 Enoch 15:6-7 — *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth... Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin.* These are the watchers' offspring: the spirits gone forth from the slain giants' flesh. 1 Enoch 15:11 names their appointed end — *thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement* — which is why the demon at Mark 1:24 asks *art thou come to destroy us?* It knows its judgement-day is fixed. 1 Enoch 16:1, 4 names their sentence — *Say to them therefore: "You have no peace"* — the no-peace condition speaking in the demon's *Let us alone.* 1 Enoch 19:1 names the standing-place of their judgement — *here shall they stand, till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* The unclean spirits recognize the Formed one before the people do because they were there at the rebellion; the recognition is not the sheep's hearing — the demons know and tremble, and the Son of Adam silences them, because the kingdom is not announced through unclean mouths.

threads.title: Binding the strong man — the binding of Azazel and the watcher-spirits in 1 Enoch and Jubilees
threads.summary_md: *No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house* (Mark 3:27). The binding-then-spoiling architecture the King names is the architecture the Enochic and Jubilees libraries already recorded. 1 Enoch 10:4-6 names the binding of Azazel — *Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert... and on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.* 1 Enoch 10:11-12 names the binding of Semjaza and his associates — *bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation.* Jubilees 5:6 carries the same — *He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound in the midst of them, and are (kept) separate.* Jubilees 10:7-8 names the Mastema-negotiation — the chief of the spirits asking that a remnant be left to him *to execute the power of my will on the sons of men* — and Jubilees 10:11 names the verdict — *all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.* The strong-man whose house the King enters and spoils is the bound watcher-administration and the tenth-part remnant under Satan; the Beelzebub-accusation of Mark 3:22 mistakes the King's spoiling of that remnant for collusion with the prince of the devils. The King's ministry is the incursion that binds the strong-man so the captives can be released — the typological anchor supplied by the libraries that name the binding.

threads.title: Legion and the evil spirits of the giants in 1 Enoch and Jubilees
threads.summary_md: Mark 5:1-20 sets the King against a man with an unclean spirit whose name is *Legion: for we are many* — a multitude of spirits afflicting a man among the tombs, begging not to be sent *out of the country.* The Hebrew library names what this multitude is and where it came from. 1 Enoch 15 traces the evil spirits to the slain giants born of the Watchers' rebellion: *the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling* — *and the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth* (1 Enoch 15:6, 15:8-9). They *destroy without incurring judgement... until the day of the consummation, the great judgement* (1 Enoch 15:11), and their sentence is already written: *You have no peace* (1 Enoch 16:4). 1 Enoch 19:1 names their work as leading mankind *astray into sacrificing to demons as gods,* held *till the day of the great judgement.* Jubilees 10 carries the same framework with the detail Mark's narrative assumes: *the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them* (Jubilees 10:1), and after Noah's prayer the chief of the spirits Mastêmâ obtains that *the tenth part of them remain before him, and let nine parts descend into the place of condemnation* (Jubilees 10:8). The legion is part of that tenth-part still permitted to operate; its plea not to be cast out of the country is the plea not to lose the ground from which it leads astray. The King's casting-out is the partially-restrained-spirits framework walked into a single deliverance — the man restored to his right mind, the spirits displaced before the day appointed for their end.

threads.title: The worm dieth not and the place of punishment in Judith and 1 Enoch
threads.summary_md: Mark 9:43-48's thrice-repeated warning — *it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched: where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched* — draws its image from Isaiah 66:24 (canon), and the Hebrew library carries the same architecture. Judith 16:17 pairs the deathless worm with the unquenched fire in the day-of-judgment register: *Yahuah (God) Almighty will take vengeance of them in the day of judgment, in putting fire and worms in their flesh; and they shall feel them, and weep for ever.* 1 Enoch maps the place itself: 1 Enoch 22:11 names the holding of the spirits of the dead *until the day of their judgement and until their appointed period, till the great judgement comes upon them* — the framework-honest two-compartment Sheol behind the gospel's *hell* (Gehenna), not the inherited eternal-torment caricature; 1 Enoch 27:1-3 places the accursed valley beside the holy mountain, the Ge-Hinnom topography the word Gehenna draws its name from. The King names the place of judgment the Hebrew library had already mapped: the deathless worm, the unquenched fire, the accursed valley appointed for the day.

threads.title: The Son of Adam enthroned on the throne of glory in the Parables of Enoch
threads.summary_md: Mark 14:62 — the King's answer under oath at the Sanhedrin: *I am: and ye shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* This is direct attribution — no kaph. (The kaph-comparative carve-out of Red Line #12 applies only to Daniel 7:13 / Revelation 1:13 / Revelation 14:14, none of which is in view here.) The Parables of Enoch name the same figure as a title, the Son of Adam beside the Head of Days: *with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man... this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness... whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever* (1 Enoch 46:1, 3), and *this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats* (46:4). 1 Enoch 62 names the seating directly: *Yahuah (God) of Spirits named the Elect One, and seated him on the throne of His glory* (62:1); *this is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, and righteousness abides over him, and the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not* (62:7); and again the judging-reversal — *this Son of Adam... shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, and the strong from their thrones* (62:9). The Parables' Son of Adam is title-naming, not the kaph-comparative — the named, chosen figure beside the Head of Days (the Formed beside the Formless source), seated on the throne of glory, who raises the mighty from their thrones. Mark 14:62's direct self-identification lands on the same figure: the condemned one at the Sanhedrin's bar is the enthroned Son of Adam who will raise the very court that condemns him from its seat. The wisdom-stream named the enthroned Son of Adam and the kings-and-mighty-cast-down reversal the King invokes at his trial.

threads.title: Gabriel, that stand in the presence — the named angel of the presence in 1 Enoch
threads.summary_md: When the angel answers Zecharyah (Zacharias) at the altar of incense — *I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of Elohim (God); and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings* (Luke 1:19) — he names the standing-before-the-throne office the Hebrew library had already named, and names himself by name. 1 Enoch 40:1-2 names the innumerable host *standing before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* and the *four presences* on the four sides of the throne; 1 Enoch 40:9 names them — *Michael... Raphael... Gabriel... Phanuel.* Gabriel is named as the third of the presences who stand before Yahuah of Spirits. The gospel sends that same named angel of the presence to the priest at the hour of incense. The Hebrew library carries the throne-room roster; the gospel sends one named angel from it into the temple-court — and the same Phanuel of the Enochic roster threads into the very next chapter as Anna *the daughter of Phanuel* (Luke 2:36). The angelic office is not a New Testament novelty; the gospel names the angel the wisdom of Enoch the righteous had already seen standing before the throne.

threads.title: The multitude of the heavenly host — the innumerable host praising before Yahuah of Spirits in 1 Enoch
threads.summary_md: Over the fields of the shepherds, *suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising Elohim (God), and saying, Glory to Elohim (God) in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men* (Luke 2:13-14).
